detail.abstract:
This report marks our 3rd year of tracking the growth and development of online alternative finance industry in the Asia Pacific region. Our report last year reflected how this nascent industry has evolved across the region, affecting the way people, businesses and institutions access, raise and invest money. This year’s report illustrates the geographically uneven yet considerable growth of online alternative finance in many countries across the Asia Pacific region. Based on the survey data collected from 340 entries from APAC’s 29 countries and 782 entries from China, the analysis contained in this report will provide a snapshot of the rapidly changing and highly fluid Asia Pacific alternative finance market. 

This report is jointly produced by The Cambridge Centre for Alternative Finance at Cambridge Judge Business School, The Academy of Internet Finance at Zhejiang University and the Asian Development Bank Institute. This report was also generously supported by KPMG Australia, Invesco and CME Group Foundation.

AI.tldr: 该报告是亚太地区在线替代金融行业发展的第三年跟踪研究，基于对亚太29个国家的340个条目和中国782个条目的调查数据，展示了该地区在线替代金融的地理分布不均但显著增长的趋势。
AI.research_question: 亚太地区在线替代金融行业如何增长和发展？不同国家间的增长模式有何差异？
AI.motivation: 跟踪亚太地区在线替代金融这一新兴行业的演变，了解其如何改变个人、企业和机构的融资和投资方式，为政策制定者和市场参与者提供数据支持。
AI.theoretical_framework: 替代金融理论、金融科技发展理论、区域金融发展差异理论
AI.method: 基于调查数据的描述性统计分析，收集了亚太29个国家的340个条目和中国782个条目的数据，采用年度跟踪研究方法
AI.findings: 亚太地区在线替代金融呈现地理分布不均但显著增长的趋势，许多国家都经历了可观的增长，市场变化快速且流动性高
AI.theory_contributions: 提供了亚太地区替代金融发展的实证数据，丰富了区域金融科技发展的理论框架，揭示了不同国家间替代金融发展的差异模式
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供市场发展现状的快照，帮助投资者了解市场机会，为企业提供融资渠道参考，支持亚太地区金融包容性发展

title: Identifying and Prioritising Organisational Factors Influencing Occupational Safety: Insights from a Systematic Review and Delphi Study
affiliations: University of Minho, University of Minho, University of Minho, Universitat de les Illes Balears and University of Minho

detail.title: Identifying and Prioritising Organisational Factors Influencing Occupational Safety: Insights from a Systematic Review and Delphi Study
detail.abstract: Organisational Factors play a central role in shaping work systems and determining occupational safety and health outcomes; however, existing evidence remains fragmented and largely concentrated in specific industrial sectors. This study aims to systematically identify, validate, and prioritise Organisational Factors influencing occupational safety in work systems, with particular attention to the food retail sector, an operationally complex and underrepresented service context. An integrated methodological design was adopted, combining a PRISMA-based systematic literature review with an expert-based Delphi study. The systematic review identified 52 Organisational Factors reported across 34 empirical studies, which were subsequently harmonised to ensure conceptual consistency. These factors were organised into nine thematic groups and subjected to expert validation and prioritisation through two Delphi rounds. The process resulted in a final validated framework comprising 68 Organisational Factors distributed across nine domains. The evaluation phase revealed marked differences in the perceived impact of organisational domains, with Safety Climate and Employee Development achieving the highest mean impact scores. Training emerged as the most influential individual factor, followed by safety behaviours and compliance, and the provision of safety equipment. The findings confirm the systemic and multidimensional nature of occupational safety and highlight the importance of integrated organisational approaches, particularly in service-based environments such as food retail. This study provides a robust conceptual and operational foundation to further development of organisational safety strategies and to promote future research.

AI.tldr: 本研究通过系统文献综述和德尔菲法，识别、验证并优先排序影响职业安全的组织因素，特别关注食品零售业，最终构建了包含68个组织因素、分布在9个领域的验证框架。
AI.research_question: 如何系统识别、验证并优先排序影响工作系统职业安全的组织因素，特别是在食品零售这一操作复杂且代表性不足的服务行业背景下？
AI.motivation: 组织因素在塑造工作系统和决定职业安全健康结果中起核心作用，但现有证据分散且主要集中在特定工业部门，缺乏对服务行业（如食品零售）的系统研究。
AI.theoretical_framework: 组织因素理论、职业安全系统理论、多维安全框架理论，强调组织因素对安全结果的系统性影响。
AI.method: 采用整合方法设计：1）基于PRISMA的系统文献综述识别组织因素；2）专家德尔菲研究（两轮）进行验证和优先排序；3）因素概念一致性协调和主题分组。
AI.findings: 1）识别了52个组织因素，协调后形成9个主题组；2）最终验证框架包含68个组织因素分布在9个领域；3）安全氛围和员工发展领域影响评分最高；4）培训是最具影响力的个体因素，其次是安全行为与合规、安全设备提供。
AI.theory_contributions: 1）提供了职业安全组织因素的系统性框架；2）证实了职业安全的系统性和多维性本质；3）扩展了组织安全理论到服务行业背景；4）为未来研究提供了概念和操作基础。
AI.practical_contributions: 1）为食品零售等服务业组织提供了具体的安全策略指导；2）识别了关键优先干预领域（安全氛围、员工发展、培训）；3）为组织安全战略制定提供了实证基础；4）支持服务行业安全管理实践改进。

title: mUTxO: CPMM Design with Native Margin Trading and Bitcoin Interoperability
affiliations: and Indipendent Researcher

detail.title: mUTxO: CPMM Design with Native Margin Trading and Bitcoin Interoperability

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The authors declare the following financial interests/personal relationships which may be considered as potential competing interests: Pi Lanningham is the CTO of SundaeSwap Labs, a decentralized exchange on the Cardano blockchain. The research presented in this paper regarding margin trading and cross-chain designs may be relevant to the future development of the SundaeSwap protocol. Georgios Tsoumas’s contribution is supported by the Artemisa Chair.
declarations.funderStatement: This research was supported by the Artemisa Chair (financed by the European Union - NextGenerationEU and the Spanish Government’s Recovery, Transformation and Resilience Plan) and by Project Catalyst (the Cardano community innovation fund).

detail.abstract: Constant Product Market Maker (CPMM) designs are the cornerstone of decentralized exchange, yet they inherently suffer from low capital efficiency and suboptimal liquidity provider (LP) incentives. In this work, we propose a novel extension of the classical CPMM model that utilizes idle liquidity within the pool to enable decentralized margin trading. We introduce a UTXO-based state management system to encode and track active margin positions, referred to as mUTXOs. We formally prove that this model closely mirrors the behavior of traditional CPMMs. Furthermore, we demonstrate how this architecture composes with standard Bitcoin interoperability solutions to facilitate cross-chain exposure, preserving a Bitcoin-native fee structure for a seamless user experience.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种基于UTXO状态管理系统的CPMM扩展模型，利用闲置流动性实现去中心化保证金交易，同时保持与传统CPMM相似的行为特性，并与比特币互操作性解决方案兼容。
AI.research_question: 如何扩展传统CPMM模型，利用闲置流动性实现去中心化保证金交易，同时保持与传统CPMM相似的行为特性？
AI.motivation: 传统CPMM存在资本效率低和流动性提供者激励不足的问题，需要创新方案提高资本利用率并改善LP收益。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于UTXO的状态管理系统（mUTXOs）、CPMM扩展模型、去中心化保证金交易理论。
AI.method: 提出UTXO-based状态管理系统来编码和跟踪活跃保证金头寸（mUTXOs），并形式化证明该模型与传统CPMM行为相似。
AI.findings: 该模型能有效利用闲置流动性实现保证金交易，与传统CPMM行为高度一致，并能与标准比特币互操作性解决方案结合实现跨链暴露。
AI.theory_contributions: 1）提出了CPMM的扩展模型；2）开发了基于UTXO的保证金头寸跟踪系统；3）形式化证明了与传统CPMM的等价性。
AI.practical_contributions: 1）提高资本效率；2）改善LP激励；3）支持跨链交易；4）保持比特币原生费用结构，提升用户体验。

title: The Ownership Gap - Digital Capital and the Structure of Economic Recognition

detail.title: The Ownership Gap - Digital Capital and the Structure of Economic Recognition
detail.abstract:
This paper identifies and analyzes a structural condition in contemporary capital formation termed the ownership gap: the divergence between those who materially contribute to the formation of durable capital systems and those who hold residual ownership claims over the resulting assets.

The argument proceeds in four stages. First, it examines how codification, persistent measurement, and large-scale aggregation transform distributed human participation into formative input at the capital formation stage — a threshold at which activity becomes asset without altering ownership. Second, it identifies two engines that drive this divergence: automation without continuity, which transfers accumulated expertise from human actors into owned infrastructure, and participation as infrastructure, which converts ongoing human activity into the substrate of durable capital systems. Third, it evaluates why the policy instruments most commonly proposed in response,  competition enforcement, income redistribution, and consent mechanisms — are structurally downstream of the formation stage and do not address the origin of asymmetry. Fourth, it introduces the Human-Derived Capital Trust as a directional institutional construct demonstrating that ownership recognition at the formation stage is conceivable within existing legal traditions.

The ownership gap is distinguished from adjacent arguments concerning wage suppression, market concentration, and behavioral surveillance. It is an architectural condition, embedded at the moment capital forms and is shown to compound over time through persistence, irreversibility, and intergenerational transmission of ownership claims. The paper argues that ownership categories, which have historically evolved in response to shifts in capital formation logic, may require recalibration under contemporary conditions of digital capital accumulation.

AI.tldr: 本文识别并分析了当代资本形成中的结构性条件——所有权缺口：即那些对持久资本系统形成做出实质性贡献的人与持有最终资产所有权的人之间的分离。作者提出人类衍生资本信托作为可能的制度解决方案。
AI.research_question: 在当代数字资本积累条件下，如何解释和解决资本形成阶段贡献者与所有者之间的结构性分离（所有权缺口）？
AI.motivation: 现有政策工具（竞争执法、收入再分配、同意机制）处于资本形成阶段的下游，无法解决所有权不对称的根源问题。需要从资本形成的架构层面重新思考所有权分配。
AI.theoretical_framework: 资本形成理论、所有权理论、制度经济学、数字资本积累理论。区别于工资压制、市场集中和行为监控等相邻论点，聚焦于资本形成的结构性条件。
AI.method: 概念分析框架构建，分四阶段论证：1）分析资本形成阶段的人类参与转化机制；2）识别驱动分离的两个引擎；3）评估现有政策工具的局限性；4）提出制度解决方案。
AI.findings: 所有权缺口是嵌入资本形成时刻的架构性条件，通过自动化无连续性、参与即基础设施等机制产生，并随时间通过持久性、不可逆性和代际所有权传递而加剧。现有政策工具无法解决根源问题。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了"所有权缺口"这一新的概念框架，区分了资本形成阶段的所有权不对称问题。发展了数字资本积累条件下的所有权理论，为重新校准所有权类别提供了理论基础。
AI.practical_contributions: 提出了"人类衍生资本信托"这一制度构想，展示了在现有法律传统中实现资本形成阶段所有权承认的可能性。为政策制定者提供了新的干预方向。

title: Rephrasing Illusions: an Agent-based model of Madoff 's Ponzi scheme
affiliations: Ca Foscari University of Venice - Dipartimento di Economia and Ca Foscari University of Venice

detail.title: Rephrasing Illusions: an Agent-based model of Madoff 's Ponzi scheme

publicationDetails.detailsText: Ca' Foscari University of Venice, Department of Economics Research Paper Series No. 10/2026
publicationDetails.journalName: Department of Economics, Ca' Foscari University of Venice Research Paper Series

detail.abstract: In light of the Madoff case, we present an Agent-Based Model of a Ponzi scheme. Agents are initially inclined to invest in the scam because they believe the wealth will increase, even if the fraudster dissipates it without any investment. We stress that the main characteristic of such schemes is the growing discrepancy between the perceived wealth and the actual total amount of money in the impostor's possession. The tendency gradually reverses and more agents withdraw their wealth (and made-up profits) if trust is lost as a result of hearing negative news about the economy. We look at how long it takes to expose the fraud and file for bankruptcy in relation to the volume of news that enters the market. We also look into the impact of a special agent dubbed Markopolos (inspired by a genuine personage) on the time to bankruptcy because of his capacity to quickly "convince" the agents he encounters to disinvest. Although the Markopolos effect seems to be statistically significant, it is not very strong when it comes to the results of a news flow and the subsequent widespread loss of faith and redemptions.

AI.tldr: 该研究通过基于代理的模型分析庞氏骗局（如麦道夫案）的动态机制，重点关注感知财富与实际资金之间的差距、负面新闻对信任的影响，以及"Markopolos"式特殊代理对骗局暴露时间的影响。
AI.research_question: 庞氏骗局中，负面新闻流量和特殊"Markopolos"式代理如何影响骗局暴露和破产时间？
AI.motivation: 基于麦道夫庞氏骗局案例，需要理解这类金融欺诈的动态机制，特别是投资者信任变化、负面信息传播以及特殊个体在揭露骗局中的作用。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于代理建模理论，结合行为金融学中的信任机制、信息传播理论和集体行为理论，分析庞氏骗局中投资者决策的动态过程。
AI.method: 采用基于代理的建模方法，模拟投资者（代理）在庞氏骗局中的投资和撤资决策，特别关注负面新闻流入和特殊"Markopolos"代理的影响。
AI.findings: 1) 庞氏骗局的核心特征是感知财富与实际资金之间的差距不断扩大；2) 负面新闻导致信任丧失，促使更多投资者撤资；3) "Markopolos"效应在统计上显著但影响有限；4) 新闻流量对广泛信任丧失和赎回的影响更为关键。
AI.theory_contributions: 1) 建立了庞氏骗局的基于代理模型框架；2) 量化分析了信任动态与信息传播的相互作用；3) 揭示了特殊个体在金融欺诈揭露中的有限作用；4) 为理解集体金融欺诈行为提供了新的理论视角。
AI.practical_contributions: 1) 为监管机构提供识别庞氏骗局早期信号的参考；2) 帮助投资者理解负面信息在骗局暴露中的关键作用；3) 强调新闻媒体在金融市场监管中的重要性；4) 为金融欺诈预警系统设计提供模型基础。

title: Traffic Assignment as a Differentiable Program
affiliations: and Northwestern University

detail.title: Traffic Assignment as a Differentiable Program
detail.abstract: Differentiable programming enables the efficient computation of gradients for complex mathematical models via automatic differentiation. In this note, we examine its application to transportation research by recasting traffic assignment as a differentiable program that can be embedded within broader hierarchical optimization and learning frameworks. Differentiable traffic assignment (DiTA) replaces conventional equilibrium conditions with an "equilibrium generation" process that is both smooth and behaviorally grounded. This reformulation allows modelers to assess how assignment outcomes respond to changes in input parameters by differentiating through the equilibrium generation process, effectively performing backpropagation, in the language of neural networks. By leveraging the computational infrastructure developed for training neural networks, DiTA has the potential to transform the way a wide range of transportation problems, particularly those formulated as bi-level programs, are solved. This note presents the conceptual foundations of DiTA, discusses key implementation challenges, and highlights promising future directions.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出了一种可微交通分配（DiTA）方法，将交通分配问题重新构建为可微程序，使其能够嵌入更广泛的分层优化和学习框架中，利用自动微分技术计算梯度，从而改变双层规划等交通问题的求解方式。
AI.research_question: 如何将可微编程应用于交通研究，特别是如何将交通分配问题重新构建为可微程序，使其能够嵌入更广泛的分层优化和学习框架中？
AI.motivation: 可微编程能够通过自动微分高效计算复杂数学模型的梯度，但这一技术在交通研究中的应用潜力尚未充分挖掘。传统交通分配方法基于均衡条件，难以直接计算输入参数变化对分配结果的影响。
AI.theoretical_framework: 可微编程理论、自动微分技术、交通分配理论、均衡生成过程、神经网络反向传播原理、双层规划理论。
AI.method: 将交通分配重新构建为可微程序，用"均衡生成"过程替代传统均衡条件，利用神经网络训练的计算基础设施进行反向传播，通过微分均衡生成过程来评估输入参数变化对分配结果的影响。
AI.findings: DiTA方法能够创建平滑且基于行为的均衡生成过程，使模型能够通过微分该过程来评估输入参数变化对分配结果的影响，从而有效执行反向传播，利用神经网络基础设施解决传统双层规划问题。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了可微交通分配（DiTA）的理论框架，将交通分配重新概念化为可微程序，建立了均衡生成过程的数学基础，为交通研究中的可微编程应用提供了理论支持。
AI.practical_contributions: DiTA能够利用神经网络训练的计算基础设施，改变交通问题特别是双层规划问题的求解方式，为交通模型评估参数敏感性提供了新方法，提高了计算效率。

title: Energy Expenditure of Low-income Households
affiliations: , Research Institute for Labour and Social Affairs, Masaryk University and Prague University of Economics and Business

detail.title: Energy Expenditure of Low-income Households

declarations.funderStatement: This research was supported financially through the institutional support for the long-term conceptual development of research organisations for the period 2023-2025, via the Ministry of Labour and Social Affairs of the Czech Republic. It forms a part of the research task “Body zlomu v nepojistných dávkových systémech” (No. IP70204).

detail.abstract: The residential sector is one of the largest consumers of energy, contributing significantly to climate change. Understanding the energy behaviour of households can allow policymakers design more effective targeted policies, achieving the targets of net-zero emissions. We analyse the drivers of electricity and gas expenditure among low-income households using an administrative panel dataset of housing benefit recipients for 2018-2023. These results are compared to the energy expenditure of average households using the EU-SILC dataset. We employ the adaptive Lasso for covariate selection and estimate a panel fixed effects model separately for homeowners and renters, motivated by the tenant-landlord problem. Electricity and gas have similar determinants, but gas expenditure is generally more elastic, reacting more to household composition and prices. Homeowners respond more to income and social benefits, while renters are more price-sensitive, by about 3-5%. Low-income households are considerably more vulnerable to price shocks and energy poverty than the average households. The counterfactuals indicate that low-income household energy spending would have been 15-20% lower in the absence of the energy crisis, while VAT cuts offer limited effectiveness. Our results highlight the need for policies that combine targeted energy rebates for low-income households and strong incentives for landlords to upgrade housing, to satisfy both affordability and national climate objectives.

AI.tldr: 本文分析低收入家庭电力和燃气支出的驱动因素，发现燃气支出更具弹性，房主对收入更敏感，租户对价格更敏感，低收入家庭在能源危机中更脆弱，需要针对性政策支持。
AI.research_question: 低收入家庭电力和燃气支出的主要驱动因素是什么？与普通家庭相比有何差异？不同住房所有权类型（房主vs租户）的能源支出行为有何不同？
AI.motivation: 住宅部门是最大的能源消费领域之一，对气候变化有重要影响。了解家庭能源行为有助于政策制定者设计更有效的针对性政策，实现净零排放目标。特别关注低收入家庭，因为他们更容易受到能源贫困和价格冲击的影响。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于租户-房东问题理论，分析不同住房所有权类型对能源支出行为的影响。使用面板固定效应模型，考虑家庭异质性和时间变化因素。
AI.method: 使用2018-2023年住房福利领取者的行政面板数据集，采用自适应Lasso进行协变量选择，分别对房主和租户估计面板固定效应模型。与欧盟收入和生活条件调查（EU-SILC）数据集中的普通家庭进行比较。
AI.findings: 1. 电力和燃气有相似的驱动因素，但燃气支出更具弹性，对家庭构成和价格变化反应更敏感；2. 房主对收入和社会福利更敏感，租户对价格更敏感（约3-5%）；3. 低收入家庭比普通家庭更容易受到价格冲击和能源贫困的影响；4. 反事实分析显示，若无能源危机，低收入家庭能源支出将降低15-20%；5. 增值税削减效果有限。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 扩展了租户-房东问题理论在能源消费领域的应用；2. 揭示了不同住房所有权类型对能源支出行为的差异化影响；3. 提供了低收入家庭能源脆弱性的实证证据。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 政策制定者应结合针对性能源补贴和房东住房升级激励措施；2. 需要针对低收入家庭的特殊政策设计；3. 增值税削减等传统政策工具效果有限，需要更综合的政策方案；4. 同时满足可负担性和国家气候目标的双重政策需求。

title: Climate Change as a Negative Global Production Externality
affiliations: University of Warsaw, Faculty of Economic Sciences and University of Warsaw, Poland

detail.title: Climate Change as a Negative Global Production Externality

declarations.declarationOfInterest: NA
declarations.ethicsApproval: NA
declarations.funderStatement: NA

detail.abstract: Climate change and global warming are the most significant negative externalities affecting global production. Atmospheric concentrations of carbon dioxide and other greenhouse gas emissions have increased remarkably since preindustrial levels. The global increase in carbon dioxide is due to increasing fossil fuel use and land-use changes. This chapter discusses climate change as a negative externality of global production, the social cost of war emissions, and the monetary price of carbon emissions. The increase in global temperature and carbon emissions is attributed to the high demand for energy for residential, industrial, and commercial purposes. An increase in global energy demand drives global warming and results in changes in climate over time. Since the Industrial Revolution, human activities have had atmospheric concentrations of greenhouse gases on the Earth's surface. The climate has experienced long-term changes in temperature, weather, sea-level rise, and precipitation. This introductory chapter addresses public goods, market failure, externalities of war, and carbon emissions, and how imposing a price on carbon can reduce global production externalities. Human activities had already warmed the planet by about 1°C above pre-industrial levels, and achieving the Paris Agreement goal of limiting global warming to 1.5°C is now increasingly challenging. Excessive carbon emissions need to be tracked and controlled to avoid great risks to humanity and the economy. In this context, this chapter highlights carbon pricing as an instrument to control carbon emissions.

AI.tldr: 本章将气候变化视为全球生产的负外部性，探讨碳排放的社会成本与货币定价，强调碳定价作为控制碳排放的政策工具。
AI.research_question: 如何通过碳定价机制来减少全球生产中的碳排放负外部性？
AI.motivation: 气候变化和全球变暖已成为影响全球生产的最显著负外部性，自工业革命以来温室气体浓度显著增加，需要有效政策工具来控制碳排放。
AI.theoretical_framework: 公共物品理论、市场失灵理论、外部性理论（特别是负外部性）、碳定价理论
AI.method: 理论分析框架，基于气候变化经济学和环境经济学的理论分析
AI.findings: 全球温度上升和碳排放增加主要源于能源需求增长；碳定价是控制碳排放的有效政策工具；实现巴黎协定1.5°C目标面临挑战
AI.theory_contributions: 将气候变化系统性地纳入全球生产负外部性分析框架；整合碳定价理论与外部性理论；为碳排放控制提供理论依据
AI.practical_contributions: 提出碳定价作为控制碳排放的政策建议；为政策制定者提供减少全球生产外部性的工具；强调追踪和控制碳排放的重要性

title: The Impact of Artificial Intelligence on the Activities of Multinational Corporations from a Conceptual Perspective
affiliations: Loyola College, Chennai - Department of Commerce

detail.title: The Impact of Artificial Intelligence on the Activities of Multinational Corporations from a Conceptual Perspective

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The authors declare that they have no known competing financial interests or personal relationships that could have appeared to influence the work reported in this paper. The research was conducted independently, and no external entity had any role in the conceptualization, analysis, writing, or decision to submit the manuscript for publication.
declarations.ethicsApproval: This study is a conceptual and theoretical analysis based exclusively on secondary sources and publicly available literature. It does not involve human participants, personal data collection, or experimental procedures. Therefore, ethics committee approval and informed consent were not required.
declarations.funderStatement: This research received no specific grant from any funding agency in the public, commercial, or not-for-profit sectors. The study was conducted as part of the authors’ independent academic research activities.

detail.abstract: Multinational corporations (MNCs) operate in increasingly complex global environments characterized by intense competition, rapid technological change, regulatory diversity, and dynamic consumer preferences. Artificial Intelligence (AI) has emerged as a transformative technology influencing a wide range of multinational activities, from strategic decision-making and operations management to finance, marketing, human resources, and supply chain coordination. This conceptual paper examines the impact of AI on key activities of multinational corporations by synthesizing existing academic literature, industry reports, and global business practices. The study highlights how AI enhances operational efficiency, strategic responsiveness, and organizational integration across borders, while also identifying challenges related to governance, ethics, workforce transformation, and regulatory compliance. The paper concludes that AI is reshaping the structure and functioning of MNCs and calls for future empirical research on AI-driven global business transformation.

AI.tldr: 这篇概念性论文探讨了人工智能对跨国公司关键活动的影响，分析了AI如何提升运营效率、战略响应能力和跨国组织整合，同时识别了治理、伦理、劳动力转型和监管合规等方面的挑战。
AI.research_question: 人工智能如何影响跨国公司的关键活动？AI对跨国公司的运营效率、战略响应能力和组织整合有何影响？
AI.motivation: 跨国公司在日益复杂的全球环境中运营，面临激烈竞争、技术快速变革、监管多样性和动态消费者偏好等挑战。人工智能作为变革性技术正在影响跨国公司的各个方面，需要系统研究其影响。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于跨国公司理论、技术创新理论和组织变革理论，分析AI对跨国公司战略决策、运营管理、财务、营销、人力资源和供应链协调的影响。
AI.method: 概念性研究，通过综合现有学术文献、行业报告和全球商业实践进行分析。
AI.findings: AI能显著提升跨国公司的运营效率、战略响应能力和跨国组织整合，但同时也带来治理、伦理、劳动力转型和监管合规方面的挑战。
AI.theory_contributions: 为AI与跨国公司研究提供了概念框架，识别了AI对跨国公司结构和功能的重塑作用，为未来实证研究奠定了基础。
AI.practical_contributions: 为跨国公司管理者提供了AI应用的实践指导，帮助识别AI实施中的挑战和机遇，促进AI驱动的全球业务转型。

title: Private Equity in College Sports
affiliations: City University of New York - Baruch College, Zicklin School of Business, Indiana University - Kelley School of Business and Indiana University - Kelley School of Business - Department of Business Law

detail.title: Private Equity in College Sports
detail.abstract: Changing financial dynamics of higher education and more specifically intercollegiate sports have led some colleges to explore unprecedented relationships with private equity firms. The potential infusion of private equity money into revenue-generating college sports programs portends an era of free-market capitalism in which college sports offerings would better serve market demand without requiring substantial upfront investment from non-profit institutions. But, these investments in college sports also produce newfound legal and ethical questions that require meaningful exploration. This article is the first to systematically investigate the potential for private equity investment into revenue-generating college sports. It provides a framework drawing on various legal theories to help regulators, university administrators, coaches, and athletes navigate the hurdles that inevitably will arise from such relationships.

AI.tldr: 本文首次系统研究私募股权对创收型大学体育项目的投资潜力，分析其带来的法律与伦理问题，并为相关方提供应对框架。
AI.research_question: 私募股权投资创收型大学体育项目的潜力、法律与伦理影响是什么？如何为相关方提供应对框架？
AI.motivation: 高等教育财务动态变化，特别是大学体育的财务压力，促使一些院校探索与私募股权公司前所未有的合作关系，这带来了新的法律和伦理问题。
AI.theoretical_framework: 自由市场资本主义理论、法律理论（包括合同法、公司法、教育法等）、伦理理论
AI.method: 系统性分析、法律理论框架构建、规范性分析
AI.findings: 私募股权投资大学体育可能开启自由市场资本主义时代，使体育项目更好服务市场需求，但会产生新的法律和伦理挑战。
AI.theory_contributions: 首次系统研究私募股权投资大学体育的学术领域，构建跨法律理论的分析框架，填补该领域研究空白。
AI.practical_contributions: 为监管机构、大学管理者、教练和运动员提供应对私募股权投资挑战的实用框架，帮助他们在新关系中导航。

title: GARP: Generalized Adaptive Rank Portfolio A Crisis-Adaptive, Assumption-Free Framework for Portfolio Construction

detail.title: GARP: Generalized Adaptive Rank Portfolio A Crisis-Adaptive, Assumption-Free Framework for Portfolio Construction
detail.abstract:
Portfolio construction has a unification problem. Mean-variance optimisation, Black-Litterman, and Hierarchical Risk Parity each solve part of the allocation problem while imposing their own distributional assumptions, methodological constraints, and arbitrary design choices. No existing framework simultaneously admits a freely chosen return signal, a freely chosen risk measure, a freely chosen crisis indicator, and a crisis-adaptive allocation mechanism without distributional assumptions.

This paper introduces GARP (Generalized Adaptive Rank Portfolio), a theoretical framework that resolves this fragmentation. GARP replaces Gaussian priors, heuristic bisection, and hard cluster assignments with a single continuous recursion through a crisis-adaptive asset hierarchy. At each node of the dendrogram, asset weights evolve as a product of three freely chosen rank scores - return attractiveness, risk, and tail contagion - scaled by marginal risk contribution and governed by a scalar crisis probability. Every input slot is free: any return signal, any risk measure, any tail dependence estimator, any crisis indicator is admissible.

The central result is a unification theorem: 1/N, IVP, ERC, HRP, HERC, and BL-HRP are all special cases of GARP under specific parameter choices. Four mathematical properties are proved: validity, continuity, crisis monotonicity, and degeneracy. Eight assumptions are stated explicitly with their roles, implications, and relaxation paths. Three concrete instantiations for global equities are fully specified to demonstrate modularity. Preliminary evidence from precursor models achieves a Sharpe ratio of 1.89 against a best benchmark of 0.22 and reduces the 2020 COVID peak drawdown by 75% relative to equal weighting. Full empirical evaluation across all three instantiations is the subject of a companion paper.

GARP is to portfolio construction what GARCH is to volatility modelling: not one more model, but the framework that contains them all.

AI.tldr: GARP是一个统一的投资组合构建框架，通过危机自适应资产层次结构的连续递归，替代传统方法的分布假设和启发式选择，允许自由选择回报信号、风险度量、尾部依赖估计和危机指标。
AI.research_question: 如何创建一个统一的投资组合构建框架，能够同时容纳自由选择的回报信号、风险度量、危机指标和危机自适应分配机制，而不需要分布假设？
AI.motivation: 现有投资组合构建方法（均值方差优化、Black-Litterman、分层风险平价等）各自解决部分分配问题，但都强加自己的分布假设、方法约束和任意设计选择，缺乏一个统一的框架。
AI.theoretical_framework: GARP（广义自适应排名投资组合）框架，基于危机自适应资产层次结构的连续递归，资产权重由三个自由选择的排名分数（回报吸引力、风险、尾部传染）的乘积决定，按边际风险贡献缩放，并由标量危机概率控制。
AI.method: 理论框架开发，包括统一定理证明、四个数学性质（有效性、连续性、危机单调性、退化性）证明，八个明确假设陈述，以及三个全球股票的具体实例化展示模块性。
AI.findings: 统一定理表明1/N、IVP、ERC、HRP、HERC和BL-HRP都是GARP在特定参数选择下的特例。初步证据显示夏普比率达到1.89（最佳基准为0.22），2020年COVID峰值回撤相对于等权重减少75%。
AI.theory_contributions: 1）提出了第一个统一投资组合构建框架；2）证明了统一定理；3）建立了四个数学性质；4）明确陈述了八个假设及其放松路径；5）展示了GARP与GARCH在各自领域的类比地位。
AI.practical_contributions: 1）为从业者提供了模块化、灵活的投资组合构建工具；2）允许自由选择输入信号和指标；3）三个具体实例化展示了实际应用；4）初步实证结果显示了优越的风险调整后回报和回撤控制能力。

title: Cavitation-Induced Hysteresis in Economic Networks: A Hydrodynamic Phase Transition Model of Operational Solvency

detail.title: Cavitation-Induced Hysteresis in Economic Networks: A Hydrodynamic Phase Transition Model of Operational Solvency
detail.abstract: Standard models of supply chain dynamics, specifically the "Bullwhip E ect," treat network nodes as elastic media subject to harmonic oscillation. This framework assumes that capacity is a continuous variable and that perturbations are reversible: when variance subsides, the system relaxes to equilibrium. We propose that this linear approximation holds only within laminar flow regimes and fails to account for topological phase transitions observed during high-amplitude volatility. Using a hydrodynamic isomorphism, we model the firm as a fluid conduit subject to thermodynamic constraints. We derive a critical threshold where local static pressure (𝑃 , representing liquidity) drops below the system's vapor pressure (𝑃 , representing fixed solvency requirements). Below this threshold, the node does not merely experience flow retardation; it undergoes a discrete phase transition from a liquid (operational) state to a vapor (insolvent) state. This transition introduces a "Capacity Void" and structural hysteresis, rendering the system non-ergodic over the recovery horizon. We introduce the Net Positive Solvency Head (𝑁𝑃𝑆𝐻) metric to quantify the metastability of the network node. Empirical validation against 2021 semiconductor supply data suggests that e iciency optimization (maximizing flow velocity 𝑣) systematically reduces the pressure margin, driving the system toward a critical point where minor stochastic fluctuations trigger catastrophic structural cavitation.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出传统供应链牛鞭效应模型存在局限，将企业建模为流体管道，引入相变概念解释供应链节点在流动性不足时的突然崩溃现象，并提出了NPSH指标来量化网络节点的稳定性。
AI.research_question: 供应链网络节点在极端波动下如何从运营状态转变为破产状态？传统线性模型能否解释这种离散的相变现象？
AI.motivation: 传统供应链牛鞭效应模型假设容量是连续变量且扰动可逆，但无法解释高波动性下观察到的拓扑相变和突然崩溃现象，需要新的理论框架来理解供应链网络的非线性行为。
AI.theoretical_framework:
1. 流体动力学同构：将企业建模为受热力学约束的流体管道
2. 相变理论：从液态（运营）到气态（破产）的离散转变
3. 临界阈值理论：当局部静压（流动性）低于系统蒸汽压（固定偿付要求）时发生相变
4. 非遍历性系统：引入结构滞后和容量空洞概念
AI.method:
1. 理论建模：建立流体动力学同构模型，推导临界阈值条件
2. 指标开发：提出净正偿付压头（NPSH）指标量化节点亚稳定性
3. 实证验证：使用2021年半导体供应链数据进行验证
AI.findings:
1. 效率优化（最大化流速）会系统性地减少压力裕度
2. 当系统接近临界点时，微小的随机波动可能引发灾难性的结构空化
3. 供应链节点在流动性不足时会发生离散的相变而非连续的流量减少
AI.theory_contributions:
1. 将相变理论引入供应链管理，提供理解节点崩溃的新视角
2. 提出NPSH指标量化供应链节点的稳定性
3. 揭示效率优化与系统脆弱性之间的权衡关系
AI.practical_contributions:
1. 为供应链管理者提供早期预警指标（NPSH）
2. 帮助企业在效率优化和系统稳定性之间做出平衡决策
3. 为供应链风险管理提供新的分析框架

title: The Trust Tax: Cognitive Offloading In Supply Chain Mechanism Design

detail.title: The Trust Tax: Cognitive Offloading In Supply Chain Mechanism Design
detail.abstract: Global supply chain governance has failed because it ignores the constraints of Bounded Rationality. The current "Audit Society" generates high-entropy signals, voluminous certificates and site visits, that overwhelm the cognitive bandwidth of agents, forcing them to rely on "Defection" as a fast and frugal heuristic. We analyze the 2025 UFLPA crisis, where a 77% isotopic failure rate (U.S. Customs and Border Protection, 2025) exposed the decoupling of administrative maps from physical territory, creating a classic Incomplete Contract problem (Hart & Moore, 1990) where residual control rights are unenforceable. This paper proposes "Hamiltonian Mechanism Design" not merely as a contract, but as a Cognitive O loader. By mapping the biological primitive of eusocial policing (rB > C) to smart contracts via "Escrowed Latency" and "Isotopic Triangulation," we collapse complex trust decisions into a binary liquidity signal. This reduces the information processing cost of integrity, allowing agents to "satisfice" safely without the "moral wiggle room" (Dana et al., 2007) that currently facilitates systemic defection. We introduce the "Judas Protocol" to destabilize cartel cognition and "Integrity Staking Pools" to financialize reputation. We argue that the "Trust Tax" is a product of cognitive overload, and that shifting from ceremonial verification to algorithmic shared destiny aligns economic incentives with the limits of human cognition.

AI.tldr: 本文提出"汉密尔顿机制设计"作为认知卸载工具，通过智能合约将复杂信任决策简化为二元流动性信号，解决全球供应链治理中因有限理性导致的失败问题。
AI.research_question: 如何设计一种机制来克服全球供应链治理中有限理性的约束，减少信息处理成本，防止系统性背叛行为？
AI.motivation: 当前"审计社会"产生的高熵信号（大量证书和现场访问）超出了代理人的认知带宽，迫使他们依赖"背叛"作为快速节俭的启发式策略，导致全球供应链治理失败。
AI.theoretical_framework: 有限理性理论、不完全契约理论（Hart & Moore, 1990）、道德摇摆空间理论（Dana et al., 2007）、真社会性监管的生物学原理（rB > C）
AI.method: 分析2025年UFLPA危机（77%同位素失败率），提出汉密尔顿机制设计，包括托管延迟、同位素三角测量、犹大协议和诚信质押池等智能合约技术
AI.findings: 当前审计方法导致行政地图与物理领土脱钩，产生不可执行剩余控制权的不完全契约问题；信任税是认知超载的产物
AI.theory_contributions: 将生物学真社会性监管原理映射到智能合约设计；提出认知卸载框架；将信任决策简化为二元流动性信号；引入算法共享命运概念
AI.practical_contributions: 提供可实施的汉密尔顿机制设计解决方案，包括具体技术组件（托管延迟、同位素三角测量、犹大协议、诚信质押池），帮助供应链参与者降低信息处理成本，实现安全满意化

title: Technology Investment, Productivity & Firm Valuation

detail.title: Technology Investment, Productivity & Firm Valuation

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The findings regarding the positive impact of AI and Clean-Tech adoption on total factor productivity (TFP), Return on Equity (ROE), and market valuation (Tobin's Q) are derived solely from the empirical data and econometric specifications detailed within the study. No external funding or industry sponsorship influenced the design, data collection, analysis, or interpretation of the results presented in this January 25, 2026, report
declarations.ethicsApproval: ​The research presented in this report, titled "Technology Investment, Productivity & Firm Valuation: Evidence from the AI and Clean-Tech Transition," involved the analysis of a panel dataset consisting of 500 publicly traded firms. All data utilized in this study—including financial metrics, technology adoption scores, and market valuation indicators—were obtained from publicly available sources and commercial databases covering the period 2021–2025.
declarations.funderStatement: The study did not receive any specific grant or financial support from funding agencies in the public, commercial, or not-for-profit sectors. The analysis was developed as an independent research project at the University of Waikato, utilizing a perspective informed by World Economic Forum Global Trends. All data utilized in the report were derived from publicly available or commercial financial databases covering the period 2021–2025.

detail.abstract:
This research report, authored by Md Rashidul Hasan of the University of Waikato, investigates the economic impact of the dual technology transition—Artificial Intelligence (AI) and Clean-Tech—on corporate performance as of January 2026. Analyzing a panel dataset of 500 firms across five major industries (2021–2025), the study quantifies how technology adoption drives measurable improvements in Total Factor Productivity (TFP), profitability, and market valuation.

Key Findings
  • Productivity Drivers: Regression analysis shows that AI adoption has a strong positive impact on TFP with a coefficient of 0.329, meaning a 10-point increase in a firm's AI adoption score correlates to a 3.3% rise in TFP. Clean-tech adoption offers a complementary productivity channel with a coefficient of 0.190.
  • Valuation & Profitability Premiums: Technology leaders in the highest AI adoption quintile command an average Tobin’s Q of 2.00, representing a 22% valuation premium over laggards. High-AI firms also achieve a significantly higher Return on Equity (ROE) of 38.1% compared to 30.9% for low-AI firms.
  • Risk-Return Profiles: Contradicting conventional wisdom, higher technology adoption is associated with lower volatility (31.2% for high-AI vs. 35.6% for low-AI firms). High-technology portfolios deliver a Sharpe ratio of 1.08, a 46% improvement in risk-adjusted returns.
  • Industry Trends: The Technology sector leads in AI adoption (79.0) and valuation (2.13 Tobin's Q), while the Energy sector dominates in clean-tech adoption (82.0). Manufacturing shows a balanced approach, effectively integrating both technologies.

The report concludes that by 2026, technology investments have become strategic imperatives rather than discretionary expenses. Firms that successfully navigate the accelerating convergence of AI and Clean-Tech are positioned to define the next decade of competitive success and shareholder value creation.

AI.tldr: 该研究分析了AI和清洁技术双重转型对企业绩效的经济影响，发现AI采用对全要素生产率有显著正向影响，技术领先企业享有估值溢价和更高盈利能力，且技术采用与更低波动性相关。
AI.research_question: 人工智能和清洁技术的双重技术转型如何影响企业绩效（包括生产率、盈利能力和市场估值）？
AI.motivation: 随着AI和清洁技术成为企业战略的核心，需要量化这些技术投资对企业绩效的实际影响，为企业在技术转型中的决策提供实证依据。
AI.theoretical_framework: 技术采纳理论、资源基础观、创新扩散理论、企业绩效评估框架（TFP、ROE、Tobin's Q）
AI.method: 使用2021-2025年500家企业的面板数据集进行回归分析，量化AI和清洁技术采纳对企业绩效的影响，包括TFP、ROE、Tobin's Q等指标。
AI.findings: 1. AI采纳对TFP有显著正向影响（系数0.329），清洁技术也有补充作用（系数0.190）；2. 高AI采纳企业享有22%估值溢价（Tobin's Q 2.00）和更高ROE（38.1% vs 30.9%）；3. 技术采纳与更低波动性相关；4. 科技行业AI采纳领先，能源行业清洁技术领先。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 提供了双重技术转型对企业绩效影响的实证证据；2. 挑战了技术投资增加风险的传统观念，发现技术采纳降低波动性；3. 建立了AI和清洁技术采纳与企业绩效的量化关系。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为企业技术投资决策提供量化依据；2. 识别不同行业的技术采纳模式；3. 证明技术投资已成为战略必需品而非可选项；4. 为投资者识别技术领先企业提供参考。

title: AI Policymaking Across the Globe: A Large-N Analysis of More Than 8,000 Policy Documents from 76 Countries
affiliations: University of York and UNDP Serbia, Digital Innovation

detail.title: AI Policymaking Across the Globe: A Large-N Analysis of More Than 8,000 Policy Documents from 76 Countries
detail.abstract: Legislative activity on AI governance has surged globally, yet we lack comparative empirical evidence on how "law hardening" develops and which pre-legislative activities catalyse binding regulation. We analyse the AI policy formation pipeline using more than 8,000 policy documents from 76 countries. Using Cox survival models, event studies, and Granger-style tests, we examine whether binding AI laws are driven by domestic pre-legislative activity or cross-border diffusion. We find that domestic accumulation of soft policy strongly predicts the timing of hard law adoption, while peer-country activity and other diffusion channels show no consistent effects. The observed trajectory reflects progressive, endogenous institutionalisation: strategic and discursive documents are followed by evidence production, then soft law adoption, and ultimately binding legislation. This pattern challenges accounts of performative policymaking in emerging technology regulation and suggests that soft law functions as an institutional stepping stone for learning and legitimation that catalyses subsequent hard law adoption.

AI.tldr: 该研究分析了76个国家8000多份政策文件，发现国内软政策积累能显著预测硬法采纳时间，而跨国扩散效应不明显。AI治理遵循渐进式内生制度化路径：战略文件→证据生产→软法→硬法。
AI.research_question: AI治理的"法律硬化"是如何发展的？哪些立法前活动催化了具有约束力的法规？国内立法前活动还是跨国扩散驱动了AI硬法的制定？
AI.motivation: 全球AI治理立法活动激增，但缺乏关于"法律硬化"发展过程和哪些立法前活动催化约束性法规的比较实证证据。
AI.theoretical_framework: 渐进式内生制度化理论、政策扩散理论、软法作为制度垫脚石理论、新兴技术治理中的表演性政策制定理论。
AI.method: 使用Cox生存模型、事件研究法和格兰杰式检验，分析76个国家8000多份政策文件，考察国内立法前活动与跨国扩散对AI硬法采纳的影响。
AI.findings: 国内软政策积累能强烈预测硬法采纳时间，而同行国家活动和其他扩散渠道没有一致效应。AI治理遵循渐进式内生制度化路径：战略和论述文件→证据生产→软法采纳→最终硬法立法。
AI.theory_contributions: 挑战了新兴技术治理中表演性政策制定的观点，提出软法作为学习和合法化的制度垫脚石理论，支持渐进式内生制度化而非政策扩散的解释框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供了AI治理路径的实证依据，表明国内软政策积累是硬法制定的重要前兆，跨国模仿效应有限，强调国内制度建设的重要性。

title: From Institutional Change to Social Responsibility: Synthesizing a Digital Archive for Global Management Research
affiliations: Harvard University - General Management Unit

detail.title: From Institutional Change to Social Responsibility: Synthesizing a Digital Archive for Global Management Research

publicationDetails.detailsText: Harvard Business School Working Paper No. 26-055
publicationDetails.journalName: Harvard Business School Working Papers

detail.abstract: Between 2007 and 2025, the Creating Emerging Markets (CEM) project at the Harvard Business School assembled a unique digital oral-history archive featuring 196 in-depth interviews with senior business leaders across 35 countries in Africa, Asia, Latin America, and the Middle East. This working paper examines the project's evolution from a regional pilot to a global research resource, highlighting its role in documenting how firms navigated institutional voids, managed political risk, and drove innovation in rapidly transforming economies. Unlike traditional archives, CEM provides rich, qualitative evidence on why management practices in emerging markets often diverge from Western models, offering new insights into diversified business groups, and reputation as a meta-resource. By analyzing the project's impact on teaching cases and scholarly literature this working paper demonstrates how longitudinal oral histories can bridge the gap between historical context and contemporary management theory. The CEM project provides a scalable model for future efforts to document the evolving intersection of business and society.

AI.tldr: 哈佛商学院CEM项目创建了包含196个深度访谈的数字化口述历史档案，记录了新兴市场企业如何应对制度真空、管理政治风险和推动创新，为理解新兴市场管理实践提供了丰富定性证据。
AI.research_question: CEM项目如何从区域试点发展为全球研究资源，以及它如何通过口述历史档案弥合历史背景与当代管理理论之间的差距？
AI.motivation: 传统档案缺乏对新兴市场企业实践的深入理解，需要创建能够捕捉新兴市场独特商业环境的定性证据资源，以解释为什么这些市场的管理实践与西方模式不同。
AI.theoretical_framework: 制度理论（应对制度真空）、政治风险管理理论、创新理论、新兴市场企业战略理论、多元化商业集团理论、声誉作为元资源理论。
AI.method: 纵向口述历史方法，对196位高级商业领袖进行深度访谈，覆盖35个国家的非洲、亚洲、拉丁美洲和中东地区，创建数字化档案并分析其对教学案例和学术文献的影响。
AI.findings: CEM项目成功记录了企业如何应对制度真空、管理政治风险和推动创新；提供了理解新兴市场管理实践差异的丰富定性证据；展示了多元化商业集团和声誉作为元资源的重要性；口述历史能够有效连接历史背景与当代管理理论。
AI.theory_contributions: 1）为新兴市场管理实践提供了新的理论视角；2）发展了制度真空应对的理论框架；3）深化了对多元化商业集团和声誉作为战略资源的理解；4）展示了口述历史作为研究方法在管理理论发展中的价值。
AI.practical_contributions: 1）为商学院教学提供了丰富的案例材料；2）为企业管理者提供了新兴市场运营的实践洞见；3）为政策制定者理解商业环境提供了参考；4）建立了可扩展的数字化口述历史模型，可供未来类似项目借鉴。

title: AI-Powered Continuous Health Monitoring for Early Disease Detection:A Proposed Framework for Proactive Healthcare

detail.title: AI-Powered Continuous Health Monitoring for Early Disease Detection:A Proposed Framework for Proactive Healthcare

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares that there are no known financial or personal relationships with any individuals or organizations that could have appeared to influence the work reported in this paper.
declarations.funderStatement: This research did not receive any specific grant from funding agencies in the public, commercial, or not-for-profit sectors.

detail.abstract:
Background: The global healthcare system operates predominantly in a reactive modepatients seek medical attention only after symptoms become clinically significant. This delay results in preventable mortality and morbidity across major disease categories including cardiovascular disease, type 2 diabetes, neurological disorders, and respiratory conditions. 

Objective: To propose a comprehensive, ethically grounded framework for AI-driven continuous health monitoring that enables early detection of disease-indicative physiological anomalies before clinical symptom onset. 

Methods: We conducted a narrative review of existing literature on wearable health monitoring, AI-based clinical diagnostics, federated learning for healthcare, and health notification systems. Based on identified evidence and gaps, we designed a four-layer system architecture comprising: 1. passive multimodal sensing, 2. data fusion and personalized baseline construction, 3. AI-based anomaly detection and risk scoring, and 4. tiered intelligent notification with care navigation integration. 

Results: We present a detailed system architecture incorporating wearable devices, smart home sensors, and smartphone-based passive monitoring. A personalized baseline approachcomputing individual Z-score deviations rather than population norms-is proposed to reduce false positives. Disease-specific detection models are outlined for six priority conditions. A phased four-stage research roadmap spanning ten years is described, with defined metrics for clinical validation. 

Conclusions: The convergence of ubiquitous sensing, advanced machine learning, and connectivity infrastructure creates a viable pathway toward proactive healthcare. The proposed framework addresses key gaps in existing systems including personalization, multimodal fusion, equity, and care integration. A structured research agenda is proposed to validate and deploy this framework at clinical and population scale.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一个基于AI的连续健康监测框架，通过可穿戴设备和智能家居传感器实现疾病早期检测，采用个性化基线减少误报，并制定了十年研究路线图。
AI.research_question: 如何构建一个全面、伦理基础的AI驱动连续健康监测框架，在临床症状出现前早期检测疾病指示性生理异常？
AI.motivation: 当前全球医疗系统主要采用被动反应模式，患者仅在症状明显时才就医，导致心血管疾病、2型糖尿病、神经系统疾病和呼吸系统疾病等主要疾病类别中可预防的死亡率和发病率增加。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于可穿戴健康监测、AI临床诊断、医疗联邦学习和健康通知系统的现有文献，构建四层系统架构：被动多模态感知、数据融合与个性化基线构建、AI异常检测与风险评分、分层智能通知与护理导航集成。
AI.method: 进行叙事性文献综述，分析现有可穿戴健康监测、AI临床诊断、医疗联邦学习和健康通知系统的证据与差距，设计四层系统架构。
AI.findings: 提出了详细系统架构，包含可穿戴设备、智能家居传感器和基于智能手机的被动监测；采用个性化基线方法（计算个体Z分数偏差而非群体标准）减少误报；为六种优先疾病制定了特异性检测模型；描述了跨越十年的四阶段研究路线图，并定义了临床验证指标。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了一个全面的AI驱动连续健康监测理论框架，整合了被动多模态感知、个性化基线构建、AI异常检测和分层通知系统，为从被动医疗向主动预防的范式转变提供了理论基础。
AI.practical_contributions: 提供了可实施的四层系统架构设计；提出了减少误报的个性化基线方法；为六种优先疾病开发了具体检测模型；制定了十年研究路线图和临床验证指标，为实际部署提供了明确路径。

detail.abstract: This positional paper argues that contemporary high-stakes educational assessment has collapsed ontologically, epistemologically, methodologically, ethically, and politically, reducing learning to a measurable commodity and reinforcing inequality. The authors contend that assessment is “beyond repair” in its current form and call for its rebirth as a Digital Public Good: open, participatory, and symbiotic with teaching and learning. They propose five principles: assessment-infused learning, continuous multimodal evaluation, learning-based accountability, teachers as assessment designers, and open digital governance, to reposition assessment as a relational, ethical, and sovereign infrastructure that promotes equity, feedback, and collective improvement.

AI.tldr: 这篇立场论文认为当代高风险教育评估在存在论、认识论、方法论、伦理和政治层面都已崩溃，将学习简化为可测量商品并加剧不平等。作者主张当前形式的评估已"无法修复"，呼吁将其重生成数字公共产品：开放、参与式、与教学共生。他们提出五项原则：评估融入学习、持续多模态评估、基于学习的问责、教师作为评估设计者、开放数字治理，以将评估重新定位为促进公平、反馈和集体改进的关系性、伦理性和主权性基础设施。
AI.research_question: 当代高风险教育评估存在哪些根本性问题？如何将评估重新构想为促进教育公平和集体改进的数字公共产品？
AI.motivation: 当前教育评估系统已崩溃，将学习简化为可测量商品，加剧教育不平等，需要根本性变革。
AI.theoretical_framework: 批判教育理论、数字公共产品理论、评估的社会政治维度理论、教育公平理论
AI.method: 立场论文/理论分析（批判性分析当代评估系统并提出重构框架）
AI.findings: 当代高风险教育评估在存在论、认识论、方法论、伦理和政治五个层面都已崩溃，需要根本性重构。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了评估作为数字公共产品的理论框架，发展了评估的五个崩溃维度的分析框架，建立了评估重构的五项原则理论。
AI.practical_contributions: 为教育政策制定者、评估设计者和教师提供了具体的重构原则：评估融入学习、持续多模态评估、基于学习的问责、教师作为评估设计者、开放数字治理。

detail.abstract:
The built environment remains anchored in linear models of extraction, construction and disposal, exposing organisations to growing regulatory, resource and transition risks. This paper argues that the next phase of transformation lies in catalytic circular business models – designed not merely to reduce waste, but to realign incentives, capital flows and governance structures across ecosystems.

Drawing on industry cases including Wienerberger and the Kalundborg industrial symbiosis, we identify three circular business model archetypes, the forces accelerating their adoption, and the structural barriers that trap initiatives in pilot stages. We define five catalytic scaling conditions and present corresponding tools and playbooks to operationalise them.

With the built environment responsible for nearly 40% of total carbon emissions, circular strategies are no longer a sustainability choice – they are a strategic imperative. The central challenge is no longer proof of concept, but scale. This paper provides a structured framework for executives, policymakers and investors to move from isolated pilots to system-level circular value creation.

AI.tldr: 该论文探讨建筑环境中的循环商业模式，识别三种原型、加速因素和障碍，提出五种催化规模化条件及相应工具，帮助从试点转向系统级循环价值创造。
AI.research_question: 建筑环境中的循环商业模式如何从试点阶段规模化到系统级价值创造？
AI.motivation: 建筑环境占全球碳排放近40%，线性模式面临监管、资源和转型风险，循环策略已成为战略必需而非可持续性选择。
AI.theoretical_framework: 循环经济理论、商业模式创新、生态系统治理、激励结构理论、价值创造理论。
AI.method: 基于行业案例研究（包括Wienerberger和Kalundborg工业共生案例），识别模式、因素和障碍。
AI.findings: 识别了三种循环商业模式原型，加速其采用的力量，将举措困在试点阶段的结构性障碍，以及五种催化规模化条件。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了催化循环商业模式理论框架，定义了从试点到系统级规模化的理论条件，丰富了循环经济在建筑环境中的应用理论。
AI.practical_contributions: 为高管、政策制定者和投资者提供结构化框架、工具和操作手册，帮助从孤立试点转向系统级循环价值创造。

title: On-site Adaptive Innovation from the Perspective of Abstractness and Control Structure: A Comparative Study of Integrated Models in the Semiconductor and Robotics Industries
affiliations: Independent

detail.title: On-site Adaptive Innovation from the Perspective of Abstractness and Control Structure: A Comparative Study of Integrated Models in the Semiconductor and Robotics Industries

declarations.ethicsApproval: This study did not involve human participants or animals, and therefore ethics approval was not required. This paper is based solely on publicly available information and does not include any confidential or proprietary data.

detail.abstract: This study examines how On-site Adaptive Innovation (OAI) manifests differently in the semiconductor and robotics industries, using Abstractness and Control Structure as the main analytical dimensions. The semiconductor industry, characterized by high abstractness, addresses design–constraint conflicts through dual integration: horizontal heterogeneous integration of components (GPU, HBM, etc.) and vertical orchestration across the supply chain, with leadership shifting toward packaging-based integration capabilities. In contrast, the robotics industry, constrained by low abstractness and real-time safety requirements, achieves adaptivity through distributed control and middleware-centered cooperation within a tri-polar structure, where solution providers play a central role in knowledge assetization and orchestration. By comparing these pathways, the study highlights the symmetrical yet distinct mechanisms of OAI across industries and argues that future industrial leadership will depend not on single-product performance but on the assetization of field knowledge and intelligent IP.

AI.tldr: 本研究比较了半导体和机器人行业中现场适应性创新（OAI）的不同表现机制，发现半导体行业通过高抽象度和供应链垂直协调实现创新，而机器人行业则通过分布式控制和中间件合作实现适应性，未来产业领导力将取决于现场知识的资产化和智能知识产权。
AI.research_question: 现场适应性创新（OAI）在半导体和机器人行业中如何以不同的方式表现出来？
AI.motivation: 理解不同行业中适应性创新的差异化机制，揭示未来产业领导力的关键决定因素。
AI.theoretical_framework: 以抽象度和控制结构为主要分析维度，构建现场适应性创新的理论框架。
AI.method: 比较案例研究，分析半导体和机器人两个行业的创新机制差异。
AI.findings: 半导体行业通过高抽象度、水平异质集成（GPU、HBM等）和供应链垂直协调实现创新，领导力向封装集成能力转移；机器人行业受低抽象度和实时安全要求限制，通过分布式控制、中间件合作和三极结构实现适应性，解决方案提供商在知识资产化和协调中发挥核心作用。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了现场适应性创新的对称但差异化机制理论，扩展了产业创新研究的分析维度。
AI.practical_contributions: 为企业提供行业特定的创新策略指导，指出未来产业竞争的关键在于现场知识的资产化和智能知识产权管理，而非单一产品性能。

title: Fundamental Dilemmas: Why Cognitive Security Cannot Be Absolute

detail.title: Fundamental Dilemmas: Why Cognitive Security Cannot Be Absolute
detail.abstract: Cognitive security confronts three structural dilemmas that can be neither ignored nor definitively resolved. The first sets the protection of the informational space against freedom of expression: any act of filtering or moderation entails a trade-off between censorship and vulnerability, with no objective threshold capable of resolving it. The second creates tension between defensive effectiveness and available resources: exhaustive verification is the theoretical gold standard, but its cognitive and economic cost renders it physically impossible at the scale of contemporary information flows. The third, perhaps the most fundamental, concerns the adversarial dynamic between defence and adaptation: any protection system creates a signature that attackers learn to circumvent, engaging an arms race with no stable end state. This article demonstrates that these three dilemmas are not independent-they feed one another in vicious cycles that render each partial attempt at resolution self-defeating. Faced with this reality, strategic maturity does not consist in seeking a non-existent optimal solution, but in composing defensive portfolios with complementary profiles, modulating equilibria according to threat levels, and investing in innovations capable of shifting the boundaries of the possible. Cognitive security is a process of continuous management, not a destination.

AI.tldr: 认知安全面临三个结构性困境：信息保护与言论自由的权衡、防御效果与资源的矛盾、防御与攻击的对抗性动态。这些困境相互强化形成恶性循环，无法彻底解决。战略成熟在于构建互补防御组合、根据威胁水平调整平衡、投资创新技术，将认知安全视为持续管理过程而非最终目标。
AI.research_question: 认知安全面临哪些结构性困境？这些困境如何相互关联并形成恶性循环？面对这些无法彻底解决的困境，应采取何种战略方法？
AI.motivation: 认知安全领域存在看似无法解决的结构性困境，传统寻求最优解决方案的方法往往适得其反。需要重新思考如何在这些困境中制定有效的战略。
AI.theoretical_framework: 结构性困境理论、权衡分析理论、对抗性动态理论、资源约束理论、系统思维理论
AI.method: 概念分析、逻辑推理、困境识别与关联分析、战略框架构建
AI.findings: 识别出三个核心困境：1)信息保护与言论自由的权衡困境；2)防御效果与资源约束的矛盾；3)防御系统与攻击者适应的对抗性动态。这些困境相互强化形成恶性循环，使任何部分解决方案都适得其反。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了认知安全的结构性困境理论框架，揭示了困境间的相互强化机制，挑战了寻求最优解决方案的传统思维，提出了"持续管理过程"的新范式。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者和安全从业者提供了战略指导：构建互补防御组合、根据威胁水平动态调整平衡、投资创新技术、接受认知安全是持续管理过程而非最终目标。

title: Research Note-Breaking Bad Email Habits: Bounding the Impact of Simulated Phishing Campaigns
affiliations: University of Pittsburgh - Katz Graduate School of Business, Pamplin College of Business, University of Illinois at Chicago and University of Pittsburgh - Management Information Systems

detail.title: Research Note-Breaking Bad Email Habits: Bounding the Impact of Simulated Phishing Campaigns
detail.abstract: Simulated phishing campaigns are among the most widely deployed tools for reducing organizational cyber risk. Yet the behavioral data these campaigns produce have an underappreciated structural feature and a resulting complication: because training is triggered by clicking, the very employees who receive intervention are those Teachable-moment design features also matter: emotion or heuristic framing and explicit reporting pitch can largely eliminate persistence, while annotated-email cues modestly exacerbate it. Finally, employees who engage with the education page still exhibit greater persistence than those who dismiss it, consistent with an emboldening mechanism in consequence-free training environments. We contribute to the IS security literature, methodologically, by integrating MSMs and CRE into a portable analytical framework that any organization with standard phishing-simulation platform logs can apply; and practically, by identifying specific education-design levers and strategies for managing a phishing-test paradox in organizations, so that they can more effectively design, sequence, and evaluate their simulated phishing programs.

AI.tldr: 该研究分析了模拟钓鱼训练中的"可教时刻"设计特征，发现点击触发训练的员工往往是最需要培训但最不可能从培训中受益的人群。研究识别了能减少持续点击行为的有效设计特征，并提出了管理钓鱼测试悖论的组织策略。
AI.research_question: 模拟钓鱼训练中的"可教时刻"设计特征如何影响员工的后续安全行为？如何解决点击触发训练导致的"钓鱼测试悖论"？
AI.motivation: 模拟钓鱼训练是减少组织网络安全风险最广泛使用的工具，但其产生的行为数据存在结构性特征和复杂问题：由于培训由点击触发，那些最需要培训的员工（点击者）往往是最不可能从培训中受益的人群，形成了"钓鱼测试悖论"。
AI.theoretical_framework: 可教时刻理论、行为安全理论、启发式决策框架、强化学习理论
AI.method: 整合边际结构模型(MSMs)和因果风险估计(CRE)的分析框架，应用于标准钓鱼模拟平台日志数据
AI.findings: 1. 情感或启发式框架和明确的报告提示能显著减少持续点击行为；2. 带注释的邮件线索会轻微加剧持续点击；3. 参与教育页面的员工比直接关闭页面的员工表现出更高的持续点击率，这与无后果训练环境中的"壮胆机制"一致。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 将MSMs和CRE整合为可移植的分析框架，为IS安全文献提供方法论贡献；2. 深化了对"可教时刻"设计特征如何影响安全行为的理论理解；3. 提出了钓鱼测试悖论的理论解释机制。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 识别了具体的教育设计杠杆；2. 提供了管理钓鱼测试悖论的组织策略；3. 帮助组织更有效地设计、排序和评估模拟钓鱼项目。

title: Is There (Still) Anybody Out There? Online Forums in the Age of Generative AI
affiliations: and Ludwig Maximilian University of Munich (LMU) - Faculty of Business Administration (Munich School of Management)

detail.title: Is There (Still) Anybody Out There? Online Forums in the Age of Generative AI
detail.abstract: Generative artificial intelligence is reshaping how individuals search for information and solve problems. For decades, online forums, particularly in technical and programming communities, have served as core infrastructure for decentralized knowledge production. We study how the diffusion of generative AI affects participation, question complexity, and solution quality in such communities, and whether governance structures moderate AI-driven substitution. Using a decade-long panel of posts and traffic data, we compare Statalist, a real-name forum, with pseudonymous platforms (Stack Overflow and Stack Exchange's Cross Validated) around the introduction of ChatGPT in November 2022. We combine activity measures with large-scale textual analyses, including an LLM-based complexity taxonomy and a benchmark comparison between community answers and a standardized "AI expert" proposal. We find that posting activity declines across platforms, but less sharply in the non-anonymous setting. At the same time, the share of high-complexity questions increases more strongly on Statalist, suggesting that AI primarily displaces routine problem solving while communities retain a comparative advantage in complex, context-rich discussions. However, more recent data indicate that this resilience may be transitional rather than permanent. Overall, our results suggest that governance shapes how the division of labor between humans and AI evolves in digital knowledge communities.

AI.tldr: 生成式AI（特别是ChatGPT）的出现减少了在线技术论坛的参与度，但实名制论坛（Statalist）比匿名平台（Stack Overflow等）受影响较小。AI主要替代了常规问题解答，而社区在复杂、情境丰富的问题上仍保持比较优势，但这种韧性可能是暂时的。治理结构影响了人类与AI在数字知识社区中的分工演变。
AI.research_question: 生成式AI的扩散如何影响在线技术论坛的参与度、问题复杂性和解答质量？治理结构是否调节了AI驱动的替代效应？
AI.motivation: 生成式AI正在重塑信息搜索和问题解决方式，而在线技术论坛作为去中心化知识生产的核心基础设施已存在数十年。需要理解AI如何影响这些社区，以及治理结构在其中扮演的角色。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于数字知识社区、去中心化知识生产、人机分工理论，探讨治理结构（实名制vs匿名制）对AI替代效应的调节作用。
AI.method: 使用十年期的面板数据，比较实名制论坛（Statalist）与匿名平台（Stack Overflow和Cross Validated）在ChatGPT推出前后的变化。结合活动指标和大规模文本分析，包括基于LLM的复杂性分类，以及社区答案与标准化"AI专家"建议的基准比较。
AI.findings: 1. 所有平台的发帖活动都下降，但实名制论坛下降幅度较小；2. 实名制论坛中高复杂性问题的比例增加更多；3. AI主要替代了常规问题解答，社区在复杂、情境丰富的讨论中保持比较优势；4. 近期数据表明这种韧性可能是过渡性的而非永久性的。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 揭示了治理结构在调节AI对数字知识社区影响中的重要作用；2. 提出了人机分工在知识生产中的动态演变理论；3. 区分了AI对不同类型问题（常规vs复杂）的替代效应差异。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为在线社区管理者设计治理机制以应对AI挑战提供指导；2. 帮助社区成员理解AI时代的知识生产角色定位；3. 为技术平台优化人机协作提供实证依据。

title: Generative AI and Worker Productivity: A Systematic Review and Quantitative Evidence Synthesis (2023-2026)

detail.title: Generative AI and Worker Productivity: A Systematic Review and Quantitative Evidence Synthesis (2023-2026)

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares no competing interests, financial relationships, or conflicts of interest that could have influenced this study. No external funding was received.
declarations.ethicsApproval: This study is a systematic review and quantitative evidence synthesis of publicly available published research. No human participants were directly involved. Ethics approval was not required.
declarations.funderStatement: This research received no external funding.

detail.abstract: The only study using nationally representative administrative records-tracking 25,000 workers across two years following the public release of ChatGPT-finds a confidence interval ruling out earnings effects larger than two percent, yet controlled experiments conducted over the same period report productivity improvements of 14 to 55 percent. Resolving this empirical paradox is the central aim of this systematic review and quantitative evidence synthesis of studies examining generative artificial intelligence (GenAI) tools and worker productivity. Following Preferred Reporting Items for Systematic Reviews and Meta-Analyses (PRISMA) 2020 guidelines, a systematic search of six databases identified 60 records; after removing three duplicates, 57 unique records were screened, yielding 11 empirical studies spanning 2023 to 2026 with a combined participant total of 269,138. The sample-size-weighted mean productivity improvement was 20.9 percent. The observed range across positive-effect studies was 3.6 to 55.8 percent. Across six studies reporting experience-level moderation, 83 percent found greater gains for less experienced workers; the largest real-world observational study reversed this pattern specifically within production software development. A Task-Expertise-Measurement (TEM) Framework is proposed as a falsifiable candidate framework to reconcile observed heterogeneity, grounded in cognitive load theory and the expertise reversal effect, with seven falsifiable hypotheses advanced for the next research cycle.

AI.tldr: 这篇系统综述通过分析11项实证研究（共269,138名参与者）发现，生成式AI工具平均带来20.9%的生产力提升，但效果存在显著异质性。研究提出TEM框架来解释观察到的差异，特别是经验水平对AI工具效果的调节作用。
AI.research_question: 如何解释生成式AI工具对工人生产力影响的实证悖论？即为什么全国代表性行政记录显示效果有限（小于2%），而同期控制实验报告了14-55%的生产力提升？
AI.motivation: 现有关于生成式AI工具对工人生产力影响的研究存在矛盾：一项使用全国代表性行政记录的研究发现效果很小（小于2%），而同期控制实验报告了显著的生产力提升（14-55%）。这种实证悖论需要系统性的解释和整合。
AI.theoretical_framework: 认知负荷理论、专业知识逆转效应、任务-专业知识-测量（TEM）框架。TEM框架作为一个可证伪的候选框架，用于解释观察到的异质性。
AI.method: 遵循PRISMA 2020指南的系统综述和定量证据综合。系统检索了六个数据库，识别出60条记录，筛选后得到11项实证研究（2023-2026年），共269,138名参与者。
AI.findings: 样本量加权的平均生产力提升为20.9%。积极效果研究的观察范围为3.6%至55.8%。在报告经验水平调节的六项研究中，83%发现经验较少的工人获益更大；但最大的现实世界观察性研究（生产软件开发）反转了这一模式。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了任务-专业知识-测量（TEM）框架作为可证伪的候选框架，基于认知负荷理论和专业知识逆转效应，提出了七个可证伪的假设供下一研究周期验证。
AI.practical_contributions: 为组织提供了关于生成式AI工具部署的实证依据，强调了任务类型、工人经验和测量方法对效果的影响，有助于更有效地实施AI工具并管理期望。

title: The Budapest Convention on Cybercrime and its Influence on EU Legal Frameworks on Cyber defence, Cybersecurity and Information Threats vis-à-vis Fundamental Rights: A Commentary
affiliations: Independent

detail.title: The Budapest Convention on Cybercrime and its Influence on EU Legal Frameworks on Cyber defence, Cybersecurity and Information Threats vis-à-vis Fundamental Rights: A Commentary

declarations.ethicsApproval: Non
declarations.funderStatement: Non

detail.abstract: The Budapest Convention on Cybercrime (the Convention), the first international treaty addressing cybercrime, has significantly shaped EU legal frameworks by promoting harmonized criminal laws, procedural tools, and cross-border cooperation. This paper provides comprehensive background research on the Convention's impact on EU cybercrime policy, examining its historical context, legal framework, influence on EU legislation, and challenges related to fundamental rights and implementation. A literature review synthesizes key scholarship, incorporating global and non-EU perspectives, while case studies and Europol data highlight practical implications.

AI.tldr: 该论文全面分析了《布达佩斯网络犯罪公约》对欧盟网络犯罪政策的影响，包括历史背景、法律框架、对欧盟立法的影响、基本权利挑战和实施问题。
AI.research_question: 《布达佩斯网络犯罪公约》如何影响欧盟网络犯罪政策框架？其历史背景、法律框架、对欧盟立法的影响、基本权利挑战和实施问题是什么？
AI.motivation: 《布达佩斯网络犯罪公约》作为首个国际网络犯罪条约，对欧盟法律框架产生了深远影响，但需要系统分析其具体影响机制、挑战和实践意义。
AI.theoretical_framework: 国际法协调理论、欧盟法律一体化理论、网络犯罪治理理论、基本权利保护理论。
AI.method: 文献综述（综合全球和非欧盟视角的关键学术研究）、案例研究、Europol数据分析。
AI.findings: 公约通过促进统一的刑法、程序工具和跨境合作，显著塑造了欧盟法律框架；但在基本权利保护和实施方面存在挑战。
AI.theory_contributions: 深化了国际条约对区域法律体系影响的理论理解，拓展了网络犯罪治理的多层次分析框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 为欧盟网络犯罪政策制定者提供实施指导，识别基本权利保护的关键挑战，促进更有效的跨境执法合作。

title: Conceptual And Jurisprudential Framework Of Legal Protection In Eu Digitalisation
affiliations: Independent

detail.title: Conceptual And Jurisprudential Framework Of Legal Protection In Eu Digitalisation

declarations.declarationOfInterest: Independent
declarations.funderStatement: Non

detail.abstract: The conceptual and jurisprudential or legal theories including juridical perspectives provide a comprehensive, logical and practical understanding of the judicial decisions and the ratio decidendi of the Court's digital rights protection mechanism. Understanding theoretical underpinnings provides a more nuanced comprehension of the issues militating against legal protection of persons, groups and institutions in the EU digitalization.

AI.tldr: 该论文从概念、法理学和法律理论角度，包括司法视角，对法院数字权利保护机制的司法决策和判决理由提供了全面、逻辑和实用的理解。理解理论基础有助于更细致地理解欧盟数字化进程中阻碍个人、团体和机构法律保护的问题。
