detail.abstract: This paper presents a comprehensive business case and technical framework for establishing a Global Quantum Risk Remediation Programme within a regulated financial institution. It outlines the full scope of Phase 1 activities, including cryptographic discovery, development of a Cryptographic Bill of Materials (CBOM), vendor and supply‑chain assessment, actuarial modelling, and regulatory exposure analysis. The work integrates current global regulatory requirements, emerging quantum‑enabled threat vectors such as Harvest Now Decrypt Later (HNDL) and Harvest Now Forge Later (HNFL), and the structural deficit between cryptographic migration timelines and projected quantum‑capability horizons. The framework is non‑prescriptive and sector‑agnostic, supporting organisations seeking to meet operational resilience obligations, strengthen cryptographic governance, and prepare for quantum‑safe transition across complex digital estates.

reference: Virginia Public Law and Legal Theory Research Paper(forthcoming); Berkeley Technology Law Journal (2027)
title: Against Transparency

detail.title: Against Transparency

publicationDetails.detailsText: Virginia Public Law and Legal Theory Research Paper(forthcoming)
publicationDetails.journalName: University of Virginia Public Law & Legal Theory Research Paper Series

detail.abstract: Contemporary regulation of artificial intelligence is dominated by a powerful intuition: that the risks posed by opaque machine learning systems can be mitigated through transparency. This Article challenges that intuition. Drawing on both legal and computer science literature on explainable AI, it argues that transparency is not only technologically unrealistic for most modern AI systems but also conceptually mismatched with the kinds of accountability that law actually demands. What law requires is not wholesale visibility into complex models, but targeted, causal explanations that connect specific processes to specific outcomes in legally salient ways. The Article begins by disaggregating the "black box" problem of AI into distinct forms of opacity-interactive, semantic, and procedural-and demonstrates that only a narrow subset of these implicates law: when potentially harmful processes are causally linked to harmful outcomes, a problem that law has confronted for centuries. Against this backdrop, the Article offers a sustained critique of the transparency-centered framework underlying much AI regulation, including the European Union's Artificial Intelligence Act and many state laws, including several in California alone. It shows that extensive documentation and disclosure mandates reflect an undifferentiated conception of transparency that will fail to provide either meaningful explanations or effective accountability. By contrast, the Article develops an explanation-centered regulatory model grounded in three features common to both legal reasoning and human explanatory practice: selectivity, comparison, and interactivity. Finally, the Article bridges legal theory and computer science by examining the capabilities and limits of contemporary explainable AI techniques and suggesting specific ways that computer science and law can inform each other for more effective AI regulation. The Article concludes that effective AI regulation must abandon transparency as a governing principle and instead embrace explanation as a regulatory paradigm.

AI.tldr: 本文挑战了AI监管中"透明度能解决黑箱问题"的主流观点，认为透明度既技术不可行又与法律问责需求不匹配，提出应转向以解释为中心的监管范式。
AI.research_question: AI监管中的透明度原则是否能有效解决机器学习系统的问责问题？如果不是，什么替代监管范式更符合法律需求？
AI.motivation: 当前AI监管过度依赖透明度直觉，但这种方法既技术不现实又与法律问责的实际需求脱节，需要重新思考监管框架。
AI.theoretical_framework: 1) AI不透明性的三种类型：交互性、语义性、程序性；2) 法律问责与因果解释理论；3) 解释性AI的法律与技术交叉理论。
AI.method: 跨学科文献分析（法学与计算机科学），概念分析，批判性法律分析，比较法分析（欧盟AI法案、加州法律等）。
AI.findings: 1) 透明度原则技术不可行且概念错配；2) 法律需要的是针对性、因果性解释而非全面可见性；3) 当前透明度监管框架无效；4) 解释性监管应具备选择性、比较性和交互性特征。
AI.theory_contributions: 1) 解构AI黑箱问题的理论框架；2) 解释性监管范式理论；3) 法学与计算机科学交叉理论；4) 批判透明度中心主义的理论框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 1) 为AI监管提供替代框架；2) 具体解释性监管设计建议；3) 跨学科合作路径；4) 对欧盟AI法案等现有法规的改进建议。

title: Viability Precedes Authority: The Law of Viability and the Technical Leadership Matrix

detail.title: Viability Precedes Authority: The Law of Viability and the Technical Leadership Matrix
detail.abstract: We propose the Viability Law as a guiding principle for software engineering in the AI-driven era of abundant code production: value does not come from execution volume, but from the precision of Intention and the sustainability of Design. Building on this postulate, we introduce the IDO paradigm (Intention, Design, and Orchestration) and suggest an effectiveness measure (E s = I × (D + O)) to make explicit the shift of the bottleneck from code writing to decision-making. Finally, we present the Technical Leadership Matrix (2×2), which structures the tension between time-to-market and technical quality, defines a Convergence Point, and characterizes four operational zones (Excellence, High Performance, Innovation, and Crisis), guiding leadership interventions to preserve viability and prevent entropy.

AI.tldr: 论文提出"生存性法则"作为AI时代软件工程的指导原则，强调价值来自意图精准度和设计可持续性而非代码量。引入IDO范式（意图、设计、编排）和有效性度量公式Es=I×(D+O)，将瓶颈从编码转向决策。提出技术领导力矩阵（2×2）来管理上市时间与技术质量之间的张力。

title: Liquidity and Financial Stability: Structural Conditions for Endogenous Systemic Risk

detail.title: Liquidity and Financial Stability: Structural Conditions for Endogenous Systemic Risk
detail.abstract: Modern financial systems are characterized by increasing complexity, innovation, and structural interdependence. In these modern financial systems, liquidity is commonly regarded as a stabilizing force that enhances capital allocation, risk-sharing, and market efficiency. However, historical episodes of the financial crisis challenge this view, demonstrating that under specific structural conditions, liquidity can contribute to systemic fragility and market collapse. This paper examines the role of liquidity in financial stability and analyzes the structural conditions under which it transitions from a stabilizing mechanism to a source of endogenous risk amplification. Particular attention is given to balance sheet leverage, volatility dynamics, interconnectedness, and feedback mechanisms within financial markets. Drawing on the theoretical frameworks of Diamond and Dybvig (1983), Minsky's Financial Instability Hypothesis, and the macro-financial model of Brunnermeier and Sannikov (2011), the paper argues that liquidity is conditionally stabilizing, with its effects determined by underlying market architecture and institutional constraints. By identifying the structural determinants that transform liquidity into a channel of instability, this research advances the theoretical understanding of systemic risk and financial stability.

AI.tldr: 该论文探讨了流动性在金融稳定中的双重角色：在正常情况下是稳定机制，但在特定结构条件下会转变为系统性风险的放大器。
AI.research_question: 流动性在什么结构条件下会从金融稳定机制转变为系统性风险的来源？
AI.motivation: 传统观点认为流动性是金融稳定的积极因素，但金融危机历史表明流动性在某些条件下会加剧系统性风险，需要深入理解这种转变的结构条件。
AI.theoretical_framework: Diamond和Dybvig（1983）的银行挤兑模型、明斯基的金融不稳定假说、Brunnermeier和Sannikov（2011）的宏观金融模型。
AI.method: 理论分析框架，结合历史金融危机案例，分析资产负债表杠杆、波动性动态、互联性和反馈机制等结构条件。
AI.findings: 流动性是条件性稳定因素，其效果取决于市场结构和制度约束；特定结构条件（如高杠杆、强互联性、正反馈机制）会使流动性转变为系统性风险的传导渠道。
AI.theory_contributions: 推进了对系统性风险和金融稳定的理论理解，识别了流动性从稳定机制转变为风险放大器的结构决定因素。
AI.practical_contributions: 为监管机构和政策制定者提供了识别和防范流动性风险转化为系统性风险的结构条件，有助于设计更稳健的金融体系。

detail.abstract: As a critical enabler of global commerce, the maritime industry is under increasing pressure to significantly reduce its greenhouse gas (GHG) emissions in line with international climate objectives. Currently, shipping accounts for nearly 3% of the world's total emissions, positioning decarbonization as not just a regulatory obligation, but also an ethical and economic necessity. Recognizing this, the International Maritime Organization (IMO) has set ambitious climate goals-most notably, a commitment to cut GHG emissions from ships by at least 50% by 2050 compared to 2008 levels (International Maritime Organization [IMO], 2023). Meeting this target will require a sweeping transformation, including a shift toward low-and zero-carbon fuels such as hydrogen, ammonia, methanol, and next-generation biofuels. Moreover, the adoption of cleaner propulsion technologies, enhanced energy efficiency systems, and more sustainable operational practices will be crucial. This paper delves into the technological innovations, regulatory frameworks, and economic implications of maritime decarbonization, highlighting the importance of global coordination, consistent policy support, and active stakeholder engagement to achieve a just and sustainable energy transition in the shipping sector.

detail.title: When Privacy Protects but Excludes: The Costs and Benefits of Privacy Regulation in Credit Markets

publicationDetails.detailsText: Olin Business School Center for Finance & Accounting Research Paper No. 2026/01
publicationDetails.journalName: Washington University in St. Louis Olin Business School Center for Finance & Accounting Research Paper Series

detail.abstract: This paper studies the consequences of privacy regulation by exploiting Google’s 2019 restriction on CDR access for a major Indian FinTech lender. We show that this intervention reflects a key policy trade-off in digital credit markets: strengthened privacy protections raise loan applications, consistent with higher demand, yet simultaneously induce tighter screening, reflecting an overall contraction in credit supply. This credit contraction disproportionately excludes economically and socially marginalized applicants. Linking to economy-wide credit bureau records, we quantify the "FinTech ladder effect'" whereby initial digital credit access serves as a gateway to broader formal credit. Privacy-induced rejection reduces the probability of obtaining any formal credit by 13.7 percentage points even four years later. Using a structural model, we decompose the welfare effects of privacy regulation and show that the regulation generates a 0.53% increase in consumer surplus and reduces lender profits by 15%.

AI.tldr: 该研究利用谷歌2019年对印度金融科技贷款机构CDR访问的限制，分析隐私监管的后果。研究发现隐私保护提高了贷款申请（需求增加），但导致更严格的筛选（信贷供应收缩），这种收缩不成比例地排除了经济和社会边缘化申请人。隐私导致的拒绝使获得任何正式信贷的概率降低13.7个百分点，即使四年后也是如此。监管使消费者剩余增加0.53%，但使贷款机构利润减少15%。
AI.research_question: 隐私监管对数字信贷市场的影响是什么？特别是，隐私保护措施如何影响信贷需求、信贷供应、信贷获取不平等以及消费者福利？
AI.motivation: 随着数字信贷市场的快速发展，隐私监管成为重要政策议题。然而，隐私保护措施可能带来意想不到的后果，特别是在信贷获取方面。需要理解隐私监管如何影响信贷市场的供需平衡，以及这种影响在不同社会经济群体中的分布。
AI.theoretical_framework: 数字信贷市场中的隐私-信贷权衡理论；信贷筛选理论；金融包容性理论；消费者福利分析框架；结构模型分析框架
AI.method: 利用谷歌2019年对印度金融科技贷款机构CDR访问限制的自然实验；将数据与全国范围的信贷局记录链接；使用结构模型分解隐私监管的福利效应
AI.findings:
1. 隐私保护提高了贷款申请（需求增加），但导致更严格的筛选（信贷供应收缩）
2. 信贷收缩不成比例地排除了经济和社会边缘化申请人
3. 隐私导致的拒绝使获得任何正式信贷的概率降低13.7个百分点（即使四年后）
4. 存在"金融科技阶梯效应"：初始数字信贷获取是通往更广泛正式信贷的门户
5. 监管使消费者剩余增加0.53%，但使贷款机构利润减少15%
AI.theory_contributions:
1. 提出了数字信贷市场中隐私监管的权衡理论框架
2. 发展了"金融科技阶梯效应"概念，解释数字信贷如何作为正式信贷获取的入口
3. 为隐私监管的福利效应分析提供了结构模型方法
4. 深化了对信贷市场不平等机制的理解
AI.practical_contributions:
1. 为政策制定者提供了隐私监管对信贷市场影响的实证证据
2. 揭示了隐私监管可能加剧信贷获取不平等的风险
3. 提供了评估隐私政策福利效应的量化工具
4. 为金融科技公司和监管机构提供了平衡隐私保护与金融包容性的参考

title: Child Tax Credit Purchasing Power and Short-Term Changes in Parental Time Allocation: Evidence from American Time Use Data
affiliations: Texas A&M University - Texas A&M University, Texarkana, Central Washington University and Rockhurst University

detail.title: Child Tax Credit Purchasing Power and Short-Term Changes in Parental Time Allocation: Evidence from American Time Use Data
detail.abstract: The Child Tax Credit (CTC) provides financial relief to families with children, yet little is known about how this policy shapes parental time allocation. This study investigates the effect of the 2017 CTC expansion using a difference-indifferences framework. Because the CTC provides a uniform dollar amount regardless of where families live, its practical value varies geographically: the same credit goes further in counties where childcare is relatively affordable than where it consumes a large share of household income. We exploit this variation in the credit's real purchasing power to identify behavioral responses to the reform. Drawing on the American Time Use Survey (2008-2021), we find that parents in counties where the credit provided greater financial relief reduce their involvement in childcare and household tasks while gaining leisure time. This pattern is especially pronounced among mothers, who show significant reductions in basic caregiving activities such as feeding and bathing, alongside meaningful gains in socializing. Importantly, educational and recreational parent-child interactions remain unaffected, suggesting limited consequences for children's cognitive development. Heterogeneity analyses indicate that the estimated reduction in parent-child time is most prominent among Hispanic parents, those without a college degree, and low-income families, with implications for the design of child-focused transfer programs.

AI.tldr: 2017年美国儿童税收抵免（CTC）扩张对父母时间分配的影响研究。研究发现，在儿童保育相对便宜的地区，CTC的实际购买力更强，导致父母（尤其是母亲）减少儿童基本照料和家务时间，增加休闲时间，但教育性亲子互动不受影响。
AI.research_question: 儿童税收抵免（CTC）政策如何影响父母的时间分配？具体来说，2017年CTC扩张对父母在儿童照料、家务、休闲和亲子互动方面的时间分配产生了什么影响？
AI.motivation: 虽然儿童税收抵免为有孩子的家庭提供了经济援助，但该政策如何影响父母的时间分配尚不清楚。了解这一影响对于评估儿童相关转移支付项目的设计效果至关重要。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于经济学中的时间分配理论，特别是家庭生产理论和劳动力供给理论。研究假设CTC通过增加家庭收入影响父母的时间分配决策，同时考虑到不同地区儿童保育成本的差异导致CTC实际购买力的地理差异。
AI.method: 采用双重差分法（difference-in-differences）分析2017年CTC扩张的影响。利用CTC统一金额但各地儿童保育成本不同导致的实际购买力差异作为识别策略。数据来源为美国时间使用调查（2008-2021年）。
AI.findings: 1. 在儿童保育相对便宜的地区（CTC实际购买力更强），父母减少儿童照料和家务时间，增加休闲时间；2. 母亲的影响尤为显著，在喂养、洗澡等基本照料活动上减少时间，社交时间增加；3. 教育和娱乐性亲子互动不受影响；4. 异质性分析显示，西班牙裔父母、无大学学历家庭和低收入家庭的亲子时间减少最为明显。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 首次系统研究CTC政策对父母时间分配的影响；2. 揭示了转移支付政策通过影响家庭时间分配而产生的行为反应；3. 为理解家庭生产函数中收入效应和时间替代效应提供了实证证据；4. 拓展了儿童相关福利政策评估的理论框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为政策制定者设计儿童相关转移支付项目提供实证依据；2. 表明CTC扩张主要影响基本照料活动而非教育性互动，减轻了对儿童认知发展的担忧；3. 识别出受影响最大的群体（西班牙裔、低教育、低收入家庭），有助于精准政策设计；4. 强调了考虑地区生活成本差异在福利政策设计中的重要性。

title: An Olympic Opportunity
affiliations: University of Cambridge, Cambridge Judge Business School, Yale University and

detail.title: An Olympic Opportunity
detail.abstract: We use a unique natural experiment in which families were randomly selected to live in the Olympic Village, constructed for the 2004 Athens Olympic Games, to assess the impact of improved neighborhood conditions on academic achievement. Comparing 12-17-year-old students who relocated and attended the new schools with non-selected applicants from the same origin schools across Attica, we find a positive, gender-neutral, and significant effect of moving on overall performance. Educational gains, primarily in language courses, are concentrated among students who previously performed poorly, indicating a "fresh start" effect.

AI.tldr: 利用2004年雅典奥运会奥运村建设的自然实验，研究发现改善社区条件对青少年学业成绩有积极影响，特别是对先前成绩较差的学生有"重新开始"效应。
AI.research_question: 改善社区条件对青少年学业成绩有何影响？
AI.motivation: 理解社区环境改善对教育成果的影响，为城市发展和教育政策提供实证依据。
AI.theoretical_framework: 社区环境与教育成果关系理论，"重新开始"效应理论，邻里效应理论。
AI.method: 利用2004年雅典奥运会奥运村建设的自然实验，采用随机分配家庭到奥运村的实验设计，比较搬迁学生与未搬迁申请者的学业成绩。
AI.findings: 搬迁对学业成绩有积极、性别中立且显著的正向影响；教育收益主要集中在语言课程；先前成绩较差的学生受益最大，表现出"重新开始"效应。
AI.theory_contributions: 为邻里效应理论提供实证支持，验证"重新开始"效应在教育环境中的作用，深化对社区环境与教育成果关系的理解。
AI.practical_contributions: 为城市更新和教育政策提供依据，支持通过改善社区环境来提升教育公平，特别是对弱势学生的支持。

title: Frequent Stress Tests
affiliations: Indiana University - Kelley School of Business - Department of Business Economics & Public Policy,  and Tsinghua University - PBC School of Finance

detail.title: Frequent Stress Tests
detail.abstract: Bank supervisors employ stress tests and disclose valuable information about banks to the stakeholders. Such tests are also conducted frequently. A credible stress test design must incorporate the stakeholders' strategic responses to test results and ensure that a bank that passes a stress test does not subsequently fail, even under the most adverse equilibrium. To study credible stress tests, we analyze bank run as a canonical regime change game under incomplete information and asynchronous moves. We find that a higher testing frequency reduces the need for stricter test stringency to maintain credibility. We then characterize the optimal credible stress test policy and demonstrate its dependence on model primitives.

AI.tldr: 本文研究银行压力测试的可信性设计，分析如何在考虑利益相关者策略性反应的情况下，确保通过压力测试的银行不会在后续失败。研究发现更高的测试频率可以减少对严格测试标准的需求。
AI.research_question: 如何设计可信的银行压力测试政策，确保通过测试的银行不会在后续失败？
AI.motivation: 银行监管机构使用压力测试并向利益相关者披露银行信息，但现有测试设计未充分考虑利益相关者对测试结果的策略性反应，可能导致通过测试的银行仍会失败。
AI.theoretical_framework: 不完全信息和异步移动下的银行挤兑作为典型制度变迁博弈（canonical regime change game）
AI.method: 博弈论分析，建立不完全信息和异步移动下的银行挤兑模型，分析压力测试频率与严格性的权衡关系
AI.findings: 更高的测试频率可以减少维持可信性所需的测试严格程度；最优可信压力测试政策取决于模型的基本参数
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了可信压力测试的理论框架，将利益相关者的策略性反应纳入测试设计，建立了测试频率与严格性的权衡关系
AI.practical_contributions: 为监管机构设计可信的压力测试政策提供指导，帮助平衡测试频率与严格性，确保银行系统的稳定性

title: Sanctuary Cities and the Wages of Native Workers: A Difference-in-Difference Analysis
affiliations: University of Concepción - Escuela de Administración y Negocios, Xinjiang University and University of Florida

detail.title: Sanctuary Cities and the Wages of Native Workers: A Difference-in-Difference Analysis
detail.abstract: Sanctuary cities are municipal jurisdictions that limit cooperation with federal immigration enforcement, creating "sanctuaries" for undocumented immigrants. Despite widespread concern that such policies may depress native workers' wages by attracting a disproportionate share of likely-undocumented immigrants (LUIs), there is little empirical evidence on the question. Using a difference in-difference framework, individual-level data from the American Community Survey (2010-2019), and the residual method to identify LUIs, this paper estimates the effect of sanctuary status on the log hourly wage of native workers across skill cells defined by education and experience. Contrary to a priori expectations, sanctuary status has no significant effect on native workers' wages including for the least skilled-across a wide range of specifications and robustness checks.

AI.tldr: 研究发现，庇护城市政策对本地工人的工资没有显著影响，包括对最低技能工人群体，这与预期相反。
AI.research_question: 庇护城市政策是否会影响本地工人的工资水平？
AI.motivation: 尽管普遍担忧庇护城市政策可能通过吸引更多可能无证移民而压低本地工人工资，但缺乏实证证据支持这一假设。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于移民对劳动力市场影响的经济学理论，特别是关于移民对本地工人工资影响的经典理论框架。
AI.method: 使用双重差分法，结合美国社区调查（2010-2019）的个体层面数据，采用残差法识别可能无证移民，分析庇护城市状态对不同教育经验技能组本地工人对数小时工资的影响。
AI.findings: 与预期相反，庇护城市状态对本地工人工资没有显著影响，包括对最低技能工人群体，这一结果在各种规格和稳健性检验中都成立。
AI.theory_contributions: 挑战了关于庇护城市政策会通过吸引移民而压低本地工人工资的传统假设，为移民政策对劳动力市场影响的讨论提供了新的实证证据。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供了实证依据，表明庇护城市政策可能不会对本地工人工资产生负面影响，有助于更理性地评估移民政策的劳动力市场效应。

title: Ch 5: Federal Jurisdiction and the Impact Assessment Act: Trojan Horse or Rational Ecological Accounting? in M. Doelle, A. J. Sinclair, eds., The Next Generation of Impact Assessment: A Critical Review of the Canadian Impact Assessment Act (Toronto: Irwin Law, 2021) at 97
affiliations: West Coast Environmental Law

detail.title: Ch 5: Federal Jurisdiction and the Impact Assessment Act: Trojan Horse or Rational Ecological Accounting? in M. Doelle, A. J. Sinclair, eds., The Next Generation of Impact Assessment: A Critical Review of the Canadian Impact Assessment Act (Toronto: Irwin Law, 2021) at 97
detail.abstract: Federal jurisdiction over impact assessment (IA) remains unsettled, despite the 1992 case Friends of the Oldman River Society v Canada (Minister of Transport). This seminal case provided much-needed guidance on the extent of federal power to assess the impacts of proposed undertakings that were federally regulated or under federal constitutional authority. However, the case left important questions unanswered respecting the extent of federal authority at the triggering, information-gathering and analysis, and decision-making stages of assessment. By taking the bold step from environmental assessment (EA) to an IA model that considers a broader range of positive and negative environmental, social, health and economic effects and their distribution, the Impact Assessment Act (IAA) has raised new questions about the limits of federal jurisdiction to carry out assessments of proposed undertakings or activities covered by the Act. This chapter explores key questions respecting federal jurisdiction with regard to the IAA, beginning with a discussion of the constitutional division of powers in Canada, federalism and Canada’s political constitution, and the cooperative federalism model that has gained traction in the courts in recent decades. Having set out the federalism context, it then lays out the key issues respecting federal jurisdiction over project-level assessment, and examines the IAA in light of relevant case law and the academic literature. In doing so, it analyses federal jurisdiction in three distinct stages of IA: triggering, information gathering and analysis, and decision making.

AI.tldr: 本文探讨加拿大《影响评估法》下联邦管辖权问题，分析联邦在影响评估三个阶段的权力范围：触发、信息收集与分析、决策。
AI.research_question: 在加拿大《影响评估法》框架下，联邦政府在影响评估的三个阶段（触发、信息收集与分析、决策）的管辖权范围是什么？
AI.motivation: 尽管1992年"Friends of the Oldman River Society v Canada"案提供了指导，但联邦在影响评估中的管辖权仍不明确。《影响评估法》从环境评估扩展到更广泛的影响评估，引发了新的管辖权问题。
AI.theoretical_framework: 加拿大宪法分权原则、联邦主义理论、政治宪法理论、合作联邦主义模型。
AI.method: 法律分析：基于宪法分权原则，结合相关判例法和学术文献，分析《影响评估法》在三个评估阶段的管辖权问题。
AI.findings: 联邦管辖权在影响评估的三个阶段存在不同限制：触发阶段需基于联邦宪法权力；信息收集阶段权力较宽；决策阶段受联邦主义原则约束。
AI.theory_contributions: 为理解加拿大联邦在影响评估中的管辖权提供了系统分析框架，澄清了合作联邦主义模型在环境治理中的应用。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者、法律从业者和项目开发者提供关于《影响评估法》下联邦权力范围的明确指导，有助于减少法律不确定性。

title: Rebalancers and the Cross-Asset Transmission of Expectations Shocks
affiliations: Federal Housing Finance Agency, University of California, Berkeley and University of California, Berkeley

detail.title: Rebalancers and the Cross-Asset Transmission of Expectations Shocks
detail.abstract: We quantify how investors that implement automatic rebalancing transmit return expectations shocks across assets. We estimate a model of country-level asset portfolios, capturing expected returns based on professional forecasts. In the model, rebalancers dampen the impact of a 1 percentage point U.S. equity return expectations shock on U.S. equity prices by 40 basis points and amplify the impact on U.S. long-term debt prices by 52 basis points. Additionally, rebalancers transmitted the 8.3 percentage point observed increase in equity return expectations during 2021 to an 8 basis point decrease in long-term debt yields.

AI.tldr: 该研究量化了自动再平衡投资者如何将回报预期冲击在不同资产间传导。研究发现，再平衡者会减弱美国股票回报预期冲击对股票价格的影响，但会放大对长期债券价格的影响。
AI.research_question: 自动再平衡投资者如何在不同资产间传导回报预期冲击？
AI.motivation: 理解投资者行为如何影响资产价格传导机制，特别是自动再平衡策略对跨资产价格联动的影响。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于投资组合再平衡理论，分析预期回报冲击在不同资产类别间的传导机制。
AI.method: 建立国家层面资产组合模型，利用专业预测数据估计预期回报，量化再平衡行为的影响。
AI.findings: 再平衡者将1个百分点的美国股票回报预期冲击对美国股票价格的影响减弱40个基点，但对美国长期债券价格的影响放大52个基点。2021年观察到的8.3个百分点股票回报预期增加通过再平衡者传导，导致长期债券收益率下降8个基点。
AI.theory_contributions: 提供了自动再平衡行为如何影响跨资产价格传导的理论框架，揭示了投资者行为在资产定价中的重要作用。
AI.practical_contributions: 帮助投资者和政策制定者理解再平衡策略对市场稳定的影响，为资产配置决策提供实证依据。

title: Inclusion and Empowerment in Education: Ensuring the Needs and Opportunities for Migrant Students
affiliations: University of Kerala

detail.title: Inclusion and Empowerment in Education: Ensuring the Needs and Opportunities for Migrant Students
detail.abstract: The study explores the inclusive education and empowerment of migrant students from India with a specific focus on the trend in Indian student migration abroad, the barriers they encounter and the strategies needed to address them. The study aims to examine the lived experience of Indian students' education in foreign countries. The scope of this research is limited to the educational aspects and exclusively considers Indian students who migrated abroad for academic purposes. The study adopted a descriptive and qualitative approach connected with secondary data sources, including policy documents, academic literature and institutional reports. By examining the existing evidence, the research highlights the key challenges migrant students face and effective measures for promoting inclusive and equitable education to empower migrant students. The findings revealed that the migration of Indian students to OECD countries has been increasing steadily due to the expansion of higher education and global mobility opportunities. But the migrant students face obstacles that may hinder their academic success and well-being. Inadequate institutional support, cultural differences, language barriers, etc., are the persistent issues they face. Hike in cost of living, political and economic uncertainty of host countries, and limited access to job opportunities create a hindrance in international education. Structured educational inclusion measures are necessary for facing these challenges. Key strategies, including implementing multilingual support programs, can reduce the language barrier. Through better peer and mentoring networks, social integration can be improved. Adopting culturally responsive teaching methods can validate diverse backgrounds and learning styles. Such initiatives can enhance academic outcomes and personally empower them. These practices promote the equity, resilience and engagement in their host institutions. A practical approach to promote inclusive education for migrant learners can benefit from academic pursuits and contribute positively to host countries.

AI.tldr: 该研究探讨了印度移民学生的包容性教育和赋权问题，重点关注印度学生海外留学趋势、面临的障碍及应对策略。研究发现印度学生赴OECD国家留学人数持续增长，但面临制度支持不足、文化差异、语言障碍、生活成本上升等问题。研究提出多语言支持、同伴网络、文化响应教学等策略来促进包容性教育。
AI.research_question: 印度学生在海外接受教育的生活体验是怎样的？他们面临哪些障碍？需要哪些策略来促进包容性教育和赋权？
AI.motivation: 随着印度学生海外留学人数持续增长，了解他们在异国他乡的教育体验、面临的挑战以及如何通过包容性教育策略来支持他们的学术成功和个人发展具有重要意义。
AI.theoretical_framework: 包容性教育理论、跨文化教育理论、学生赋权理论、教育公平理论
AI.method: 采用描述性和质性研究方法，基于政策文件、学术文献和机构报告等二手数据进行分析
AI.findings:
1. 印度学生赴OECD国家留学人数因高等教育扩张和全球流动机会增加而稳步增长
2. 移民学生面临制度支持不足、文化差异、语言障碍等持续问题
3. 生活成本上升、东道国政治经济不确定性、就业机会有限构成国际教育障碍
4. 多语言支持、同伴指导网络、文化响应教学等策略能有效促进包容性教育
AI.theory_contributions:
1. 丰富了跨文化教育背景下包容性教育的理论框架
2. 深化了对移民学生赋权机制的理解
3. 为教育公平理论在跨国教育环境中的应用提供了实证基础
AI.practical_contributions:

2. 为政策制定者设计包容性教育政策提供参考

title: Income Mobility of the Top One Percent
affiliations: Board of Governors of the Federal Reserve System and Joint Committee on Taxation

detail.title: Income Mobility of the Top One Percent

publicationDetails.detailsText: Finance and Economics Discussion Series, issue 2026-015, 2026[10.17016/FEDS.2026.015]

publicationDetails.journalName: Board of Governors: Finance & Economics Discussion Series (Topic)

detail.abstract: Circulation into and out of the top one percent is pronounced in the U.S. One third exit after a year and two-thirds exit after a decade. This mobility lowers top income shares when shifting from annual to multi-year income measures. Intragenerational mobility over two decades lowers recent top one percent fiscal income shares by over 10 percent. Two-decade mobility reduces top 0.1% shares by over 20 percent, top 0.01% shares by 30 percent, and top 0.001% shares by 40 percent. Effects of variability on wealth inequality are similar in magnitude, although more modest as a share of top wealth inequality.

AI.tldr: 美国顶层1%收入群体流动性显著，三分之一一年后退出，三分之二十年后退出。这种流动性使得从年度收入转向多年收入衡量时，顶层收入份额下降。二十年内的代内流动性使近期顶层1%财政性收入份额降低超过10%，对更顶层群体（0.1%、0.01%、0.001%）的份额降低效应更显著（20%-40%）。财富不平等中的变异性效应类似，但相对影响较小。
AI.research_question: 美国顶层收入群体的代内流动性程度如何？这种流动性如何影响长期收入不平等衡量？
AI.motivation: 现有收入不平等研究多基于年度收入数据，忽略了个人在收入分布中的流动性。理解顶层收入群体的流动性对于准确衡量长期不平等和政策制定至关重要。
AI.theoretical_framework: 代内流动性理论、收入不平等衡量方法、持久收入与暂时收入区分、顶层收入动态变化理论
AI.method: 使用多年收入数据追踪个人在收入分布中的位置变化，分析从年度收入转向多年收入衡量时顶层收入份额的变化，比较不同时间跨度的流动性效应
AI.findings:
1. 美国顶层1%收入群体流动性显著：三分之一一年后退出，三分之二十年后退出
2. 代内流动性显著降低顶层收入份额：二十年流动性使顶层1%份额降低超过10%
3. 流动性效应随收入层级升高而增强：顶层0.1%份额降低超过20%，0.01%降低30%，0.001%降低40%
4. 财富不平等中的变异性效应类似，但相对影响较小
AI.theory_contributions:
1. 提供了顶层收入群体代内流动性的实证证据
2. 揭示了年度收入衡量可能高估长期不平等程度
3. 建立了流动性对不同收入层级影响的量化关系
4. 扩展了收入不平等研究的时际维度
AI.practical_contributions:
1. 为政策制定者提供更准确的不平等衡量方法
2. 表明顶层收入群体的高流动性可能缓解对极端不平等的担忧
3. 建议使用多年收入数据评估税收和福利政策效果
4. 为财富不平等研究提供方法论参考

title: The Practice of U.S. Monetary Policy Independence from Martin to Greenspan
affiliations: Board of Governors of the Federal Reserve System

detail.title: The Practice of U.S. Monetary Policy Independence from Martin to Greenspan

keywords: Board of Governors of the Federal Reserve System (U.S.)

publicationDetails.detailsText: Finance and Economics Discussion Series, issue 2026-014, 2026[10.17016/FEDS.2026.014]

publicationDetails.journalName: Board of Governors: Finance & Economics Discussion Series (Topic)

detail.abstract: Central bank independence is a major area of study, but the economic literature has been characterized by numerous misstatements regarding how U.S. monetary policy independence has operated over time. Against this backdrop, this paper lays out major elements of the practice of central bank independence in the United States in the period from 1951 to 2006—a time span that encompasses the William McChesney Martin, Jr., through Alan Greenspan tenures as the head of the Federal Reserve. Many documentary materials and policymaker quotations not considered in previous research on U.S. monetary policy are highlighted. The analysis covers both institutional aspects (statutory objectives, formalities of Federal Reserve structure, and conventions followed in regularizing the central bank’s interactions with the legislative and executive branches) and the conceptual basis for independence, as expressed by leading Federal Reserve officials, particularly Chairs. It is shown—with heavy reliance on their own words—how Federal Reserve Chairs have characterized the position of the central bank within the governmental structure of the United States and how they have set out the case for monetary policy independence. What emerges is that successive Chairs over the decades made essentially the same, three-part, economic case for independence. This case does not rely on the arguments associated with economic research on time inconsistency.

AI.tldr: 本文通过分析1951-2006年间美联储主席的言论和文件，揭示了美国央行独立性的实践特点，发现历任主席都提出了基本相同的三部分经济论证来支持独立性，这些论证与时间不一致性理论无关。
AI.research_question: 美国央行独立性在实践中是如何运作的？历任美联储主席如何论证货币政策的独立性？
AI.motivation: 现有文献对美国货币政策独立性的运作存在诸多误解，需要基于实际历史文件和决策者言论来澄清央行独立性的实践特点。
AI.theoretical_framework: 央行独立性理论，特别是时间不一致性理论，但本文发现美联储主席的实际论证与此不同。
AI.method: 历史文献分析，研究1951-2006年间（从马丁到格林斯潘时期）的文件材料、决策者言论和制度安排。
AI.findings: 历任美联储主席都提出了基本相同的三部分经济论证来支持独立性，这些论证不依赖于时间不一致性理论；同时揭示了央行独立性在制度实践中的具体运作方式。
AI.theory_contributions: 挑战了传统央行独立性理论（特别是时间不一致性理论）的适用性，提出了基于实践的三部分经济论证框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 为理解美国央行独立性的实际运作提供了历史视角，有助于政策制定者和研究者更准确地把握央行与政府关系的实质。

title: Cryptoasset Ecosystem in Latin America and the Caribbean
affiliations: University of Cambridge, Judge Business School, Cambridge Centre for Alternative Finance, Students, , ,  and University of Cambridge, Judge Business School, Cambridge Centre for Alternative Finance, Students

detail.title: Cryptoasset Ecosystem in Latin America and the Caribbean

publicationDetails.detailsText: Cambridge Centre for Alternative Finance Research Paper No. 53
publicationDetails.journalName: Cambridge Centre for Alternative Finance (CCAF) Research Paper Series

detail.abstract:
The Cambridge Centre for Alternative Finance, in partnership with the Inter-American Development Bank, conducted a comprehensive study on the cryptoasset landscape in Latin America and the Caribbean (LAC) throughout 2022. This research initiative encompassed surveys, interviews, and extensive data collection from key stakeholders within the LAC cryptoasset ecosystem. The overarching goal was to gain valuable insights into its growth trajectory, prevalent market trends, existing challenges, and potential opportunities, while also delving into the regulatory and policy dimensions.

The methodology employed in this study was twofold, involving targeted surveys conducted online over the period of June to August 2022. The private sector survey was directed at companies actively engaged in cryptoasset-related activities across LAC, yielding a total of 52 responses. Complementing this, the public sector survey was tailored for institutions responsible for overseeing and regulating the LAC cryptoasset domain. Additionally, in-depth interviews were conducted with some of the largest cryptoasset firms in LAC to augment both qualitative and quantitative data. Furthermore, data from sources such as the Cambridge Fintech Ecosystem Atlas (Atlas) and the Cambridge Bitcoin Electricity Consumption Index (CBECI) were leveraged. Secondary resources, including legal documents, central bank releases, and industry reports, were also tapped to provide robust contextualisation and augment the primary findings. In totality, data was sourced from over 80 public and private institutions across the LAC region.

AI.tldr: 剑桥替代金融中心与美洲开发银行合作，对2022年拉丁美洲和加勒比地区的加密资产格局进行了全面研究，通过调查、访谈和数据收集分析了该地区加密生态系统的发展轨迹、市场趋势、挑战机遇及监管政策。
AI.research_question: 拉丁美洲和加勒比地区加密资产生态系统的现状、发展趋势、面临的挑战和机遇是什么？该地区的监管政策环境如何影响加密资产的发展？
AI.motivation: 随着加密资产在全球范围内的快速发展，拉丁美洲和加勒比地区作为新兴市场，其加密生态系统的发展轨迹、市场动态和监管环境缺乏系统性研究。了解该地区的具体情况对于政策制定者、行业参与者和投资者都具有重要意义。
AI.theoretical_framework: 本研究基于金融科技生态系统理论、监管政策分析框架和新兴市场金融创新理论，结合加密资产发展的特定背景，构建了分析拉丁美洲和加勒比地区加密资产生态系统的综合框架。
AI.method: 采用混合研究方法：1）2022年6-8月在线调查（私营部门52家公司，公共部门监管机构）；2）深度访谈（LAC地区最大的加密资产公司）；3）剑桥金融科技生态系统地图和比特币电力消耗指数数据；4）法律文件、央行公告和行业报告等二手资料；总计覆盖80多家公私机构。
AI.findings: 研究发现拉丁美洲和加勒比地区加密资产生态系统呈现快速增长态势，但面临监管不确定性、技术基础设施不足等挑战。同时，该地区在金融包容性、跨境支付等方面存在显著机遇。监管政策呈现多样化特征，不同国家采取了不同的监管立场。
AI.theory_contributions: 本研究为新兴市场加密资产生态系统的发展提供了实证基础，丰富了金融科技在发展中国家应用的理论框架，为理解监管政策对加密资产发展的影响提供了区域性的案例研究。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供了制定加密资产监管政策的参考依据；为行业参与者提供了市场进入和业务发展的战略指导；为投资者提供了区域风险评估和市场机会分析；为学术研究提供了拉丁美洲和加勒比地区加密资产的系统性数据。

title: Integrating Stress Testing and Risk Appetite within a Risk-Based Supervision Framework: Towards a Unified Supervisory Architecture
affiliations: Central Bank of Bahrain

detail.title: Integrating Stress Testing and Risk Appetite within a Risk-Based Supervision Framework: Towards a Unified Supervisory Architecture
detail.abstract: Risk-based supervision (RBS) frameworks in central banks increasingly rely on stress testing and risk appetite frameworks (RAF) as core supervisory tools. However, these instruments often operate as parallel processes with limited structural integration, creating supervisory blind spots in capital planning, risk rating methodologies, and macroprudential calibration. This article examines the fragmentation problem and proposes a unified supervisory architecture that embeds stress testing outcomes into risk appetite calibration, supervisory risk ratings, Pillar 2 capital addons, and early warning systems. Drawing on international practices from the Basel Committee, European Central Bank's Supervisory Review and Evaluation Process (SREP), Federal Reserve's Comprehensive Capital Analysis and Review (CCAR), Bank of England's Prudential Regulation Authority (PRA), Monetary Authority of Singapore (MAS), and Office of the Superintendent of Financial Institutions (OSFI), the article develops a five-layer integration model that transforms stress testing from a compliance exercise into a dynamic supervisory tool. Particular attention is given to implementation challenges in emerging markets and small open economies, including data constraints, concentrated banking systems, and limited modeling capacity. The article concludes with actionable policy recommendations for central bank supervisors seeking to operationalize stress-appetite integration within proportionate, forward-looking supervisory frameworks suitable for diverse institutional contexts and systemic risk profiles.

AI.tldr: 本文探讨了央行风险监管框架中压力测试与风险偏好框架的碎片化问题，提出了一个五层整合模型，将压力测试结果嵌入风险偏好校准、监管风险评级、第二支柱资本附加和早期预警系统，使压力测试从合规性工具转变为动态监管工具。
AI.research_question: 如何解决央行风险监管框架中压力测试与风险偏好框架的结构性整合不足问题，以消除监管盲点并提升监管有效性？
AI.motivation: 当前央行风险监管框架中，压力测试和风险偏好框架往往作为平行流程运行，缺乏结构性整合，导致在资本规划、风险评级方法和宏观审慎校准等方面存在监管盲点，影响监管效果。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于巴塞尔委员会、欧洲央行SREP、美联储CCAR、英国PRA、新加坡MAS和加拿大OSFI等国际监管实践，构建了一个整合压力测试与风险偏好框架的理论框架，强调从合规性工具向动态监管工具的转变。
AI.method: 采用比较分析和案例研究方法，分析国际监管机构的实践，开发了一个五层整合模型，并特别关注新兴市场和小型开放经济体的实施挑战。
AI.findings: 提出了一个统一的监管架构，将压力测试结果嵌入风险偏好校准、监管风险评级、第二支柱资本附加和早期预警系统，使压力测试成为动态监管工具。识别了新兴市场在数据约束、银行系统集中和建模能力有限等方面的实施挑战。
AI.theory_contributions: 发展了风险监管整合理论，提出了压力测试与风险偏好框架的结构性整合模型，为央行监管框架的理论发展提供了新视角，特别是在不同制度环境和系统性风险特征下的适应性应用。
AI.practical_contributions: 为央行监管者提供了可操作的政策建议，包括具体的整合实施路径、针对新兴市场的适应性方案，以及在不同制度环境下实施比例性、前瞻性监管框架的实用指导。

title: The Effects of the War on Ukraine on Global Corporate Investment
affiliations: Board of Governors of the Federal Reserve System, , Board of Governors of the Federal Reserve System and Board of Governors of the Federal Reserve System, Board of Governors of the Federal Reserve System

detail.title: The Effects of the War on Ukraine on Global Corporate Investment

publicationDetails.journalName: Board of Governors: International Finance Discussion Papers (Topic)

detail.abstract: We study the investment effects of the Russia-Ukraine war using a novel, text-based measure of firm-level exposure derived from earnings call transcripts. Combining this measure with financial statement data for over 6,500 firms across 50 countries, we show that exposure to the conflict led to sizable and persistent declines in corporate investment. Firms that discussed the war in early 2022 invested significantly less than otherwise similar firms. The results hold across multiple empirical strategies and highlight the role of geopolitical risk in shaping firm behavior during global crises.

AI.tldr: 使用基于财报电话会议文本分析的新方法，研究发现俄乌战争对全球企业投资产生了显著负面影响，暴露于冲突的企业投资大幅下降
AI.research_question: 俄乌战争如何影响企业投资决策？企业层面的冲突暴露度如何影响其投资行为？
AI.motivation: 理解地缘政治风险在全球危机期间对企业行为的影响，特别是俄乌战争这一重大地缘政治事件的经济后果
AI.theoretical_framework: 地缘政治风险理论、不确定性下的企业投资决策理论、文本分析在金融研究中的应用
AI.method: 基于财报电话会议文本构建企业层面的战争暴露度指标，结合50个国家超过6,500家企业的财务数据，采用多种实证策略进行分析
