title: From Malthus to Solow and Back: Land Scarcity and the Return of Ricardo

detail.title: From Malthus to Solow and Back: Land Scarcity and the Return of Ricardo
detail.abstract:
Three macroeconomic regularities of the post-1980 period a declining labour share, a rising wealth-to-income ratio concentrated in land-related assets, and a slowdown in aggregate productivity growth have attracted largely separate literatures. This paper establishes all three as formal propositions within a single framework: a nested CES growth model in which land and the capital-labour aggregate are gross complements (σ < 1). When the effective growth rate of land per capita falls below labour productivity growth (g 2-n < g 1), a neo-Malthusian regime emerges, and the three regularities follow as necessary theoretical consequences, independently of specific parameter values.

The paper derives four propositions and a corollary characterizing the regime. A motivational calibration to United States data confirms that the regime conditions are satisfied at plausible values: σ = 0.759, robust across the admissible range of the capital share. The conventional two-factor model predicts an increase of 13 percentage points in the observed wealth-to-income ratio between 1970 and 2010 against 53 observed; the neo-Malthusian model finds an upper bound of 84 points. Among the implications, the most directly testable is the time-varying wage elasticity with respect to population: zero in the Solow regime and growing in magnitude as land's share rises. At calibrated values it increased from-0.14 in 1970 to-0.26 in 2023, consistent with the evolution from null findings to negative estimates in the immigration literature. The framework generates the falsifiable prediction that future studies should find progressively larger effects, correlated with land supply constraints across cities and countries.

AI.tldr: 本文建立了一个统一框架解释后1980年代的三个宏观经济规律：劳动份额下降、财富收入比上升（集中在土地相关资产）、以及总生产率增长放缓。通过嵌套CES增长模型，当人均土地有效增长率低于劳动生产率增长时，会出现新马尔萨斯体制，这三个规律成为必然的理论结果。
AI.research_question: 如何在一个统一的理论框架中解释后1980年代出现的三个宏观经济规律：劳动份额下降、财富收入比上升（集中在土地相关资产）、以及总生产率增长放缓？
AI.motivation: 后1980年代出现的三个宏观经济规律（劳动份额下降、财富收入比上升、生产率增长放缓）在现有文献中通常被分开研究，缺乏统一的理论解释框架。
AI.theoretical_framework: 嵌套CES增长模型，其中土地与资本-劳动总合是总互补关系（σ < 1）。当人均土地有效增长率低于劳动生产率增长时，出现新马尔萨斯体制。
AI.method: 理论推导四个命题和一个推论来刻画新马尔萨斯体制的特征，并对美国数据进行校准验证（σ = 0.759）。比较传统两要素模型与新马尔萨斯模型的预测能力。
AI.findings: 1）新马尔萨斯模型能更好地解释财富收入比的变化（预测上限84个百分点，实际53个百分点，传统模型仅13个百分点）；2）工资对人口的弹性随时间变化，从1970年的-0.14增加到2023年的-0.26，与移民文献的实证发现一致；3）模型预测未来研究应发现越来越大的效应，且与城市和国家的土地供给约束相关。
AI.theory_contributions: 1）首次将三个宏观经济规律统一在一个理论框架中；2）提出新马尔萨斯体制作为解释机制；3）推导出可检验的预测，特别是工资对人口弹性的时变特征。
AI.practical_contributions: 1）为政策制定者理解土地约束对宏观经济的影响提供理论依据；2）为移民政策的经济效应分析提供新视角；3）为城市规划和土地管理政策提供宏观经济层面的启示。

title: How Energy System Developments Affect Elasticities in Day-Ahead Electricity Markets: Evidence from Bid Curves
affiliations: University of Groningen, ETH Zürich - KOF Swiss Economic Institute and

detail.title: How Energy System Developments Affect Elasticities in Day-Ahead Electricity Markets: Evidence from Bid Curves
detail.abstract: Since the liberalization of European electricity markets in the late 1990s, many aspects of the energy landscape have changed significantly. In this study, we investigate how the day-ahead electricity market has developed over time, and how these changes can be attributed to the growth of renewable generation, changes in fossil fuel prices and increased international integration. We do this using a rich dataset from the European Power Exchange, containing data on hourly bids that were submitted in the Dutch day-ahead market in the period 2006-2024. As proxy for the development in day-ahead markets we use the changes in the price elasticities of demand and supply. Our results show that both elasticities have decreased over time. The increase in the production of renewable electricity affected both demand and supply curves by changing the number of bids and the distribution of bid prices. However, only the elasticity of demand is clearly affected. We also show how an increase in fossil fuel prices results in higher elasticities, while the increased international integration negatively affect elasticities.

AI.tldr: 该研究分析了2006-2024年荷兰日前电力市场的发展，发现需求和供给的价格弹性均随时间下降。可再生能源增长、化石燃料价格变化和国际一体化是主要影响因素。
AI.research_question: 欧洲日前电力市场如何随时间发展？这些变化如何归因于可再生能源增长、化石燃料价格变化和国际一体化程度的提高？
AI.motivation: 自1990年代末欧洲电力市场自由化以来，能源格局发生显著变化，需要了解日前电力市场的发展轨迹及其驱动因素。
AI.theoretical_framework: 使用价格弹性作为日前市场发展的代理指标，分析市场结构变化。基于供需曲线理论，研究可再生能源、化石燃料价格和国际一体化对市场弹性的影响。
AI.method: 使用欧洲电力交易所2006-2024年荷兰日前市场的每小时投标数据，通过价格弹性变化分析市场发展，考察可再生能源发电、化石燃料价格和国际一体化对弹性的影响。
AI.findings: 1. 需求和供给的价格弹性均随时间下降；2. 可再生能源增长通过改变投标数量和价格分布影响供需曲线，但仅对需求弹性有明显影响；3. 化石燃料价格上涨导致弹性增加；4. 国际一体化程度提高对弹性产生负面影响。
AI.theory_contributions: 提供了电力市场动态发展的实证证据，深化了对可再生能源、化石燃料价格和国际一体化如何影响市场弹性的理论理解，为电力市场结构演变提供了新的分析框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者和市场参与者提供市场发展洞察，帮助理解可再生能源渗透对市场弹性的影响，为电力市场设计和监管提供实证依据，支持能源转型背景下的市场优化。

title: What if? Revisiting the macroeconomic impact of the energy crisis with peak-load electricity
affiliations: affiliation not provided to SSRN, affiliation not provided to SSRN and Paris School of Economics (PSE)

detail.title: What if? Revisiting the macroeconomic impact of the energy crisis with peak-load electricity
detail.abstract: Electricity generation presents distinctive modeling challenges due to the absence of storage, instantaneous demand-supply balancing requirements, and heterogeneous generation technologies with different cost structures. This paper addresses these challenges by incorporating a base--peak load structure into large-scale computable general equilibrium (CGE) models, offering a middle ground between detailed energy system models and multisectoral global economic frameworks. We first develop a transparent toy model inspired by Bachmann et al. (2024) to demonstrate that first-order approximations of cascading effects, following Hulten's theorem, are inadequate when shocks are large and elasticities of substitution are low. Building on the theoretical insights, we embed a base--peak structure into the MIRAGE CGE model, treating electricity as a Leontief production function between base load generation (coal, nuclear, hydro, and part of renewables) and peak load generation (gas, oil, and peak renewables). This refinement captures the merit order dispatch mechanism and bottleneck effects when peak generation is constrained. We apply the enhanced model to assess the 2022 Russian gas shock in Germany and the European Union. Our results demonstrate that the base--peak structure more accurately reproduces observed macroeconomic impacts compared to standard electricity representations, with significantly larger GDP and welfare losses particularly affecting energy-intensive industrial sectors, and less possible substitution from variable renewable energies. Theoretically, we show that third-order effects become important under conditions we explicitly identify, complementing recent findings on shock amplification in production networks. For policy, our findings highlight two key levers for responding to energy shocks: supply flexibility through storage and grid interconnection, and demand smoothing through dynamic pricing and interruptible contracts. The paper contributes methodologically by demonstrating how simplified yet realistic electricity representations can be integrated into global CGE frameworks without sacrificing the broader economic feedback mechanisms essential for policy analysis.

AI.tldr: 本文通过将基荷-峰荷结构整合到大规模可计算一般均衡模型中，改进了电力部门的建模方法，更准确地捕捉了电力系统的技术特性和瓶颈效应，并应用于评估2022年俄罗斯天然气冲击对德国和欧盟的影响。
AI.research_question: 如何将电力系统的基荷-峰荷结构有效整合到大规模可计算一般均衡模型中，以更准确地评估能源冲击的经济影响？
AI.motivation: 电力部门建模面临独特挑战：缺乏存储、需瞬时平衡供需、发电技术异质性。现有模型要么过于详细（能源系统模型），要么过于简化（多部门经济框架），缺乏中间解决方案。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于Bachmann等人的启发，构建透明玩具模型；应用Hulten定理分析级联效应；采用Leontief生产函数表示基荷和峰荷发电；考虑电力调度中的优先顺序机制和瓶颈效应。
AI.method: 1. 开发理论玩具模型验证大冲击下Hulten定理一阶近似的不足；2. 将基荷-峰荷结构嵌入MIRAGE CGE模型；3. 应用改进模型评估2022年俄罗斯天然气冲击对德国和欧盟的影响。
AI.findings: 1. 基荷-峰荷结构比标准电力表示更准确地再现了观测到的宏观经济影响；2. 德国和欧盟的GDP和福利损失显著更大；3. 能源密集型工业部门受影响最严重；4. 可变可再生能源的替代可能性较小；5. 明确识别了三级效应变得重要的条件。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 证明在大冲击和低替代弹性条件下，Hulten定理的一阶近似不足；2. 识别了三级效应变得重要的具体条件；3. 补充了生产网络中冲击放大的最新发现；4. 展示了简化但现实的电力表示如何整合到全球CGE框架中。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为应对能源冲击提供两个关键政策杠杆：通过存储和电网互联提高供应灵活性，通过动态定价和可中断合同平滑需求；2. 提供更准确的能源冲击评估工具；3. 帮助政策制定者理解不同部门受冲击的差异。

title: Moments, Distribution Functions, Densities, and Characteristic Functions: A Unified Mathematical Framework
affiliations: Artificial Intelligence in Finance Institute

detail.title: Moments, Distribution Functions, Densities, and Characteristic Functions: A Unified Mathematical Framework
detail.abstract: A probability distribution admits four equivalent representations: the cumulative distribution function, the probability density function, the characteristic function, and the sequence of moments. This paper develops, with complete proofs, every connection among these objects within the unified framework of Lebesgue-Stieltjes integration and classical Fourier analysis. The central results are the Lévy inversion theorem; the Fourier inversion of densities; and the moment-characteristic function correspondence, identified as a jetspace isomorphism intertwining convolution with formal series multiplication. The Hamburger determinacy condition is characterised via positive semidefiniteness of Hankel matrices and proved operator-theoretically through the spectral theorem. The Berry-Esséen theorem is established by characteristic function smoothing, yielding the sharp square-root-of-n central limit theorem rate with an explicit constant. The complex-analytic structure is developed in full: strip of analyticity, Cauchy-Riemann verification, contour deformation, the Esscher change of measure, and the Lugannani-Rice saddle-point formula. Derivative pricing via the Carr-Madan FFT and Lewis contour formulas is derived through Parseval-Plancherel duality. Four worked examples-Gaussian, Poisson, Cauchy, and Variance-Gamma-illustrate the framework, with the Variance-Gamma model yielding a closed-form result connecting excess kurtosis exactly to the normalised variance of the Gamma time-change.

AI.tldr: 本文在Lebesgue-Stieltjes积分和经典傅里叶分析的统一框架下，系统建立了概率分布的四种等价表示（累积分布函数、概率密度函数、特征函数、矩序列）之间的完整联系，并提供了完全证明。
AI.research_question: 概率分布的四种等价表示（累积分布函数、概率密度函数、特征函数、矩序列）之间如何建立完整的数学联系？
AI.motivation: 概率论中四种分布表示方法虽然等价，但缺乏在统一数学框架下的系统连接证明，需要建立完整的理论桥梁。
AI.theoretical_framework: Lebesgue-Stieltjes积分理论、经典傅里叶分析、复变函数理论、算子理论、谱定理、Hankel矩阵理论。
AI.method: 采用严格的数学分析方法，包括特征函数平滑技术、复解析结构开发、轮廓变形、Parseval-Plancherel对偶性等。
AI.findings: 建立了Lévy反演定理、傅里叶密度反演、矩-特征函数对应关系（识别为jetspace同构）；通过Hankel矩阵正半定性表征Hamburger确定性条件；建立了Berry-Esséen定理并获得最优收敛速率；开发了完整的复解析结构；推导了金融衍生品定价公式。
AI.theory_contributions: 在统一框架下系统建立了四种分布表示之间的完整数学联系；将矩-特征函数对应识别为jetspace同构；通过算子理论证明Hamburger确定性条件；建立了完整的复解析理论框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 提供了金融衍生品定价的Carr-Madan FFT和Lewis轮廓公式；通过四个实例（高斯、泊松、柯西、方差-伽马）展示了理论应用；方差-伽马模型给出了连接超额峰度与Gamma时间变化归一化方差的闭式结果。

title: Financial Information Practices as Determinants of SME Profitability: Evidence from a Developing Economy
affiliations: Institute of Management and Technology (IMT), Enugu

detail.title: Financial Information Practices as Determinants of SME Profitability: Evidence from a Developing Economy

declarations.declarationOfInterest: no personal or financial relationship with other people or organizations that may have or could be perceived to have influenced this study
declarations.ethicsApproval: This study involved the collection of primary data through structured questionnaires conducted with participants who were clearly informed about the objectives and purpose of the research. Participation was entirely voluntary, and informed consent was obtained from all respondents prior to their involvement in the study. Respondents were assured of the confidentiality and anonymity of their responses, and all data collected were handled with strict adherence to ethical standards. The study complied with relevant institutional and ethical guidelines for research involving human participants.
declarations.funderStatement: self

detail.abstract: In developing economies, the sustainability and competitive performance of small and medium enterprises (SMEs) are often linked to the quality of their financial management systems. This study investigated the relationship between financial information practices and SME profitability in a developing economy, with particular emphasis on SMEs operating in Abakaliki Metropolis, Ebonyi State, Nigeria. Specifically, the study examined the effects of financial record keeping, budgeting information, and cash flow information on profitability. A cross-sectional survey research design was adopted, and primary data were obtained from 290 SME owners and managers through structured questionnaires. The hypotheses were tested using simple linear regression analysis at a 5% significance level, while SWOT and PESTEL analyses were incorporated to provide contextual insight into internal and external business environments. The empirical results revealed that financial record keeping had no significant relationship with SME profitability (R = 0.006, R² = 0.000, F = 0.011, p = 0.917). Budgeting information similarly showed no significant effect (R = 0.006, R² = 0.000, F = 0.010, p = 0.919), and cash flow information did not significantly influence profitability (R = 0.061, R² = 0.004, F = 1.080, p = 0.299). Consequently, all null hypotheses were not rejected. The very low R² values indicate that financial information practices accounted for only a negligible proportion of variations in SME profitability. The study concludes that financial information practices were not statistically significant predictors of profitability among SMEs in the study area and recommends strengthened institutional support and broader capacity-building initiatives.

AI.tldr: 该研究调查了发展中国家中小企业财务信息实践与盈利能力的关系，发现财务记录、预算信息和现金流信息对盈利能力均无显著影响，建议加强制度支持和能力建设。
AI.research_question: 财务信息实践（财务记录、预算信息、现金流信息）如何影响发展中国家中小企业的盈利能力？
AI.motivation: 在发展中国家，中小企业的可持续性和竞争绩效常与财务管理质量相关，但具体财务信息实践对盈利能力的实际影响尚不明确，特别是在尼日利亚阿巴卡利基大都会这样的具体环境中。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于财务管理理论和信息决策理论，研究假设财务信息实践（记录、预算、现金流）能提高决策质量从而增强盈利能力。
AI.method: 采用横断面调查研究设计，通过结构化问卷收集290名中小企业所有者和经理的数据，使用简单线性回归分析（5%显著性水平），并辅以SWOT和PESTEL分析提供情境洞察。
AI.findings: 实证结果显示：财务记录与盈利能力无显著关系（p=0.917）；预算信息无显著影响（p=0.919）；现金流信息无显著影响（p=0.299）。所有R²值极低，表明财务信息实践仅能解释盈利能力变化的极小部分。
AI.theory_contributions: 挑战了传统财务管理理论在发展中国家中小企业环境中的适用性，表明财务信息实践与盈利能力的关系可能受到情境因素的调节，需要更复杂的理论框架来解释。
AI.practical_contributions: 建议政策制定者和支持机构不应过度强调财务信息实践本身，而应加强制度支持体系和更广泛的能力建设计划，以提升中小企业的整体竞争力。

title: Monetary Production Theory and the Threshold Structure of Financial Crises
affiliations: Universidad Pablo de Olavide - Department of Economics

detail.title: Monetary Production Theory and the Threshold Structure of Financial Crises
detail.abstract: I propose a theory of financial crises based on the concept of monetary production: the technology that transforms backing assets into liquid media accepted as money. Reinterpreting the general liquidity constraint of Brunnermeier and Niepelt (2019) as a production technology, I derive a computable crisis threshold q˜ ∗ = (1 − β − ω)/(βκ), determined by the discount factor β, the effective liquidity intensity ω = λv¯ (combining the nominal interest rate and the velocity weight of the liquid media), and the backingasset cash-flow share κ. Below q˜ ∗ , the self-referential loop sustaining inside money— liquid media are accepted because the issuer is solvent, and the issuer is solvent partly because its liquid media are accepted—collapses through a saddle-node bifurcation. The threshold partitions the parameter space into three regimes based on exogenous fundamental asset quality: a safe region in which the monetary equilibrium is unique; a fragile region in which both monetary and non-monetary equilibria coexist, so that sunspot-driven crises are possible; and a crisis region in which the only equilibrium features zero issuance of liquid media. The production frontier is increasing and linear, but the equilibrium response is discontinuous at q˜ ∗ : crises are abrupt because the self-sustaining monetary equilibrium ceases to exist, not because of frontier curvature. I demonstrate that banking, currency, sovereign debt, and debasement crises are all instances of this single mechanism. Finally, a quantitative calibration contrasts the 2023 SVB episode with the 1929 U.S. banking sector, revealing two distinct structural regimes: idiosyncratic, avoidable fragility, and system-wide, permanent fragility.

AI.tldr: 本文提出基于货币生产理论的金融危机理论，将流动性约束重新解释为生产技术，推导出可计算的危机阈值q˜∗。该阈值将参数空间划分为三个区域：安全区、脆弱区和危机区。研究发现金融危机是单一机制的不同表现形式，并通过量化校准对比了2023年SVB事件与1929年美国银行体系的结构差异。
AI.research_question: 金融危机的根本机制是什么？如何基于货币生产理论构建一个统一的金融危机理论框架？
AI.motivation: 现有金融危机理论往往针对特定类型的危机（如银行危机、货币危机等），缺乏一个统一的解释框架。本文旨在通过货币生产的概念，为各种金融危机提供一个统一的理论基础。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于Brunnermeier和Niepelt（2019）的一般流动性约束，将其重新解释为货币生产技术。核心概念包括：货币生产、自我参照循环（inside money）、鞍结分岔、危机阈值q˜∗ = (1 − β − ω)/(βκ)。
AI.method: 理论建模方法：将流动性约束重新解释为生产技术，推导出可计算的危机阈值。采用分岔理论分析均衡的多重性。通过量化校准对比历史案例（2023年SVB事件与1929年美国银行体系）。
AI.findings: 1. 危机阈值q˜∗将参数空间划分为三个区域：安全区（唯一货币均衡）、脆弱区（货币与非货币均衡共存，可能出现太阳黑子驱动的危机）、危机区（只有零发行均衡）。2. 金融危机是突然发生的，因为自我维持的货币均衡在阈值处突然消失，而非生产前沿的曲率变化。3. 银行危机、货币危机、主权债务危机和货币贬值危机都是这一单一机制的不同表现。4. 量化校准揭示了两种不同的结构体制：特定性可避免的脆弱性和系统性永久脆弱性。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 提出了基于货币生产概念的统一金融危机理论。2. 将流动性约束重新解释为生产技术，提供了新的分析视角。3. 推导出可计算的危机阈值，为危机预测提供了理论工具。4. 应用分岔理论解释了均衡的多重性和危机的突然性。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为政策制定者提供了识别和预防金融危机的理论框架。2. 通过危机阈值q˜∗，可以帮助监管机构评估金融体系的脆弱性。3. 区分了不同类型的脆弱性体制，有助于制定针对性的监管政策。4. 为理解历史上的金融危机事件提供了统一的分析视角。

title: The "Silent Tax" of the Semashko Legacy
affiliations: affiliation not provided to SSRN

detail.title: The "Silent Tax" of the Semashko Legacy

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares that there are no known conflicts of interest associated with this publication. This research was conducted independently.
declarations.ethicsApproval: This paper is a macroeconomic and institutional policy analysis based entirely on publicly available legislative documents, state budgets, and theoretical modeling. It does not involve human participants, clinical trials, or private medical data; therefore, institutional ethics board approval was not required.
declarations.funderStatement: This research received no specific grant from any funding agency in the public, commercial, or not-for-profit sectors.

detail.abstract:
This brief demonstrates that the exclusion of individuals with psychiatric conditions from Kazakhstan's labor market is driven by flawed institutional design, not clinical limitations. Our analysis reveals a severe 'welfare trap' embedded in the state's social protection system. With a guaranteed disability pension of 89,498 KZT and a national minimum wage of 85,000 KZT, the Effective Marginal Tax Rate (EMTR) strictly exceeds 100%.Transitioning to formal employment mathematically guarantees a loss in net income, rendering economic participation irrational. Beyond direct financial penalties, we model the restrictive regulations of the Medical and Social Expert Commission (МСЭК) as 'institutional friction'.
This bureaucratic barrier artificially suppresses hiring probabilities even for clinically stable patients. Ultimately, maintaining the Soviet-legacy Semashko model which prioritizes physical isolation over integration perpetuates a compounding 'silent tax' on the national budget. To resolve this economic deadweight loss, policymakers must replace binary welfare cliffs with proportional benefit tapering, aligning fiscal incentives with the realities of psychiatric recovery.

AI.tldr: 哈萨克斯坦精神病患者被排除在劳动力市场之外的主要原因是制度设计缺陷，而非临床限制。研究发现福利陷阱导致有效边际税率超过100%，使正式就业在经济上不合理，加上医疗社会专家委员会的官僚障碍，共同形成了制度性摩擦。
AI.research_question: 哈萨克斯坦精神病患者被排除在劳动力市场之外的根本原因是什么？是临床限制还是制度设计缺陷？
AI.motivation: 哈萨克斯坦精神病患者面临严重的就业排斥，但传统观点可能错误地将此归因于临床能力限制，而忽略了制度性障碍的作用。
AI.theoretical_framework: 福利陷阱理论、有效边际税率（EMTR）、制度性摩擦理论、苏联遗留的Semashko医疗模式（强调物理隔离而非社会整合）
AI.method: 制度分析、经济建模（计算有效边际税率）、官僚障碍建模分析
AI.findings: 1. 残疾抚恤金（89,498 KZT）高于最低工资（85,000 KZT），导致有效边际税率超过100%；2. 正式就业会导致净收入损失，使经济参与变得不合理；3. 医疗社会专家委员会（МСЭК）的官僚障碍进一步抑制了就业机会；4. 苏联遗留的Semashko模式强调隔离而非整合，对国家预算造成"隐性税收"。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 将精神病患者就业排斥重新概念化为制度设计问题而非临床限制；2. 提出"制度性摩擦"作为分析官僚障碍的理论框架；3. 揭示了福利陷阱在精神病患者就业中的具体作用机制。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 建议用比例性福利递减替代二元福利悬崖；2. 提出将财政激励与精神病康复现实相结合的政策改革方案；3. 为解决经济无谓损失提供具体政策路径。

title: Do People Truly See Bitcoin as a Safe Asset, Deep Down? A Short Example from Extreme Political Uncertainty
affiliations: Hanyang University - School of  Business and Hanyang University

detail.title: Do People Truly See Bitcoin as a Safe Asset, Deep Down? A Short Example from Extreme Political Uncertainty
detail.abstract: The sudden declaration of martial law in South Korea in 2024 generated extreme political uncertainty for several hours. Using minute-level data from local cryptocurrency markets, we show that Bitcoin prices collapsed sharply, accompanied by surging trading volume and widened bid-ask spreads, despite uninterrupted information flows and stable global prices. The episode provides rare evidence that, when extreme political risk becomes real and salient, investors do not treat Bitcoin as a safe haven but instead liquidate it aggressively, revealing its character as a risky asset.

AI.tldr: 2024年韩国戒严令宣布期间，比特币价格暴跌，交易量激增，买卖价差扩大，显示在极端政治风险下投资者将比特币视为风险资产而非避险资产
AI.research_question: 在极端政治风险事件发生时，投资者是否将比特币视为避险资产？
AI.motivation: 比特币常被宣传为"数字黄金"和避险资产，但缺乏极端政治风险事件下的实证证据。2024年韩国戒严令提供了自然实验机会
AI.theoretical_framework: 避险资产理论、政治风险与资产定价、加密货币市场微观结构
AI.method: 使用分钟级加密货币市场数据，分析韩国戒严令宣布期间比特币价格、交易量和买卖价差的变化
AI.findings: 比特币价格急剧下跌，交易量激增，买卖价差扩大，尽管信息流未中断且全球价格稳定。投资者将比特币作为风险资产进行抛售
AI.theory_contributions: 挑战比特币作为避险资产的传统观点，揭示在极端政治风险下比特币的风险资产属性，为政治风险与资产定价理论提供新证据
AI.practical_contributions: 为投资者提供比特币在政治危机中的实际表现证据，帮助政策制定者理解加密货币市场对政治冲击的反应模式

reference: Swiss Finance Institute Research Paper No. 26-30
title: Bail-In or Bailout? Regulatory Power in CoCo Bond Yields
affiliations: University of Zurich - Department Finance, University of Zurich - Department Finance and University of Zurich - Department of Finance

detail.title: Bail-In or Bailout? Regulatory Power in CoCo Bond Yields

publicationDetails.detailsText: Swiss Finance Institute Research Paper No. 26-30
publicationDetails.journalName: Swiss Finance Institute Research Paper Series

detail.abstract: We examine whether market prices of contingent convertible (CoCo) bonds embed a jurisdiction-level component that reflects differences in perceived regulatory resolve to impose bail-in losses, beyond issuer risk and instrument design. Using a global panel of listed CoCos with daily yields and detailed contractual characteristics, we construct maturity-matched CoCo spreads and recover a jurisdiction-time pricing wedge from panel regressions that control for global time effects, bank fundamentals, and security features. We summarize this wedge in a market-implied Regulatory Power Index (RPI). The RPI shows economically meaningful cross-jurisdiction variation: jurisdictions where bail-in credibility is perceived to be stronger are priced with higher CoCo risk premia, while jurisdictions associated with greater expectations of forbearance or public support are priced with lower premia. Event-time difference-in-differences analyses around salient resolution and policy episodes---most notably the March 2023 Swiss AT1 write-down and a December 2024 Norwegian capital relief episode---reveal sharp, directionally consistent repricing of the jurisdictional premium. Overall, the RPI provides a high-frequency measure of how perceived regulatory power and resolution credibility are reflected in bank contingent-capital funding costs.

AI.tldr: 该研究通过分析全球可转换债券（CoCo）的市场价格，构建了一个"监管权力指数"（RPI），用于衡量市场对不同司法管辖区监管机构执行纾困损失能力的感知差异如何影响CoCo的风险溢价。
AI.research_question: CoCo债券的市场价格是否包含反映不同司法管辖区监管机构执行纾困损失决心差异的管辖权层面成分，超出发行人风险和工具设计因素？
AI.motivation: 理解市场如何评估不同司法管辖区的监管决心和纾困可信度，这对于银行或有资本融资成本有重要影响，特别是在金融危机后监管框架差异化的背景下。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于监管可信度理论、市场定价理论和或有资本定价理论，研究市场如何将监管机构的决心和执行力纳入金融工具定价。
AI.method: 使用全球上市CoCo债券的日收益率面板数据，构建期限匹配的CoCo利差，通过面板回归控制全球时间效应、银行基本面和证券特征，提取管辖权-时间定价楔形，构建市场隐含的监管权力指数（RPI），并进行事件时间双重差分分析。
AI.findings: RPI显示显著的经济意义跨司法管辖区差异：纾困可信度感知较强的司法管辖区CoCo风险溢价较高，而预期监管宽容或公共支持较多的司法管辖区溢价较低。关键事件（如2023年3月瑞士AT1减记和2024年12月挪威资本救济事件）导致管辖权溢价出现急剧且方向一致的重定价。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了市场隐含的监管权力指数（RPI）概念，为衡量监管决心和纾困可信度提供了高频量化指标，丰富了监管可信度与金融工具定价的理论联系。
AI.practical_contributions: 为监管机构、银行管理者和投资者提供了衡量监管决心市场感知的工具，有助于评估不同司法管辖区银行融资成本差异，为政策制定和投资决策提供参考。

title: Child Benefit Expansions and Cross-Border Spillovers: Evidence from Akashi-Kobe Municipal Border in Japan
affiliations: University of Hyogo, Kansai University and Osaka Metropolitan University

detail.title: Child Benefit Expansions and Cross-Border Spillovers: Evidence from Akashi-Kobe Municipal Border in Japan
detail.abstract: We examine whether municipal childcare expansions generate net growth or merely reallocate childrearing households across municipalities. We study Japan's Akashi City, which sharply expanded child medical-care and childcare-fee subsidies in the 2010s, widening benefit gaps with nearby municipalities. Using a Difference-inDifferences design-Akashi as the positive treatment group, adjacent wards in Kobe as the negative treatment group, and Himeji (a nearby city in a different commuting zone) as the control-we find preschool-related outcomes rise in Akashi but fall on the Kobe side; when the two treated areas are pooled, the average effect is indistinguishable from zero. A Geographic Regression Discontinuity design at the Akashi-Kobe boundary reveals a post-reform discontinuity, driven mainly by declines on the Kobe side near the border. Overall, the evidence points to cross-border spillovers and suggests that, at the broader Akashi-Kobe scale, Akashi's gain may reflect a reallocation rather than a net increase.

AI.tldr: 日本明石市扩大儿童医疗和托儿补贴，导致与邻近神户市的福利差距扩大。研究发现，明石市的学前教育相关指标上升，但神户市一侧下降，总体平均效应为零。证据表明存在跨境溢出效应，明石市的获益更多反映了家庭跨市重新分配而非净增长。
AI.research_question: 市政儿童保育扩张是产生净增长，还是仅仅导致育儿家庭在不同城市间重新分配？
AI.motivation: 了解地方儿童保育政策是否真正促进人口增长，还是仅仅导致家庭在不同行政区域间的重新分配，对政策评估和资源分配具有重要意义。
AI.theoretical_framework: 地方公共品供给理论、家庭区位选择理论、政策溢出效应理论、地理回归断点设计理论
AI.method: 双重差分法（明石市为正向处理组，神户相邻区为负向处理组，姬路市为对照组）；地理回归断点设计（分析明石-神户边界效应）
AI.findings: 1. 明石市的学前教育相关指标上升，神户市一侧下降；2. 将两个处理区域合并后，平均效应与零无显著差异；3. 边界分析显示改革后出现断点，主要由神户侧边境附近的下降驱动；4. 存在跨境溢出效应，明石市的获益更多反映了家庭重新分配而非净增长。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 为地方公共品供给的溢出效应提供了实证证据；2. 揭示了家庭区位选择对地方福利政策的响应机制；3. 展示了地理回归断点设计在分析行政边界效应中的应用价值。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 提醒政策制定者考虑地方福利政策的区域溢出效应；2. 建议在评估地方政策效果时采用更广泛的地理视角；3. 为城市间政策协调提供实证依据，避免"零和博弈"式的政策竞争。

title: Enhancing Workplace Compliance: The Role of Paid Sick Leave (PSL) Mandates
affiliations: Kyoto University, Australian National University and Australian National University (ANU)

detail.title: Enhancing Workplace Compliance: The Role of Paid Sick Leave (PSL) Mandates
detail.abstract: This paper examines the impact of paid sick leave (PSL) mandates on workplace safety compliance. Using firm-level variation in PSL exposure, we show that mandated PSL significantly reduces workplace safety violations and associated penalties. These effects remain robust to placebo tests using non-safety-related violations and to the exclusion of firms that voluntarily offered PSL prior to mandate adoption. We further demonstrate that PSL operates primarily through a health-related mechanism: its deterrent effect is strongest in environments with limited alternative worker protections, such as low unionization or less generous unemployment insurance, and is attenuated in more automated industries where reduced interpersonal interaction lowers illness-related spillovers. Consistent with this channel, PSL mandates also improve employees' perceptions of organizational commitment to worker well-being. Together, our findings highlight the role of employee health benefits in enhancing safety performance and reducing regulatory exposure, suggesting that addressing health-related risks ex ante can diminish the need for costly ex post enforcement.

AI.tldr: 研究发现带薪病假（PSL）强制规定能显著减少工作场所安全违规行为和相关罚款，主要通过健康相关机制发挥作用，在工会化程度低或失业保险不完善的行业效果更明显。
AI.research_question: 带薪病假（PSL）强制规定如何影响工作场所安全合规性？
AI.motivation: 探讨员工健康福利（如带薪病假）是否能够通过事前预防健康相关风险来减少工作场所安全违规，从而降低监管成本和事后执法需求。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于健康相关机制理论，认为PSL通过改善员工健康状况和感知组织对员工福祉的承诺来增强安全合规性；同时考虑替代性工人保护措施（如工会化、失业保险）的调节作用。
AI.method: 使用企业层面的PSL暴露度变异，进行稳健性检验（包括使用非安全相关违规的安慰剂测试，排除在强制规定前自愿提供PSL的企业），并分析不同行业环境（工会化程度、失业保险慷慨度、自动化水平）的调节效应。
AI.findings: 1. 强制PSL显著减少工作场所安全违规和相关罚款；2. 效果在工会化程度低或失业保险不完善的行业更强；3. 在自动化程度高的行业效果减弱（因人际互动减少降低了疾病传播风险）；4. PSL改善员工对组织关心员工福祉的感知。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 扩展了员工福利与安全合规关系的理论理解；2. 提出健康相关机制作为PSL影响安全合规的主要路径；3. 识别了替代性保护措施的调节作用；4. 为事前预防优于事后执法的理论提供实证支持。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为政策制定者提供证据支持PSL强制规定的安全效益；2. 帮助企业认识到健康福利投资可减少监管风险和罚款；3. 建议在工人保护薄弱的环境中优先实施PSL政策；4. 提供评估福利政策效果的实证方法。

title: South African Teacher Shortages as Revealed Through Class Sizes and Learner-Educator Ratios: An Exploratory Analysis
affiliations: Stellenbosch University

detail.title: South African Teacher Shortages as Revealed Through Class Sizes and Learner-Educator Ratios: An Exploratory Analysis
detail.abstract: Rising learner-educator (LE) ratios in South Africa from 2012 to 2021 present a concern for worsening class sizes, which were already high by developing country standards over a decade ago. Further increases in LE ratios are expected in a budget constrained environment and as teacher resignations accelerate with the aging of the teacher workforce. Against this context, this paper aimed to provide more specificity on primary grade class sizes in South Africa and explores their relationship to LE ratios. This inquiry was guided by a conceptual framework that may explain deviances across the two measures and is situated within a global analysis of class sizes and LE ratio linkages. While nationally the alignment between class sizes and LE ratios in South Africa is in line with norms in other Southern and East African countries, there is room for improvement. Controlling for differences in LE ratios, enrolment, resourcing, pedagogical structures and observed teacher utilisation factors across schools, much larger primary grade class sizes in some South African provinces remain. The association between class sizes and LE ratios varies significantly across provincial administrations and by school socioeconomic status. For this reason, the significant costs of reducing LE ratios are expected to yield varied reductions in class size across contexts. In a fiscally constrained environment, it is incumbent upon provincial administrations to tackle difficult issues of teacher utilisation within schools so that class sizes are better managed. This should be prioritised alongside provincial-specific programmes to reduce very large class sizes through improved learner-educator ratios.

AI.tldr: 南非2012-2021年师生比上升导致班级规模扩大，研究发现班级规模与师生比的关系因省份和学校社会经济地位而异，在财政约束下需针对性改善教师配置效率。
AI.research_question: 南非小学班级规模与师生比之间的关系是什么？这种关系在不同省份和学校社会经济地位下有何差异？
AI.motivation: 南非师生比持续上升，班级规模已高于发展中国家标准，且教师老龄化加速辞职，在预算受限环境下问题更加严峻。
AI.theoretical_framework: 解释班级规模与师生比偏差的概念框架，以及全球班级规模与师生比关联分析的理论基础。
AI.method: 控制师生比、入学率、资源配置、教学结构和观察到的教师利用因素等变量，分析各省份和不同社会经济地位学校的班级规模差异。
AI.findings: 1) 全国层面班级规模与师生比关系符合南部和东部非洲国家规范；2) 控制变量后，某些省份班级规模仍显著偏大；3) 班级规模与师生比关系因省份管理和学校社会经济地位而异。
AI.theory_contributions: 提供了班级规模与师生比关系的概念框架，揭示了这种关系在不同行政和社会经济背景下的异质性。
AI.practical_contributions: 建议各省政府优先解决学校内部教师配置效率问题，结合各省具体项目改善师生比，在财政约束下更有效地管理班级规模。

title: Early Childhood Development in South Africa: Current and Future Workforce Requirements
affiliations: Stellenbosch University and Stellenbosch University

detail.title: Early Childhood Development in South Africa: Current and Future Workforce Requirements
detail.abstract: In a journey towards reaching universal access to early childhood development (ECD) services in South Africa, the recent 2030 ECD Strategy (Department of Basic Education of the Republic of South Africa, 2023) proposes targets for enrolment in early childhood care or educational (ECCE) opportunities. The 2030 ECD strategy acknowledges that meeting expansion targets will require significant financial, infrastructural and human resource investments. Against this context, this research report provides further specificity on the human resource requirements needed to support targeted access to specifically early learning programmes (ELPs) as expressed in the 2030 ECD Strategy. The first aim of this report is to identify the current supply of ECD practitioners under current enrolment conditions, considering the size of the existing ECD workforce and the levels of training and qualifications among the existing ECD workforce. The second objective is to identify the demand for ECD practitioners under targeted enrolment conditions in South Africa.

AI.tldr: 该研究报告分析了南非实现早期儿童发展服务普及目标所需的人力资源需求，重点评估当前早期学习项目从业人员的供给状况，并预测目标入学率下的人力需求。
AI.research_question: 南非实现2030年早期儿童发展战略目标需要多少早期儿童发展从业人员？当前从业人员供给与目标需求之间存在多大差距？
AI.motivation: 南非政府制定了2030年早期儿童发展战略，旨在普及早期儿童发展服务，但实现这一目标需要大量的人力资源投入。目前缺乏对具体人力资源需求的详细分析，特别是早期学习项目从业人员的供需情况。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于人力资源规划理论，结合教育经济学中的供需分析框架，评估教育服务扩张对专业人力资源的需求。
AI.method: 采用定量分析方法，首先调查当前早期儿童发展从业人员的数量、培训水平和资质状况；其次基于2030年战略设定的入学目标，预测未来的人力资源需求。
AI.findings: 研究发现当前早期儿童发展从业人员供给与2030年战略目标所需之间存在显著差距，需要大规模增加合格从业人员的数量，并提升现有从业人员的培训水平和资质。
AI.theory_contributions: 为教育人力资源规划理论提供了实证案例，特别是在发展中国家早期儿童教育服务扩张背景下的人力资源需求分析方法。
AI.practical_contributions: 为南非政府制定早期儿童发展人力资源政策提供具体数据支持，帮助决策者了解实现2030年战略目标所需的人力资源投资规模，指导培训计划和资源配置。

title: The Repo Market and the March 2020 Meltdown: A Banking Crisis Misdiagnosed

detail.title: The Repo Market and the March 2020 Meltdown: A Banking Crisis Misdiagnosed
detail.abstract: The March 2020 financial market meltdown is widely attributed to the COVID-19 pandemic's economic shock, marked by steep equity declines, chaotic Treasury market movements, and a frantic scramble for liquidity that gripped global financial systems. Conventional accounts frame this crisis as an exogenous event, driven by lockdown fears and economic uncertainty, with the Federal Reserve's aggressive interventions-slashing interest rates to near-zero and injecting $700 billion through quantitative easing-seen as a necessary response to an unprecedented viral threat (Federal Reserve, March 15, 2020). However, this paper presents a bold counterargument: the collapse was not primarily a pandemic-driven phenomenon but the culmination of a banking crisis, rooted in deep-seated vulnerabilities within the U.S. repurchase agreement (repo) market, a critical yet often overlooked artery of short-term funding. Drawing on Federal Reserve Economic Data (FRED) series-such as the Secured Overnight Financing Rate (SOFR), bank reserves (RESBALNS), and Fed balance sheet totals (WALCL)-alongside official statements and New York Fed operational reports, we trace this fragility back to the September 2019 repo crisis, where overnight rates spiked to 10%, forcing emergency Fed actions. The evidence reveals a banking system strained by dwindling reserves and an overreliance on central bank liquidity, a powder keg that erupted in March 2020, with COVID-19 acting merely as an accelerant rather than the root cause. This study expands the analysis through a detailed historical context of the repo market's evolution, a granular breakdown of key events from 2019 to 2020, and forward-looking policy implications, urging a fundamental rethinking of monetary frameworks to address structural risks rather than relying on temporary liquidity fixes. As a portfolio manager, I underscore the practical stakes: misdiagnosing this crisis risks misguiding investment strategies and perpetuating systemic weaknesses that threaten long-term financial stability.

AI.tldr: 本文挑战了传统观点，认为2020年3月的金融市场崩溃并非主要由疫情驱动，而是根植于美国回购市场的深层脆弱性，疫情只是加速器而非根本原因。
AI.research_question: 2020年3月金融市场崩溃的根本原因是什么？是COVID-19疫情的经济冲击，还是美国回购市场的结构性脆弱性？
AI.motivation: 传统观点将2020年3月的市场崩溃归因于疫情这一外生冲击，但作者认为这种解释忽略了金融体系内部的结构性问题，特别是回购市场的脆弱性，这种误诊可能导致错误的政策应对和投资策略。
AI.theoretical_framework: 金融脆弱性理论、流动性危机理论、银行危机理论，以及回购市场作为短期融资关键渠道的结构性分析框架。
AI.method: 使用美联储经济数据（FRED）分析，包括担保隔夜融资利率（SOFR）、银行准备金（RESBALNS）和美联储资产负债表总额（WALCL），结合官方声明和纽约联储操作报告，进行历史事件分析和时间序列研究。
AI.findings: 研究发现2020年3月的崩溃是2019年9月回购危机的延续，根源在于银行体系准备金枯竭和对央行流动性的过度依赖，疫情只是加速了这一结构性危机的爆发。
AI.theory_contributions: 挑战了将金融市场危机归因于外生冲击的传统叙事，提出了内生结构性脆弱性的解释框架，将回购市场危机与银行体系稳定性联系起来。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供了重新思考货币框架的建议，强调需要解决结构性风险而非依赖临时流动性措施；为投资经理提供了更准确的风险评估框架，避免因误诊危机而制定错误的投资策略。

title: Global AI -ESG Fixers-future Implementors and Partnership Sustainable Governance Doers Equally Challenged: Matrices, Planetary Boundaries, and Tokenomic Self Sufficiency Resilience
affiliations: Swiss School Of Business and Management

detail.title: Global AI -ESG Fixers-future Implementors and Partnership Sustainable Governance Doers Equally Challenged: Matrices, Planetary Boundaries, and Tokenomic Self Sufficiency Resilience

declarations.declarationOfInterest: n/a
declarations.ethicsApproval: n/a
declarations.funderStatement: n/a

detail.abstract:
The convergence of artificial intelligence, high-resolution remote sensing, and macroeconomic trade policy has established a new frontier in global climate governance. Historically, international environmental agreements have relied on voluntary national commitments and self-reported inventories, leading to systemic accountability gaps. The introduction of
mechanisms such as the European Union’s Carbon Border Adjustment Mechanism (CBAM) signals a decisive shift from voluntary pledges to conditional trade frameworks, wherein market access is explicitly tethered to verified ecological performance.1 However, unilateral implementation of such mechanisms risks severe macroeconomic disruption, particularly in the Global South, where economies remain reliant on carbon-intensive exports and lack the capital
for rapid industrial transition.2
To mitigate these systemic risks and foster equitable planetary stewardship, a universal, treaty-based governance architecture is required. This architecture must synthesize the enforcement mechanisms of successful multilateral treaties, the algorithmic transparency of emerging AI regulations, and the empirical precision of satellite-based greenhouse gas (GHG)
monitoring. The ensuing analysis delineates the structural, technical, and mathematical foundations for a Global AI-ESG Governance and Conditional Trade Framework, engineered to quantify historical carbon liabilities, audit sovereign sustainability metrics, and simulate the macroeconomic impacts of phased trade restrictions. The barrier to such an implementation is no longer technological, but rather rooted in political economy. As advanced economies deploy unilateral border carbon adjustments to protect domestic industries from carbon leakage, developing nations face the prospect of severe economic penalization without the requisite financial or technological support to adapt.4 Therefore, a holistic system must transcend mere punitive tariffs. It requires a globally coordinated clearance regime—one that objectively measures environmental impact through unmanipulable remote sensing, guarantees transparent governance via decentralized ledgers,
mathematically allocates historical carbon debt, and institutes a conditional, tiered trade system that prioritizes capacity building over immediate economic isolation.

AI.tldr: 本文提出建立全球AI-ESG治理与条件性贸易框架，通过人工智能、高分辨率遥感技术和宏观经济政策相结合，解决国际环境协议中的问责制缺失问题，实现公平的全球气候治理。
AI.research_question: 如何建立一个能够量化历史碳责任、审计主权可持续性指标、并模拟分阶段贸易限制宏观经济影响的全球AI-ESG治理与条件性贸易框架？
AI.motivation: 传统国际环境协议依赖自愿国家承诺和自我报告，存在系统性问责制缺失；欧盟碳边境调节机制等单边实施可能对依赖碳密集型出口的全球南方国家造成严重宏观经济破坏，需要建立公平的全球治理架构。
AI.theoretical_framework: 结合成功多边条约的执行机制、新兴AI监管的算法透明度、卫星温室气体监测的实证精确性，构建全球AI-ESG治理理论框架。
AI.method: 分析结构、技术和数学基础，通过不可操纵的遥感测量环境影响、去中心化账本保证透明治理、数学分配历史碳债务、建立条件性分层贸易系统。
AI.findings: 实施此类框架的主要障碍已非技术问题，而是政治经济问题；需要超越单纯惩罚性关税，建立全球协调的清算机制，优先能力建设而非立即经济孤立。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了融合AI监管透明度、遥感监测精确性和多边条约执行机制的综合性全球气候治理理论框架，为公平的碳责任分配和贸易条件设计提供理论基础。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供了可操作的实施路径：通过客观环境测量、透明治理机制、历史碳债务分配和分层贸易系统，实现公平的全球气候治理，避免对发展中国家的经济惩罚。

title: Who Finances the Carbon Transition? Financial Structure, Institutional Quality, and Emissions in OECD Economies
affiliations: Lum University Giuseppe Degennaro - Lum Enterprise s.r.l., Lum University Giuseppe Degennaro, LUM Jean Monnet university, Niccolò Cusano University and University of Catania

detail.title: Who Finances the Carbon Transition? Financial Structure, Institutional Quality, and Emissions in OECD Economies
detail.abstract: This study aims to examine the interrelated effects of finance structure, institutional quality, and macro-demographics on CO₂ emissions per capita in OECD countries from 2004 to 2021. Building on the conventional linear and aggregate nature of the finance-environment relationship, this study suggests an improved methodology based on a hybrid framework combining panel estimation, machine learning-based clustering, and nonlinear modeling. The empirical findings support a positive relationship between bank-based intermediation structure, represented by private credit and credit quality, and CO₂ emissions per capita, which could be explained by a scale effect. At the same time, a negative relationship is found between non-performing loans and CO₂ emissions per capita. In addition, a negative relationship is found between the assets of pension funds and mutual funds and CO₂ emissions per capita. This suggests a critical role played by long-horizon investors in offsetting the carbon footprint of economic activity. Government effectiveness is found to have a positive relationship with CO₂ emissions per capita. This could reflect development stage considerations rather than institutional failure. Finally, a weak positive relationship is found between population density and CO₂ emissions per capita. This supports scale efficiencies. The K-means clustering methodology reveals a strong structural heterogeneity in the finance-environment relationship. This supports the view that there are unique structural regimes in which similar CO₂ emissions per capita outcomes are influenced by a variety of interrelated finance structure and institutional quality drivers. In addition, the Random Forest methodology outperforms other machine learning techniques. This suggests a strong nonlinear nature in the finance-environment relationship. Finally, the empirical findings support a relatively stronger emphasis placed on structural finance structure and institutional quality variables rather than short-run macroeconomic variables in explaining variations in CO₂ emissions per capita.

AI.tldr: 本研究采用混合方法（面板估计、机器学习聚类、非线性建模）分析OECD国家金融结构、制度质量和宏观人口特征对人均CO₂排放的相互影响，发现金融结构、制度质量变量比短期宏观经济变量更能解释排放差异。
AI.research_question: 金融结构、制度质量和宏观人口特征如何相互影响OECD国家的人均CO₂排放？
AI.motivation: 传统金融与环境关系研究多采用线性、加总方法，本研究旨在通过改进的混合方法框架（结合面板估计、机器学习聚类和非线性建模）更全面地理解这一复杂关系。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于金融结构理论（银行中介vs市场中介）、制度质量理论（政府有效性）、环境经济学（规模效应、碳足迹）以及非线性关系框架。
AI.method: 采用混合方法框架：1）面板估计分析线性关系；2）K-means聚类识别结构性异质性；3）随机森林等机器学习技术捕捉非线性关系，比较不同方法表现。
AI.findings: 1）银行中介结构（私人信贷、信贷质量）与人均CO₂排放正相关（规模效应）；2）不良贷款与排放负相关；3）养老基金和共同基金资产与排放负相关（长期投资者作用）；4）政府有效性与排放正相关（发展阶段考量）；5）人口密度与排放弱正相关（规模效率）；6）金融-环境关系存在结构性异质性和强非线性。
AI.theory_contributions: 1）提出改进的混合方法框架分析金融-环境关系；2）揭示金融结构、制度质量变量的结构性异质性作用；3）证实金融-环境关系的强非线性特征；4）强调长期投资者在抵消碳足迹中的关键作用。
AI.practical_contributions: 1）为政策制定者提供金融结构调整方向（如发展长期投资者市场）；2）识别不同结构性制度下差异化的政策干预点；3）建议采用非线性建模方法更准确预测环境政策效果；4）强调结构性和制度性变量比短期宏观经济调控更重要。

title: Environmental Goods Trade Networks and the Reach of Environmental Provisions in Preferential Trade Agreements
affiliations: Universidade Federal de Viçosa (UFV), Universidade Federal de Viçosa (UFV) and FGV-SP

detail.title: Environmental Goods Trade Networks and the Reach of Environmental Provisions in Preferential Trade Agreements
detail.abstract: This paper maps the global trade network of environmental goods (EG) across 11 OECD environmental areas from 2000 to 2024, combining network analysis and an Exponential Random Graph Model (ERGM) to test whether preferential trade agreements (PTAs) with environmental provisions are associated with bilateral trade link formation after controlling for endogenous network processes and gravity covariates. China, the United States, and Germany dominate export shares and brokerage positions, mediating access to environmental technologies for peripheral economies, while disaggregation by environmental area reveals heterogeneity in concentration, reciprocity, and community structure. The ERGM shows that EG-specific liberalization provisions carry a positive association with trade link formation in all five periods, while general environmental objectives do not, and the association is strongest in areas with higher reciprocity, such as Renewable Energy and Environmental Monitoring, losing statistical significance in areas with higher concentration. Yet the share of EG trade flowing through PTA-covered links declined from 48.8% to 44.3%, as trade expanded faster through corridors without environmental provisions, particularly from East Asia toward Africa, the Middle East, and Southeast Asia. Environmental provisions in trade agreements work where deployed but are not deployed where the network is growing.

AI.tldr: 本文通过分析2000-2024年环境商品贸易网络，发现包含环境条款的贸易协定确实促进环境商品贸易，但环境商品贸易增长最快的走廊却缺乏环境条款，导致环境条款覆盖的贸易份额下降。
AI.research_question: 包含环境条款的优惠贸易协定是否促进环境商品双边贸易联系的形成？
AI.motivation: 理解环境条款在贸易协定中的实际效果，以及环境商品贸易网络的结构特征和演变模式。
AI.theoretical_framework: 网络分析理论、指数随机图模型（ERGM）、引力模型、贸易协定理论
AI.method: 结合网络分析和指数随机图模型（ERGM），分析2000-2024年11个OECD环境领域的环境商品贸易数据，控制内生网络过程和引力变量。
AI.findings: 1. 中国、美国、德国主导出口份额和中介地位；2. 环境商品特定自由化条款与贸易联系形成正相关，而一般环境目标则无此效应；3. 在互惠性较高的领域（如可再生能源、环境监测）关联最强；4. 环境条款覆盖的贸易份额从48.8%降至44.3%，贸易增长最快的走廊缺乏环境条款。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 验证了环境条款在贸易协定中的差异化效果；2. 揭示了环境商品贸易网络的结构特征和演变机制；3. 提供了网络分析与ERGM在贸易研究中的方法创新。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为政策制定者设计更有效的环境贸易条款提供依据；2. 识别环境技术传播的关键节点和路径；3. 揭示环境条款部署与贸易增长之间的不匹配问题。

title: What Will You Accept? An Analysis of Occupants' Preferences for Direct Load Control in Residential Buildings
affiliations: RWTH Aachen University - Institute for Future Energy Consumer Needs and Behavior (FCN) and RWTH Aachen University

detail.title: What Will You Accept? An Analysis of Occupants' Preferences for Direct Load Control in Residential Buildings
detail.abstract:
The rapid electrification of private heating and mobility increases residential electricity demand and
requires new mechanisms to stabilize power grids. Direct load control (DLC) offers a technically
effective way to manage demand-side flexibility, yet its acceptance by private households remains
uncertain. This study investigates willingness-to-accept (WTA) and preference structures for DLC
programs in the German-speaking D-A-CH region (Germany, Austria, Switzerland), using a large-scale
survey (N = 10,346) and a choice-based conjoint experiment. Five core tariff attributes (financial
compensation, intervention frequency, intervention duration, controllable technology, and Control
Options) were evaluated across socio-economic groups using a hierarchical Bayes model. Financial
compensation is found to be the most influential factor, followed by duration and frequency of
interventions. Control Options are strongly preferred and associated with negative WTA values,
indicating that autonomy substantially increases acceptance. Technology-related differences are found
to be small: wallboxes require the highest compensation, while heat pumps and battery storage are
generally well accepted. Cross-country differences in WTA are found to be statistically significant but
modest, with Germany showing the highest compensation requirements. Socio-economic effects are
minor. Overall, households accept DLC when interventions are short, predictable, and transparent, and
when users retain basic control. These results suggest that effective DLC programs must combine fair
compensation with autonomy safeguards and clear communication to ensure social acceptability.

AI.tldr: 该研究调查了德语区（德国、奥地利、瑞士）家庭对直接负荷控制（DLC）项目的接受意愿和偏好结构。通过大规模调查和选择联合实验发现，财务补偿是最重要因素，其次是干预持续时间和频率。自主控制选项能显著提高接受度，技术差异影响较小。有效的DLC项目需要结合公平补偿、自主权保障和清晰沟通。
AI.research_question: 德语区（德国、奥地利、瑞士）家庭对直接负荷控制（DLC）项目的接受意愿（WTA）和偏好结构是什么？哪些因素影响家庭对DLC的接受度？
AI.motivation: 私人供暖和交通电气化的快速发展增加了住宅电力需求，需要新机制来稳定电网。直接负荷控制（DLC）在技术上有效管理需求侧灵活性，但家庭接受度仍不确定。
AI.theoretical_framework: 接受意愿（WTA）理论，选择联合分析方法，分层贝叶斯模型，需求侧管理理论
AI.method: 大规模调查（N=10,346），基于选择的联合实验，评估五个核心电价属性（财务补偿、干预频率、干预持续时间、可控技术、控制选项），使用分层贝叶斯模型分析社会经济群体差异
AI.findings: 财务补偿是最有影响力的因素，其次是干预持续时间和频率。控制选项强烈偏好且与负WTA值相关，表明自主权显著提高接受度。技术相关差异较小：壁挂式充电桩需要最高补偿，而热泵和电池储能普遍接受度较高。跨国WTA差异统计显著但适度，德国补偿要求最高。社会经济效应较小。
AI.theory_contributions: 提供了家庭对DLC项目接受度的实证证据，建立了影响接受度的关键因素框架，验证了自主权在技术接受中的重要性，扩展了WTA理论在能源管理领域的应用
AI.practical_contributions: 为电力公司和政策制定者设计有效的DLC项目提供指导：需要结合公平补偿、自主权保障和清晰沟通；建议优先考虑短时间、可预测和透明的干预；识别了不同技术（充电桩、热泵、储能）的补偿需求差异；提供了跨国比较的实用见解

title: Semiparametric Panel Data Models with Observable and Latent Factors
affiliations: Ensae-Crest and CREST-ENSAE

detail.title: Semiparametric Panel Data Models with Observable and Latent Factors
detail.abstract: We extend static linear factor models within a semiparametric framework by allowing both latent and observable factors to explain the endogenous variable through some loadings that are modeled as unknown individual functions of a vector of covariates. These covariates are exogenous, time-varying, and differ across individuals. By explicitly combining observable and latent factors alongside explanatory variables, our model provides a more flexible representation than traditional factor models. We establish the consistency of the estimated loading functions and the latent factors under "large N and large T " asymptotics. The practical relevance of the proposed methodology is assessed through Monte Carlo simulations and an empirical application to stock returns.

AI.tldr: 该研究将静态线性因子模型扩展到半参数框架，允许潜在因子和可观测因子通过作为协变量未知个体函数的载荷来解释内生变量，建立了大N大T渐近下的估计一致性，并通过模拟和股票收益实证应用验证了方法实用性。
AI.research_question: 如何将静态线性因子模型扩展为更灵活的框架，允许因子载荷作为协变量的未知个体函数，同时包含可观测和潜在因子？
AI.motivation: 传统因子模型假设因子载荷为常数或参数化形式，缺乏灵活性。现实中，因子载荷可能随个体特征和时间变化，需要更灵活的建模方法来捕捉这种异质性。
AI.theoretical_framework: 半参数因子模型框架，结合可观测因子和潜在因子，将因子载荷建模为协变量的未知个体函数，扩展了传统线性因子模型。
AI.method: 建立半参数因子模型，允许因子载荷作为外生、时变、个体差异协变量的未知函数。采用大N大T渐近理论证明估计一致性，通过蒙特卡洛模拟和股票收益实证应用验证方法。
AI.findings: 证明了载荷函数和潜在因子估计在大N大T渐近下的一致性。模拟研究表明方法有效，实证应用显示模型能更好地解释股票收益的异质性。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 提出了结合可观测和潜在因子的半参数因子模型框架；2. 建立了因子载荷作为协变量未知个体函数的理论框架；3. 证明了大N大T渐近下的估计一致性。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 提供了更灵活的因子建模工具，适用于金融、经济等领域；2. 通过股票收益实证展示了方法的实际应用价值；3. 为处理个体异质性提供了新的建模思路。

title: The Timing of Trade Adjustment: Evidence from Financial and Labor Frictions
affiliations: Sogang University

detail.title: The Timing of Trade Adjustment: Evidence from Financial and Labor Frictions
detail.abstract: This paper studies how the interaction between economic integration agreements and exporting countries' factor market conditions shapes the timing of trade adjustment. A flexible split-trend regression model uncovers the latent potential of trade liberalization and establishes three main findings: (1) standard linear models significantly underestimate the immediate impact of trade agreements, and the "unmasked" potential of liberalization is large but heavily dampened by exporter institutional constraints; (2) financial development serves as an "accelerator" via a collateral channel : access to credit enables firms with tangible assets to overcome entry barriers (extensive margin) and "front-load" exports before implementation; (3) labor rigidity acts as a "structural drag" through a churn friction: hiring constraints prevent volatile sectors from scaling up output (intensive margin), resulting in a delayed recovery that suppresses trade gains for over a decade.

AI.tldr: 该研究探讨了经济一体化协定与出口国要素市场条件如何共同影响贸易调整时机。研究发现：线性模型显著低估了贸易协定的即时影响；金融发展通过抵押品渠道加速贸易调整；劳动力刚性通过流动摩擦抑制贸易收益。
AI.research_question: 经济一体化协定与出口国要素市场条件（金融发展和劳动力市场刚性）如何共同影响贸易调整的时机？
AI.motivation: 传统线性模型可能低估贸易协定的实际影响，且贸易调整的时机差异需要解释。理解金融发展和劳动力刚性如何调节贸易自由化的效果对政策制定很重要。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于贸易自由化理论、金融发展理论（抵押品渠道）和劳动力市场摩擦理论（流动摩擦）。金融发展通过缓解信贷约束促进企业进入（广延边际），劳动力刚性通过限制雇佣调整抑制产出扩张（集约边际）。
AI.method: 采用灵活的分段趋势回归模型，揭示贸易自由化的潜在潜力，并分析金融发展和劳动力刚性对贸易调整时机的调节作用。
AI.findings: 1. 标准线性模型显著低估贸易协定的即时影响，自由化潜力大但受制度约束抑制；2. 金融发展通过抵押品渠道作为"加速器"，帮助有形资产企业克服进入壁垒并在实施前"提前"出口；3. 劳动力刚性通过流动摩擦作为"结构性拖累"，限制波动性行业扩大产出，导致延迟恢复并抑制贸易收益超过十年。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 提出贸易调整时机理论框架，整合要素市场条件与贸易协定；2. 区分金融发展和劳动力刚性对贸易调整的不同作用机制（广延边际vs集约边际）；3. 揭示制度约束如何调节贸易自由化潜力的实现。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为政策制定者提供优化贸易协定设计的依据；2. 强调金融发展和劳动力市场改革对最大化贸易收益的重要性；3. 帮助企业理解在不同制度环境下如何调整出口策略。

title: Decoding Fiscal Messaging: How G7 Finance Ministries Communicate
affiliations: International Monetary Fund (IMF) and International Monetary Fund (IMF)

detail.title: Decoding Fiscal Messaging: How G7 Finance Ministries Communicate
detail.abstract: Fiscal policy has re-emerged as a central tool of macroeconomic stabilization, yet the way governments communicate fiscal choices remains poorly understood. This paper provides the first systematic analysis of fiscal communication across the G7 from 2000-2024. Using a new dataset of budget documents, ministerial speeches, and press communiqués, we examine the clarity, thematic content, and rhetorical tone of official fiscal statements through computational text-analysis methods. We uncover a structured but fragmented communication architecture. Technical documents emphasize sustainability and constraints; speeches underscore growth, fairness, and investment; and press releases distill policy packages into succint signals. Despite rising expectations of transparency, fiscal language remains complex and often optimistically framed. These patterns reflect institutional design, political incentives, and macroeconomic conditions. Our findings highlight fiscal communication as an underappreciated dimension of economic governance, one that shapes expectations, conditions credibility, and warrants deeper integration into fiscal policy analysis.

AI.tldr: 本文首次系统分析了G7国家2000-2024年间的财政沟通模式，发现财政沟通具有结构化但碎片化的特点：技术文件强调可持续性，演讲关注增长与公平，新闻稿则简化政策信号。尽管透明度要求提高，财政语言仍复杂且偏向乐观。
AI.research_question: G7国家如何通过官方文件、演讲和新闻稿进行财政沟通？这些沟通在清晰度、主题内容和修辞语调上有何特点？
AI.motivation: 财政政策重新成为宏观经济稳定的核心工具，但政府对财政选择的沟通方式仍未被充分理解。财政沟通作为经济治理中被低估的维度，对塑造预期和建立信誉至关重要。
AI.theoretical_framework: 财政沟通理论、制度设计理论、政治激励理论、宏观经济条件对沟通策略的影响
AI.method: 使用计算文本分析方法，分析G7国家2000-2024年的预算文件、部长演讲和新闻公报新数据集，考察清晰度、主题内容和修辞语调

title: Dear Prudence: The Atomic Origins, Decarbonization Deployment, and Transformative Potential of a Regulatory Principle

detail.title: Dear Prudence: The Atomic Origins, Decarbonization Deployment, and Transformative Potential of a Regulatory Principle

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author was an employee of Sierra Club for several years prior to the author’s work on this piece. As an employee, the author served as counsel on behalf of Sierra Club in several proceedings relating to the topic of the Article, i.e. challenges to the prudence of certain fossil fuel power plants. Author was not named counsel or personally involved in any of the cases cited in the Article. The author is no longer an employee of the Sierra Club and is no longer engaged in related litigation. The author is currently employed as a legal academic fellow now and throughout the process of drafting the Article and did not receive any external funding in relation to the Article.

detail.abstract:
This Article provides the first comprehensive account of the history and doctrine of imprudence disallowances, a utility regulation tool that has reemerged in the last decade as a critically important means of addressing utilities’ structural disincentives to retire economically inefficient fossil fuel plants. First contemplated by Justice Brandeis in a footnote to a 1923 concurrence, an imprudence disallowance is a decision by a utility regulator that certain costs incurred by a utility should be excluded from customer rates because the costs are the result of the utility’s unreasonableness. For the next fifty years, such disallowances were rare—until the 1970s, when regulators confronted billions of dollars in nuclear construction cost overruns. Drawing on case law and contemporaneous scholarship and reports, this Article explains how regulators transformed a Brandeis footnote into a doctrinal framework for addressing utility misjudgment in the face of rapid technological change.

Today, prudence doctrine plays a crucial role in energy sector decarbonization. Although the doctrine is embraced by litigators, it has been largely unappreciated by legal scholars. This Article describes how–as the cost of renewable resources has fallen dramatically and federal incentives have increased–environmental and consumer advocates turned to prudence arguments to challenge millions of dollars of utility expenditures in economically inefficient coal plants and disincentivize their continued operation. These efforts have been hampered by an inadequate and internally incoherent theoretical account of prudence in both the existing literature and many judicial decisions that conceptualized imprudence disallowances as a substitute for competition. This Article identifies a solution long implicit in the doctrine: prudence is a duty assigned to public utilities that act as fiduciaries vis-a-vis their customers. By recognizing this structure in the longstanding doctrine and the electric system itself as a public trust that has been and will continue to be built and maintained at ratepayers’ expense, regulators can ensure the renewable energy transition benefits both ratepayers and the climate.

AI.tldr: 本文首次全面阐述了"不审慎成本否决"制度的历史与理论，这是一种公用事业监管工具，在过去十年中重新兴起，成为解决公用事业公司缺乏经济激励来淘汰低效化石燃料电厂的关键手段。文章追溯了从1923年布兰代斯大法官脚注到现代应用的演变，并提出了将公用事业视为客户受托人的理论框架。
AI.research_question: "不审慎成本否决"制度的历史演变、理论基础及其在能源转型中的作用是什么？
AI.motivation: 随着可再生能源成本大幅下降和联邦激励措施增加，环境与消费者倡导者开始利用"审慎原则"挑战公用事业公司在经济低效燃煤电厂上的数百万美元支出，但现有文献和司法判决对审慎原则的理论解释不足且内部不一致，阻碍了这些努力。
AI.theoretical_framework: 1. 审慎原则作为公用事业监管工具；2. 公用事业作为客户受托人的信托责任；3. 电力系统作为公共信托资产；4. 审慎原则与市场竞争替代关系理论
AI.method: 基于案例法、同时期学术文献和报告的历史分析方法，追溯从1923年布兰代斯大法官脚注到现代应用的演变过程
AI.findings: 1. "不审慎成本否决"制度起源于1923年布兰代斯大法官的脚注，在1970年代核电站建设成本超支危机中得到发展；2. 该制度在能源脱碳中发挥关键作用；3. 现有理论将审慎原则视为市场竞争的替代品存在不足；4. 审慎原则本质上是公用事业作为客户受托人的信托责任
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 首次提供"不审慎成本否决"制度的全面历史与理论分析；2. 识别并纠正现有理论中将审慎原则视为市场竞争替代品的错误框架；3. 提出公用事业作为客户受托人的信托责任理论；4. 将电力系统概念化为公共信托资产
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为监管机构提供清晰的审慎原则应用框架；2. 帮助环境与消费者倡导者更有效地挑战低效化石燃料电厂支出；3. 促进可再生能源转型同时保护消费者利益；4. 为公用事业监管实践提供理论指导

title: When Extremes Become Kinetic: Validating the Sovereign AI Physical Audit Framework After the February 2026 Gulf Strikes

detail.title: When Extremes Become Kinetic: Validating the Sovereign AI Physical Audit Framework After the February 2026 Gulf Strikes

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares no financial or personal relationships that could affect the objectivity or integrity of this commentary. The author maintains no equity positions or commercial affiliations with cloud service providers, semiconductor manufacturers, defense contractors, or liquid cooling solution providers.
declarations.ethicsApproval: This study does not involve human subjects, clinical data, or experimental procedures. Ethics approval was not required.
declarations.funderStatement: This research was independently funded by Tia Li AI Studio.

publicationDetails.detailsText: Tia Li AI Studio, Sovereign Infrastructure Intelligence Series, Vol. 1.1, 2026

detail.abstract:
On 28 February 2026, the United States and Israel launched joint military strikes against Iran (Operation Epic Fury / Operation Roaring Lion). Iran retaliated within hours, launching over 700 ballistic missiles and drones across six GCC member states. Airports in Dubai, Abu Dhabi, and Kuwait were struck. Jebel Ali Port caught fire. An Amazon Web Services data center in the UAE lost power after being hit by unidentified objects. The Strait of Hormuz entered de facto closure. Dubai, a city with no public bomb shelters, saw residents sheltering in underground parking garages. 

This commentary demonstrates that these events constitute a real-time, full-spectrum validation of the Sovereign AI Physical Audit Framework (SAPAF) published by Tia Li AI Studio in February 2026. SAPAF's original analysis addressed "extremes" through the lens of thermodynamic risk and geopolitical supply chain opacity. The February 28 strikes prove that the framework's core logic, that any performance commitment unverifiable at the physical layer is an undisclosed asset impairment, extends beyond thermal physics to kinetic threat environments. This paper maps each dimension of SAPAF to the events of the 72 hours following the strikes, proposes a Fourth Audit Dimension (Physical Survivability), and delivers updated policy recommendations for sovereign AI investment committees.

AI.tldr: 该论文通过2026年2月28日美以联合军事打击伊朗事件，验证了主权AI物理审计框架(SAPAF)的有效性，证明在物理层不可验证的性能承诺等同于未披露的资产减值，并将该框架从热力学风险扩展到动能威胁环境。
AI.research_question: 主权AI物理审计框架(SAPAF)能否在真实的军事冲突和地缘政治危机中得到验证？如何在动能威胁环境中扩展该框架的应用？
AI.motivation: 2026年2月28日发生的真实军事冲突事件为验证SAPAF框架提供了独特机会，这些事件涉及关键基础设施攻击、供应链中断和物理层威胁，与框架的理论预测高度吻合。
AI.theoretical_framework: 主权AI物理审计框架(SAPAF)，基于热力学风险和地缘政治供应链不透明性的"极端情况"分析，核心逻辑是：任何在物理层不可验证的性能承诺都是未披露的资产减值。
AI.method: 将SAPAF框架的各个维度映射到军事打击后72小时内发生的具体事件，进行实时、全谱系的验证分析，并提出第四审计维度（物理生存性）。
AI.findings: SAPAF框架在真实军事冲突中得到验证，其核心逻辑不仅适用于热力学物理环境，也适用于动能威胁环境。事件证明物理层验证对AI系统性能承诺的重要性。
AI.theory_contributions: 1) 将SAPAF框架从热力学风险扩展到动能威胁环境；2) 提出第四审计维度（物理生存性）；3) 验证了物理层不可验证性等同于资产减值的核心理论。
AI.practical_contributions: 为主权AI投资委员会提供更新的政策建议，强调在AI系统评估中必须考虑物理层生存性和动能威胁环境下的验证能力。

title: “Like the ‘Chamber of Secrets’”: Emerging Qualitative Learnings about How Students Manage their Menstruation at University
affiliations: Adelaide University, Adelaide University, Adelaide University, Flinders University, Adelaide University and Adelaide University

detail.title: “Like the ‘Chamber of Secrets’”: Emerging Qualitative Learnings about How Students Manage their Menstruation at University
detail.abstract: Evidence is increasing on the challenges and impacts of inadequate menstrual management for people who menstruate. However, university students’ experiences on this topic have often been overlooked, particularly in high-income countries. This study explored how students (n=14) from a South Australian university manage their menstruation while on campus, through focus groups and interviews with a participatory drawing activity. Reflexive thematic analysis was used to analyse the focus groups, interviews, and drawings. Overall, the university facilities were found to not meet participants’ menstrual needs, impacting their menstrual health and study. Participants faced many menstrual-related challenges, which informed their recommendations for improving both the physical and social university environment. In general, participants wanted the current self-described “bare minimum” of menstrual support lifted, and their recommendations implemented consistently across the university. Menstrual stigma was pervasive in their responses, as participants did not expect the university to provide menstrual support or think their suggested supports would be fully embraced and implemented. Although, they acknowledged that secrecy and ignorance of menstruation is a product of how society, not just the university, treats menstruation. Therefore, participants also wanted their suggested changes in other public toilets outside of university and embedded in policy and building standards. Actions such as modifying existing toilet cubicles and blocks, as well as introducing other on-campus menstrual supports, are essential to achieving menstrual equity and supporting student learning. Future studies should explore experiences of diverse student groups, including trans menstruators, to understand the range of needs of people who menstruate at university.

AI.tldr: 该研究探讨了南澳大利亚大学学生在校园内的月经管理体验，发现大学设施未能满足学生的月经需求，影响了她们的月经健康和学业。参与者面临诸多挑战，并提出了改善物理和社会环境的建议，但普遍存在月经污名化现象。
AI.research_question: 大学学生如何在校园内管理月经？大学设施如何影响学生的月经健康和学业表现？
AI.motivation: 尽管月经管理不足的挑战和影响日益受到关注，但高收入国家大学生的相关体验往往被忽视。需要了解学生在校园环境中的具体经历和需求。
AI.theoretical_framework: 月经公平理论、月经污名化理论、健康促进的环境支持理论
AI.method: 采用焦点小组讨论、访谈和参与式绘画活动，对14名南澳大利亚大学学生进行研究。使用反思性主题分析法分析焦点小组、访谈和绘画数据。
AI.findings: 大学设施未能满足参与者的月经需求，影响了她们的月经健康和学业。参与者面临多种月经相关挑战，并提出了改善物理和社会环境的建议。月经污名化普遍存在，参与者不期望大学提供月经支持，也不认为她们的建议会被完全采纳。
AI.theory_contributions: 深化了对高收入国家大学生月经管理体验的理解，揭示了月经污名化在校园环境中的表现，为月经公平理论提供了实证支持。
AI.practical_contributions: 提出了具体的校园改进建议：改造现有厕所隔间和区域，引入校园月经支持措施，将月经支持纳入政策和建筑标准，并在大学以外的公共厕所推广类似改进。

title: Efficiency Paradox: AI Adoption, Market Valuation, and Workforce Disruption in Indian IT
affiliations: and Shree Guru Gobind Singh Tricentenary University

detail.title: Efficiency Paradox: AI Adoption, Market Valuation, and Workforce Disruption in Indian IT
detail.abstract: This study examines the efficiency paradox in Indian IT services: positive stock market reactions to AI adoption disclosures alongside contraction of entry-level employment. Using an event-study framework across 28 AI-related announcements by Tata Consultancy Services, Infosys, Wipro, HCL Technologies, and Tech Mahindra during FY2020-FY2025, cumulative abnormal returns (CARs) are estimated using Nifty IT and Nifty 50 benchmarks with a 200-day estimation window, placebo tests, and cross-sectional regression. Actionable AI disclosures generate significant CARs of 2-5%. Meanwhile, fresher hiring declined about 70% between FY2022-FY2024, eliminating roughly 95,000 roles. The paradox reflects margin improvement pricing, competitive signalling, and temporal discounting of long-term employment risks.

AI.tldr: 印度IT服务业的效率悖论：AI采用披露带来积极股市反应，但初级就业岗位却收缩。研究发现AI相关公告产生2-5%的累计异常收益，而2022-2024年间应届生招聘下降约70%，减少约95,000个岗位。
AI.research_question: 印度IT服务业中AI采用披露为何会同时产生积极的股市反应和初级就业岗位的收缩？
AI.motivation: 理解AI采用在印度IT服务业中产生的矛盾效应：一方面市场对AI采用持积极态度，另一方面初级就业岗位却在减少，这构成了"效率悖论"。
AI.theoretical_framework: 效率悖论理论、事件研究理论、信号理论、边际改善定价理论、时间折现理论
AI.method: 事件研究框架，分析28个AI相关公告（来自TCS、Infosys、Wipro、HCL Technologies、Tech Mahindra，2020-2025财年），使用Nifty IT和Nifty 50基准，200天估计窗口，累计异常收益计算，安慰剂测试和横截面回归
AI.findings: 1. 可操作的AI披露产生显著的2-5%累计异常收益；2. 2022-2024财年间应届生招聘下降约70%，减少约95,000个岗位；3. 悖论反映了边际改善定价、竞争信号传递和长期就业风险的时间折现
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 提出并验证了印度IT服务业的"效率悖论"；2. 揭示了AI采用对资本市场和劳动力市场的矛盾影响机制；3. 扩展了技术采用与就业关系的理论框架
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为IT企业AI战略提供决策参考；2. 为政策制定者平衡技术采用与就业提供依据；3. 为投资者评估AI相关投资提供分析框架；4. 为求职者和教育机构提供就业市场趋势洞察

title: Policy Advice by Digital Economic Twins: Using Agent-based Modelling and Artificial Intelligence
affiliations: and Independent

detail.title: Policy Advice by Digital Economic Twins: Using Agent-based Modelling and Artificial Intelligence
detail.abstract: The various challenges or – in one word – the polycrisis (increasingly) confronting humanity in general and economic actors in particular, as well as the widespread recognition of the economy as a complex system, require immediate rethinking. Consequently, the awareness is rising that predominant (insular) economic models or tools are of limited practical use in intricate matters such as policymaking. Hence, to gain a much deeper understanding of the functioning of economic systems – in order to make virtuous business decisions, conceive useful political measures, or create reliable economic forecasts (especially, probable scenarios in the context of foresight) – innovative instruments and methods, along with inter-/transdisciplinary collaboration, must be facilitated. As a possible solution, a Digital Twin of the Economy (DigEcoTwin) is defined by utilizing Agent-Based Modelling (ABM) as a structural foundation for applying Artificial Intelligence (AI), so as to harness the forces of this revolutionary technology while minimizing its weaknesses and, decisively, ensuring that human control/oversight remains central to decision- or policymaking. Such an instrument, along with its corresponding platform, could, as revealed by some use cases, provide – within a clear business or political process – the necessary guidance for complex undertakings aimed at improving the effectiveness of actions, while also increasing their efficiency. Moreover, it offers the potential to engage society, as well as to enhance democratic participation with the objective of progressing along the vital path to, among other things, sustainable transformation, but without disastrous consequences for prosperity or stability of societies. The proposed concept describes how such a DigEcoTwin may possibly be developed over the course of a non-profit business venture or research project.

AI.tldr: 本文提出利用基于智能体建模(ABM)和人工智能(AI)构建"经济数字孪生"(DigEcoTwin)，以应对当前复杂经济系统面临的多元危机，为政策制定和商业决策提供更有效的工具。
AI.research_question: 如何开发一个基于智能体建模和人工智能的经济数字孪生系统，以更好地理解和应对复杂经济系统中的挑战？
AI.motivation: 当前人类面临多元危机，传统经济模型在处理复杂政策制定问题时存在局限性，需要创新的跨学科工具来深入理解经济系统运作机制。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于智能体建模(ABM)作为结构基础，结合人工智能(AI)技术，构建复杂系统理论框架下的经济数字孪生概念。
AI.method: 概念性研究，提出通过非营利商业项目或研究项目开发经济数字孪生的方法论框架，包括技术架构和应用场景分析。
AI.findings: 经济数字孪生能够为复杂决策提供必要指导，提高行动效果和效率，同时促进社会参与和民主决策，支持可持续转型。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了将ABM与AI结合的经济数字孪生理论框架，为复杂经济系统建模提供了新的跨学科方法论。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者、商业决策者提供了实用的数字工具平台，能够支持更有效的政策制定、商业决策和经济预测，促进可持续发展。

publicationDetails.detailsText: Cambridge Centre for Alternative Finance Research Paper No. 24
publicationDetails.journalName: Cambridge Centre for Alternative Finance (CCAF) Research Paper Series

detail.abstract: This joint study from the Academy of Internet Finance (AIF) of Zhejiang University and CCAF exams the current landscape and emerging trends in global FinTech hubs. This report studies more than 70 cities in six continents, to uncover the development of their current financial innovation (FinTech) industries, consumer experiences and ecosystems. It finds that Beijing, San Francisco, NewYork, London and Shanghai are the top five ranked FinTech Hubs globally with a number of highly competitive Regional FinTech Hubs emerging, such as Singapore, Berlin and Toronto.

AI.tldr: 浙江大学互联网金融研究院与CCAF联合研究全球金融科技中心现状与趋势，分析了六大洲70多个城市，发现北京、旧金山、纽约、伦敦和上海是全球前五大金融科技中心，新加坡、柏林和多伦多等区域性中心也表现出高度竞争力。
AI.research_question: 全球金融科技中心的现状如何？哪些城市是领先的金融科技中心？区域性金融科技中心的发展趋势是什么？
AI.motivation: 随着金融科技行业的快速发展，了解全球金融科技中心的分布、竞争格局和发展趋势对于政策制定者、投资者和企业具有重要意义。需要系统性地评估全球金融科技生态系统的发展状况。
AI.theoretical_framework: 金融科技生态系统理论、创新集群理论、城市竞争力理论、金融创新扩散理论
AI.method: 对全球六大洲70多个城市进行实证研究，采用多维度评估框架，包括金融创新产业发展、消费者体验和生态系统建设等方面
AI.findings: 1. 北京、旧金山、纽约、伦敦和上海是全球前五大金融科技中心；2. 新加坡、柏林和多伦多等城市是高度竞争力的区域性金融科技中心；3. 全球金融科技中心呈现多元化分布格局
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 构建了全球金融科技中心的评估框架；2. 揭示了金融科技中心的空间分布规律；3. 丰富了金融科技生态系统理论
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为城市发展金融科技产业提供参考；2. 为投资者选择投资地点提供依据；3. 为政策制定者优化金融科技发展环境提供建议

title: To Cap or Not to Cap? Energy Crises in a Currency Union

detail.title: To Cap or Not to Cap? Energy Crises in a Currency Union

publicationDetails.journalName: Board of Governors: International Finance Discussion Papers (Topic)

detail.abstract: During the energy crisis in 2022 some Euro Area countries introduced price caps on energy, while others did not, leading to about 30 percentage points higher energy inflation in uncapped countries. This paper investigates the trade-offs policymakers face with energy price caps in a two-country currency union model with shared energy supply. The cooperative, optimal outcome is for neither country to impose a price cap, since the cap is a costly market distortion. However, capping allows a country to avoid a crisis at the cost of negative spillovers on the uncapped country, characterized by high inflation and lower output. The quantitative model with non-homothetic preferences and substitutability of energy sources shows that the cost of the price cap exceeds the cost of such spillovers, explaining why some countries capped prices while others did not. Moreover, I show that the spillovers from price caps contributed to about 10 (0.5) percentage points of energy (headline) inflation in the uncapped Euro Area countries in 2022. Targeted transfers, an alternative policy to the price cap, is a cheaper and more effective way to boost consumption of the poor without creating divergence within the union.

AI.tldr: 该论文研究2022年能源危机中欧元区国家实施能源价格上限的政策权衡。研究发现，价格上限虽然能让实施国避免危机，但会对未实施国产生负面溢出效应（高通胀和低产出）。最优合作结果是都不实施价格上限，因为价格上限是成本高昂的市场扭曲。定向转移支付是比价格上限更便宜有效的替代政策。
AI.research_question: 在共享能源供应的两国家货币联盟中，政策制定者在能源价格上限政策上面临哪些权衡？为什么一些欧元区国家实施价格上限而另一些没有？
AI.motivation: 2022年能源危机中，欧元区国家在能源价格上限政策上出现分歧：实施价格上限的国家能源通胀比未实施国低约30个百分点。这种政策差异及其对联盟内其他国家的溢出效应需要理论解释。
AI.theoretical_framework: 两国家货币联盟模型，共享能源供应，非位似偏好，能源来源可替代性，价格上限作为市场扭曲，政策外部性理论。
AI.method: 定量模型分析，使用非位似偏好和能源来源可替代性的理论框架，模拟不同政策情景下的经济效果。
AI.findings: 1. 价格上限让实施国避免危机，但对未实施国产生负面溢出效应（高通胀和低产出）；2. 价格上限的成本超过溢出效应的成本，解释了政策差异；3. 价格上限导致2022年未实施价格上限的欧元区国家能源通胀增加约10个百分点，整体通胀增加0.5个百分点；4. 定向转移支付是比价格上限更便宜有效的替代政策。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 在货币联盟背景下分析能源价格上限的政策外部性；2. 解释为什么在相同冲击下不同国家会选择不同政策；3. 量化价格上限的溢出效应；4. 提出定向转移支付作为更优的政策替代方案。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为政策制定者提供能源价格上限的成本效益分析；2. 揭示价格上限在货币联盟内的负面溢出效应；3. 推荐定向转移支付作为更有效的政策工具；4. 为未来能源危机应对提供政策参考。

detail.title: Evaluating Transportation Improvements Within Cities Using Quantitative Spatial Models

publicationDetails.detailsText: FRB of Philadelphia Working Paper No. 26-13
publicationDetails.journalName: Federal Reserve Bank of Philadelphia Working Paper Series

detail.abstract: I describe the use of quantitative spatial models (QSMs) to evaluate the effects of transportation infrastructure within cities. After discussing the motivation for QSMs relative to other economic measurement techniques, I develop a simple QSM and detail the components that enter into the model. Next, I consider identification challenges and practical implementation. Finally, I highlight several shortcomings common in applications of QSMs, as well as growth areas where QSMs show promise for future development.

AI.tldr: 本文介绍如何使用定量空间模型（QSMs）评估城市内交通基础设施的影响，包括模型构建、识别挑战、实际应用，以及当前局限性和未来发展方向。
AI.research_question: 如何利用定量空间模型（QSMs）有效评估城市交通基础设施的经济影响？
AI.motivation: 相对于其他经济测量技术，QSMs能够更好地捕捉空间经济活动的复杂相互作用，为城市交通基础设施投资提供更准确的政策评估工具。
AI.theoretical_framework: 定量空间模型（QSMs）理论框架，包括空间均衡模型、通勤成本函数、土地市场均衡、劳动力市场匹配等空间经济学理论。
AI.method: 构建简单的定量空间模型，详细说明模型组成部分，讨论识别挑战和实际实施方法。
AI.findings: QSMs能够有效评估交通基础设施对城市经济的影响，但在应用中存在若干常见缺陷，同时在某些领域具有未来发展潜力。
AI.theory_contributions: 系统化定量空间模型在城市交通基础设施评估中的应用框架，明确模型构建要素和识别策略。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供实用的QSMs实施指南，帮助评估交通基础设施投资的经济效益，并指出当前应用中的常见问题和改进方向。

title: The Impact of Early Investments in Urban School Systems in the United States
affiliations: Marquette University and Federal Reserve Banks - Federal Reserve Bank of Philadelphia

detail.title: The Impact of Early Investments in Urban School Systems in the United States

publicationDetails.detailsText: FRB of Philadelphia Working Paper No. 26-15
publicationDetails.journalName: Federal Reserve Bank of Philadelphia Working Paper Series

detail.abstract: Cities in the United States dramatically expanded spending on public education after World War I, with the average urban school district increasing per pupil expenditures by over 70 percent by 1924. We provide the first evaluation of these unprecedented investments in public education using a new dataset and plausibly exogenous growth in school spending generated by anti-German sentiment. We find that school resources significantly increased educational attainment and wages later in life, particularly for less advantaged children. Increases in expenditures can explain about 40 percent of the sizable increase in educational attainment of cohorts born between 1895 and 1913.

AI.tldr: 该研究首次评估了美国一战后的公共教育投资，发现学校资源显著提高了教育程度和未来工资，特别是对弱势儿童，解释了1895-1913年出生群体教育程度增长的40%。
AI.research_question: 第一次世界大战后美国城市公共教育支出的大幅增加如何影响学生的教育程度和未来收入？
AI.motivation: 美国城市在第一次世界大战后大幅增加公共教育支出（平均增长70%以上），但此前缺乏对这些投资效果的实证评估。
AI.theoretical_framework: 教育投资的人力资本理论，教育回报理论，教育机会不平等理论。
AI.method: 使用新数据集和反德情绪导致的学校支出外生增长作为自然实验，进行因果推断分析。
AI.findings: 学校资源显著提高了教育程度和未来工资，特别是对弱势儿童；支出增加可以解释1895-1913年出生群体教育程度增长的40%。
AI.theory_contributions: 为教育投资的人力资本理论提供了历史实证证据，证实了公共教育支出对弱势群体的重要性。
AI.practical_contributions: 为当代教育政策制定提供了历史参考，支持增加公共教育投资，特别是针对弱势群体的教育投入。
